notes.title: Developer Note: Season 3 – Light and Shadow
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/e0da14f614f65e3e0770ee76bc0b550e4b848fbe.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Hello, this is JANG, the Executive Producer of Game of Thrones: Kingsroad.[/b] [b] 

[/b]Thanks to your continued interest and active participation, [b]Season 2: Highgarden Grand Festival[/b] has come to a successful close. We are deeply grateful to all of you who continue to support and enjoy [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i].[/p][p] [/p][p]As we get ready to move onto [b]Season 3: Light and Shadow[/b], players will face the tension between the radiant promises of purification and the hidden truths that lie in the shadows.[/p][p] [/p][p]This developer note provides a first look at the major updates and improvements planned for Season 3.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h2][b]🛠️ IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]1. RP System[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p]The RP System has long been one of the most frequently requested improvements from the community. Alongside ongoing efforts to expand content that doesn’t consume RP, Season 3 will introduce additional changes to make field content more flexible and rewarding. These updates will give players more freedom and choice in how they engage with content.[/p][p] [/p][p]Starting in Season 3, [b]first-clear rewards for field content will no longer consume RP[/b]. In addition, players will have the option to spend RP or not upon completing content.[/p][p] [/p][p]🔹 Spending RP will grant the usual rewards.[/p][p]🔸 Choosing not to spend RP will still allow players to earn Regional Currency and engage with the content.[/p][p] [/p][p]The development team will continue to monitor the RP system and explore further improvements based on player feedback going forward.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]2. World Boss Ranking Contribution[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p]Starting in Season 3, the minimum contribution requirement for all World Bosses will be [b]lowered from 1% damage to 0.1%[/b].[/p][p] [/p][p]As players have grown stronger with each update, the time required to defeat World Bosses has steadily decreased. To ensure that more players can take part and earn rewards, the contribution threshold will be adjusted starting this season.[/p][p] [/p][p]With this change, even brief participation will now qualify for rewards, making World Boss battles more accessible and easier to participate in.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]3. Ranged Combat Improvements[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p]Ranged combat will receive several key updates in Season 3.[/p][p] [/p][p]Previously, after each shot, characters would lower their weapon as if reloading before aiming again. Starting next season, aim will remain active between shots, allowing for a smoother and more immersive combat experience.[/p][p] [/p][p]In addition, combat controls in ranged mode will also be improved. Players will be able to perform quick dodges and rolls even while aiming, providing greater flexibility and responsiveness in battle.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]4. Training Grounds[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p]Many players have requested a dedicated space to practice and improve combat skills. In Season 3, the Training Grounds will be introduced to meet this need.[/p][p] [/p][p]The Training Grounds will provide a safe environment to hone mastery and enjoy the process of growth, allowing practice of character controls and skill combos without pressure. Features such as unlimited rage, instant skill cooldown resets, and more will let players experiment freely across a variety of scenarios.[/p][p] [/p][p]Additionally, the Training Grounds will offer practical combat data like DPS, enabling intuitive comparisons and analysis. Setups can be freely adjusted, giving players the flexibility to train in a style that best suits them.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]5. Artifact System[/b][/h3][p]Starting in Season 3, the Artifact system will undergo the following improvements. [/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Artifact Growth UI Improvements][/b][/p][p]Season 3 will introduce updates to the Artifact UI, making the growth and management of Artifacts more intuitive.[/p][p] [/p][p]Effects that were previously applied based on conditions will become easier to understand, and players will be able to directly click to apply Collection Effects based on levels, providing a clearer sense of progression.[/p][p] [/p][p]Passive stat increases tied to Collection Effects levels will be more easily visible, and players will be able to preview the specific stats granted by higher levels. These improvements will allow players to quickly grasp all relevant information about Artifact growth, making the overall progression process more transparent and easier to follow.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]\[Artifact Enhancement Adjustments][/b][/p][p]In addition, the stat bonuses applied at each total enhancement stage will be slightly increased, and any individual Artifacts that exceed 100% enhancement will also be reflected in passive stats.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]6. Kraken - Damage Inflicted Rankings Removed[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p]In Season 3, the Damage Inflicted Rankings for the Altar of Lost Memories: Kraken will be removed.[/p][p] [/p][p]Rewards that were previously distributed based on damage inflicted will now be allocated through Clear Time rankings, ensuring that rewards better reflect overall performance in the encounter. This change is intended to provide a fairer and more consistent way for players to earn rewards while still rewarding skill and strategy.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][b] [/b][/p][h2][b]🌓 SEASON 3[/b][/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]1. Season 3: Light and Shadow[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p][i]Purification carried out in the name of light, the truths concealed behind it, and the deep darkness cast by persecution in the name of faith.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Players will be tasked by Stannis Baratheon to investigate the disappearance of a young noble in the Stormlands. What appears to be a simple missing-person case is anything but. Beneath the surface lies a tangled web of religious and political tensions involving supporters of Renly Baratheon, followers of the Faith of the Seven, Stannis’ loyalists, and heretical priests of R’hllor.[/p][p] [/p][p]Your character’s mission will focus on uncovering the true nature of the so-called “purification,” revealing the distorted beliefs that have been used to justify it, and exposing the hidden truths that have long been shrouded in darkness.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]2. New Altar of Memories: Basilisk[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p]The Basilisk is a monstrous creature resembling a massive lizard, with an elongated snout lined with razor-sharp teeth capable of swallowing prey whole.[/p][p] [/p][p]Native to swamps and jungle regions, its potent venom has long been associated with political assassinations. In battle, the Basilisk will wield a unique ability to alter its appearance, introducing an unpredictable challenge for those who face it.[/p][p] [/p][p]Beginning with Season 3, the new Altar of Memories: Basilisk will become available, offering Tier 5 legendary equipment as a wish reward. To obtain it, the cumulative clear count requirement will increase by 8, bringing the total to 16, encouraging deeper engagement with the content.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]3. Altar of Memories Level Scaling and Wait Time[/b][/h3][h3] [/h3][p]With the recent introduction of the Giant Ice Spider Hard Mode, Season 3 will expand Hard Mode to all Altars of Memories.[/p][p] [/p][p]Hard Mode bosses will feature distinct appearances from their normal difficulty counterparts and will introduce new combat patterns, offering players fresh and more formidable encounters.[/p][p] [/p][p]Additionally, responding to community feedback, Season 3 will also implement a short start delay for Altar of Memories battles, ensuring fair competition across different player environments.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]4. World Level 3[/b][/h3][h3] [/h3][p]World Level 3 will be introduced in an update following the start of Season 3. As noted in our previous developer note, players can expect higher drop rates for Tier 6 legendary materials compared to World Levels 1 and 2.[/p][p] [/p][p]This new difficulty will pit players against stronger enemies, offering both greater challenges and the chance to claim the most coveted rewards.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][b] [/b][/p][h2][b]✨ FUTURE UPDATES[/b][/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]1. Content Preview[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p]Our most recent survey reaffirmed that players are eager for main story expansions, multiplayer content, and a variety of special events.[/p][p] [/p][p]In response, Season 3 will introduce Hard Mode for all pre-existing Altar of Memories bosses alongside the new Basilisk, as already mentioned above. On the event side, several unique initiatives are also planned.[/p][p] [/p][p]We would also like to tease a fun new event coming in Season 3. In the "[b]One More Drink![/b]" event, players will be able to obtain and drink special beverages from all over Westeros. These drinks provide not only helpful combat buffs, but also a special effect upon consumption.[/p][p] [/p][p]Beyond this, a variety of additional events are in development to enrich adventures across Westeros, with detailed updates to follow in future announcements.[/p][p] [/p][p]Most importantly, we’d like to share more about the highly anticipated new main story and Altar of Lost Memories content.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]2. Firewyrm[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p]The Firewyrm, the next boss for the Altar of Lost Memories, will be added in an update planned for November.[/p][p] [/p][p]According to old tales, the Firewyrm was a wingless dragon subspecies that inhabited the Fourteen Flames in Valyria. Though it has no wings, it shares the fearsome appearance of a dragon and moves skillfully underground, making it a deadly and unpredictable foe.[/p][p] [/p][p]Defeating the Firewyrm will demand unprecedented levels of strategy and teamwork from raiding parties.[/p][p] [/p][p]In this developer note, we’re offering a first glimpse of the Firewyrm in its current stage of development.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/549d18ca52a03740abc788f25045a9b046dbacd0.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/f32d9f3fb12d5fd63675d6188f5e488af4fd6e56.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/1d46df81bde7e068bc11704ecbaff5dc98d18955.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][h3][b]3. Westerlands[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p]Casterly Rock and the Westerlands region are currently in development, and the exact release schedule has yet to be determined. We know that many players have been eagerly looking forward to this content, and we truly appreciate your patience. The team is taking the time to carefully craft every aspect, from set design to field content, to ensure that when the Westerlands is ready, it will be a rich and polished experience that players can fully enjoy. The core concepts and direction are being carefully shaped and refined to deliver a brand-new stage for players to explore.[/p][p] [/p][p]This developer note offers a first look at select concept artwork created during development, providing a glimpse into the atmosphere and character of the Westerlands as it comes to life in-game.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5e4d547727bfc5aaea379a40e2e5c99d426accaa.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/4325e3501a9f49c1f9cc70219d42bf6c8d5bc2f0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/6bfb6a5fe439e314e69aac9bbe33151db939f500.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/ab826fcc37aa161f1c331dab399c58c0601178e3.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]This concludes today’s developer note. Season 3 will bring a variety of new content, offering fresh challenges and experiences for players to enjoy in the upcoming season.[/p][p] [/p][p]We look forward to your continued feedback, which helps shape the world of [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i], and we’ll return in October with another developer note to share further updates.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you for your ongoing dedication as we continue to explore Westeros together.
[/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p][b]JANG[/b][/p][p]Executive Producer, Game of Thrones: Kingsroad
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 9/17 (Wed) Bans Against Unauthorized Program Usage
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies.[/p][p]This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/b]team. [/p][p][/p][p]As part of our ongoing commitment to maintaining a fair and enjoyable gaming environment, we regularly monitor for abnormal gameplay behavior and the use of unauthorized programs.[/p][p] [/p][p]In accordance with our operational policies and Terms of Service, we have applied account restrictions to users found repeatedly violating these guidelines despite prior notice. [/p][p] [/p][p]Affected users will receive an in-game message detailing their restriction.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]⚠️ Please note that all individual rankings associated with accounts found using unauthorized programs, including Altars, Content, Wormwalks, Beyond the Wall, and other game modes, have been deleted and cannot be restored. These accounts are also ineligible for any associated rewards.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We continue to investigate reports and suspicious activity, and further actions will be taken as necessary. We appreciate your patience and understanding as we work to ensure fair play for everyone.[/p][p] [/p][p]For more detailed information, please refer to our [url="https://help.netmarble.com/en/terms/terms_of_service_en_?lcLocale=en"][b]\[Terms of Service][/b][/url].[/p][p]  [/p][p]If you have questions or concerns regarding your account, please contact Customer Support. [/p][p] [/p][p]We're committed to providing a fair gaming experience for all players, and we appreciate your cooperation.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Information Regarding EU Latency Issues
notes.notes:
[p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies.
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team.  [/p][p][/p][p]Since earlier this week, we have been monitoring reports of unusually high latency affecting players in certain countries within the EU region.[/p][p] [/p][p]After conducting a thorough investigation, we can confirm that this issue does not stem from our internal game systems. Instead, it is the result of external factors affecting network routes and connections.[/p][p] [/p][p]We understand how disruptive latency can be to your gameplay experience, and we want to assure you that resolving this matter is our highest priority. To that end, we are working closely with our external partners to identify the root causes and implement corrective measures as quickly as possible.[/p][p] [/p][p]We kindly ask for your patience and understanding as we work toward a solution, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. [/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i]. We remain committed to providing a stable and enjoyable service environment for all players.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 9/10 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/661d50962b015bc14ff1bc13d0cadb05b0d26953.gif"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team.  [/p][p][/p][p]Our September 10 update introduces new limited-time events, along with a series of fixes for known issues and overall gameplay improvements.[/p][p] [/p][p]Dive into the full details below.[/p][p][/p][p][u][b]1️⃣ \[Improvements & Changes][/b][/u][/p][p][u][b]2️⃣ \[New Events][/b][/u][/p][p][u][b]3️⃣ \[Shop][/b][/u][/p][p][u][b]4️⃣ \[Bug Fixes][/b][/u][/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][b] [/b][/p][h2][b]🛠️ IMPROVEMENTS & CHANGES[/b][/h2][h3][b] [/b][/h3][h3][b]⚜️ GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Certain exchangeable byproducts from Ferocious Beasts, previously obtainable only in base difficulty, can now also be acquired when a World Level is applied.[/p][p]🔸 The amount of Copper obtained from certain chests in Enemy Hideouts when a World Level is applied has been increased.[/p][p]🔸 The instant progression feature for the Season 2 Pass is now available.[/p][p]     ✔️ Players can use Golden Dragons to instantly advance by the desired number of levels.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]⚜️ COMBAT & GAMEPLAY [/b][/h3][p]🔸 A cooldown has been added to the Taunt skill used by the Ferocious Beast: Angry Bull.[/p][p]🔸 A cooldown has been added to the Dodge skill used by the Ferocious Beast: Direwolf.[/p][p]🔸 The frequency of the Charge skill used by the Ferocious Beast: Direwolf has been reduced.[/p][h3] [/h3][h3][b]⚜️ INVENTORY[/b][/h3][p]🔸 The number of default slots for Basic and Equipment inventory has been increased.[/p][p]     ✔️ Basic Inventory: 25 slots → 35 slots[/p][p]     ✔️ Equipment Inventory: 40 slots → 50 slots[/p][p]🔸 The purchase limit for Inventory Expansion Tools in the Regional Currency Exchange Shops has been increased.[/p][p]🔸 An Inventory Expansion Tool has been added to the Alliance Shop, available from Alliance Level 2 and above.[/p][p]🔸 New Basic/Equipment Inventory Expansion Tools purchasable with Golden Dragons have been added to the Support/Convenience tab within the shop. [/p][p]🔸 The maximum number of inventory slots that can be expanded using Expansion Tools has been increased.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h2][b]🎊 NEW EVENTS[/b][/h2][p]👉 [b]Missions Await: Claim Your Rewards in Westeros[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][hr][/hr][p][b] [/b][/p][h2][b]🛒 SHOP[/b][/h2][p]🔸 New items have been added to the shop. Please check the in-game shop for more details.[/p][p]🔸 Certain items will no longer be available for purchase after September 24th. Please see below for more details.[/p][p]     ✔️ Wormwalks Challenge Conquest Package[/p][p]▸ Any unclaimed or unearned rewards will be automatically delivered to the mailbox.[/p][p]     ✔️ Westeros Welcome Package (Trial included)[/p][p]     ✔️ Mail Crow (Trial included)[/p][p]▸ Players who purchased either the Westeros Welcome Package or Mail Crow will be refunded in Iron Bank Marks.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h2][b]🛠️BUG FIXES[/b][/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]⚜️ GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Backend server optimizations have been implemented to improve overall stability.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚜️ COMBAT & GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the selling price of Tier 6 equipment was set the same as Tier 4 equipment.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed the spinning animation of the Giant Spider boss in Beyond the Wall Expeditions.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where characters could become stuck in certain terrain within the Oldtown Enemy Hideout - Shaded Septry.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the Black Elk’s daze gauge was incorrectly applied in World Levels. [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚜️ UI/UX & VISUAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Implemented various UI/UX improvements.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]We appreciate your continued support and feedback as we work to improve your experience in the game. As always, we remain committed to providing you with the best possible gameplay experience. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of our community!  [/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img][/p]

This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team.

New challenges and rewards await as the journey through Westeros continues! We’ve prepared a series of special events with missions and rewards to support your battles and adventures.[/p][p]

notes.title: 9/3 (Wed) Bans Against Unauthorized Program Usage
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies.[/p][p]This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/b]team. [/p][p][/p][p]As part of our ongoing commitment to maintaining a fair and enjoyable gaming environment, we regularly monitor for abnormal gameplay behavior and the use of unauthorized programs.[/p][p] [/p][p]In accordance with our operational policies and Terms of Service, we have applied account restrictions to users found repeatedly violating these guidelines despite prior notice. [/p][p] [/p][p]Affected users will receive an in-game message detailing their restriction.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]⚠️ Please note that all individual rankings associated with accounts found using unauthorized programs, including Altars, Content, Wormwalks, Beyond the Wall, and other game modes, have been deleted and cannot be restored. These accounts are also ineligible for any associated rewards.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We continue to investigate reports and suspicious activity, and further actions will be taken as necessary. We appreciate your patience and understanding as we work to ensure fair play for everyone.[/p][p] [/p][p]For more detailed information, please refer to our [url="https://help.netmarble.com/en/terms/terms_of_service_en_?lcLocale=en"][b]\[Terms of Service][/b][/url].[/p][p]  [/p][p]If you have questions or concerns regarding your account, please contact Customer Support. [/p][p] [/p][p]We're committed to providing a fair gaming experience for all players, and we appreciate your cooperation.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Developer Note: Upcoming Improvements
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/e0da14f614f65e3e0770ee76bc0b550e4b848fbe.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Hello, this is JANG, the Executive Producer of Game of Thrones: Kingsroad.[/b] [b] 

[/b]As [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] reaches its 100th day since the official launch, we want to extend our heartfelt thanks for the incredible support and enthusiasm you’ve shown.[/p][p] [/p][p]In this developer note, we will be sharing upcoming improvements and changes currently in development, based directly on the feedback and suggestions you have sent us.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][h2][/h2][h2][b]🌍 World Level System[/b][/h2][p] [/p][p]The [b]World Level System [/b]has been introduced in our latest update.

Currently, [b]World Levels 1 and 2[/b] are available. [b]World Level 1[/b] unlocks upon completing the main quest [i]“Snow and Storm”[/i] from Episode XIV – [i]The Crow’s Bastard[/i], while [b]World Level 2[/b] becomes available once your Momentum reaches 150,000.

The difficulty of World Level 1 is set to match the final boss of the current main quest. As the World Level increases, rewards for repeatable content will scale accordingly, giving greater value for the challenge.

With the World Level System, players can now explore and engage with field content across all areas continuously, without waiting for scheduled events. For example, defeating Fierce Beasts at the designated World Level grants Tier 6 crafting materials, allowing you to hunt across all regions and maximize your chances of collecting rare resources.[/p][p]
When the next World Level is added in a future update, drop rates for these materials will be higher, further enhancing both the sense of accomplishment and the value of rewards. We believe this system will offer more opportunities than ever to acquire [b]legendary-grade materials[/b].[/p][p]
Along with scaling difficulty and rewards, World Levels will also bring updates to certain content. We’re exploring options like making Bounties repeatable and other such improvements to content, and will share more details in a future developer note once these plans are finalized.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h2][b]🏰 Altar of Memories[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Starting in Season 3, Altar of Memories will also receive difficulty scaling alongside the World Level System.[/p][p]* Please note that the Altar’s difficulty won’t always align perfectly with the World Level.

As new World Levels are unlocked, higher Altar of Memories difficulties will become available, with rewards increasing alongside the challenge.

Wish Rewards will be shared across all dungeons at the same difficulty, and the Wish Reward count will apply universally among them. For example, a Wish Reward set in the Blue Cockatrice dungeon will also apply to the Giant Ice Spider dungeon at the same difficulty level. 

In future updates, higher Altar difficulties will also feature [b]legendary-grade equipment[/b] as Wish Rewards. These legendary rewards will require higher accumulated counts than Epic-grade items, encouraging progression at higher tiers.

For this update, the [b]Giant Ice Spider[/b] hard difficulty has been added as the first scaled difficulty. Looking ahead, we plan to introduce more bosses with modified difficulty levels, giving players exciting new challenges to tackle.

We have also heard feedback that entering the Altar of Memories can be slower depending on a player’s environment, which can negatively impact rankings. To address this, [b]a brief wait time will be introduced at the start of Altar runs beginning with the Season 3 update[/b].[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h2][b]🦑 Altar of Lost Memories - Hard Mode[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We are currently also preparing a [b]Hard mode [/b]for the[b] Altar of Lost Memories[/b], and along with it, we are revising the reward structure. This includes potential adjustments to amulet crafting and the overall reward system.

These changes are currently in the planning stage and will require additional time before they can be finalized. Once the improvements are confirmed, we will provide detailed information in a future developer note.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h2][b]🔥 Season 3 Improvements[/b][/h2][p] Here’s a look at some of the improvements we’ll be making during Season 3.[/p][h3][b]
✨ Convenience Features Made Free[/b][/h3][p]The [b]Westeros Welcome Package[/b] and [b]Messenger Raven[/b] features currently available for purchase will be discontinued.
[/p][p]All features previously included in these packages will be [b]available for free[/b], directly in-game. Players can enjoy these quality-of-life features freely, making for a smoother gameplay experience. (Players who have already purchased these features will be refunded the Iron Bank Marks spent.)[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚡ Worker Stamina Removal[/b][/h3][p]Starting with Season 3, the worker system will no longer use stamina. This change will allow players to assign their workers freely to any activity without restriction.[/p][p]You will be able to repeatedly use your most valuable workers as much as you want for production, trade, and expeditions, giving you greater flexibility and efficiency in managing your workforce.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]🐺 No RP Cost for First-Time Field Content Rewards[/b][/h3][p]First-time rewards from field content will be granted without consuming RP.[/p][p]We understand that many players found RP costs restrictive, so this change will allow you to enjoy field content more freely while still earning your rewards.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]🗡️ Option to Spend RP After Clearing Field Content[/b][/h3][p]Players will also have the option to choose whether or not to consume RP after clearing field content. You can continue spending RP to receive rewards as the current system, or opt not to consume RP and repeatedly collect regional currency while playing content.[/p][p] [/p][h3]❄️ [b]Beyond the Wall Expedition Improvements[/b][/h3][p]Beyond the Wall Expeditions will no longer consume tickets for first-time clears.[/p][p]Additionally, your achievements from the previous season will be taken into account, allowing you to skip lower stages and start directly at a difficulty that matches your progress. Jump in at the start of the season and challenge the stage that’s right for you.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][b] [/b][/p][h2][b]🍰 100 Day Celebration Rewards[/b][/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][p]To celebrate the 100th day since launch, we've prepared the following rewards, which you can claim from your in-game mailbox.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][th][p align="center"]🎁  [b]100-Day Celebration Rewards[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]100 RP Recharge Ticket x1[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]100 Days Celebration Cake x 10 [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Copper Pouch x10[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Uncommon - Epic Sigil Box x10[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Highgarden Banquet Raffle Bundle x1[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][b] [/b][/p][p]In addition to the updates shared above, we want you to know that we’ve heard all of your feedback, including suggestions related to the[b] ranking system [/b]and [b]other frequently mentioned areas[/b]. We understand these are important to you, and while some improvements are still under review and being carefully developed, we truly appreciate your patience as we work to make the experience better. For matters not covered in this note, discussions and planning are still ongoing, and we'll share detailed updates once everything is finalized.

In our next developer note, we’ll share more updates and news about Season 3.

Until then, we hope you enjoy the new World Level System and the 100-Day Celebration rewards to the fullest. We sincerely appreciate your ongoing support, feedback, and enthusiasm.

Thank you once again for being an important part of the [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] journey.

 Sincerely,[/p][p][b]JANG[/b][/p][p]Executive Producer, Game of Thrones: Kingsroad
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 8/28 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/661d50962b015bc14ff1bc13d0cadb05b0d26953.gif"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team. 

Our latest update introduces the [b]World Level System [/b]along with a new equipment tier, dungeon challenges, and a range of improvements designed to enhance your journey through Westeros.

Adjust the difficulty of the world, tackle the formidable Giant Ice Spider in the Altar of Memories, and craft powerful Tier 6 gear to strengthen your forces. Alongside these additions, we’ve made various gameplay improvements and fixes to enhance your overall experience.

Dive into the full details below.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]1️⃣ \[New Content][/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]2️⃣ \[Improvements & Changes][/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]3️⃣\[New Events] [/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]4️⃣\[Shop][/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]5️⃣\[Bug Fixes][/u][/b][/p][p align="center"][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]
🌎 NEW CONTENT
[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]🗺️ World Level System [/b][/h3][p]🔹 The new World Level System has been added to allow players to adjust the difficulty of the game to better match their power and progression. [/p][p]🔹 You can access the World Level system via the button at the top of the [b]☰ Menu[/b]. Field content difficulty will automatically scale based on your selected level.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/3791465da8da3b4ebc25125ad00b61e63ba7b69c.png"][/img][/p][p]▸ World Level 1 & 2 have been added in this update.[/p][p][b]⚠️ Please note: A cooldown applies after changing the World Level.
[/b][/p][p][b]🔹 How To Unlock:[/b][/p][p]     ✔️ World Level 1: Complete the main quest [b]“Snow and Storm”[/b] from [b]Episode XIV - The Crow’s Bastard[/b]. [/p][p]     ✔️ World Level 2: Reach 150,000 Momentum

🔹 Repeatable content rewards now scale with the selected World Level. (One-time and first-time completion rewards remain unchanged.)[/p][p]🔹 At World Level 1,[b] Tier 6 Epic-grade[/b] materials and equipment become obtainable, while at World Level 2 and higher, [b]Tier 6 Legendary-grade[/b] materials and equipment can be acquired.[/p][p]🔹 New achievements related to World Levels have been added.[/p][p]🔹 Setting World Level 1 or higher allows all Ferocious Beast Maesters to exchange Beast Pelt Scraps.[/p][h3]
[b]⚔️ New Equipment Tier[/b][/h3][p]🔹 Tier 6 equipment has been added.[/p][p]🔹 Tier 6 gear can be crafted once you reach Forge Level 8 and Character Level 37 (Estate Level 25 required).[/p][p]🔹 The following tabs have been updated to include Tier 6: Set Research, Set Collection, Craft Equipment, and Reforge Equipment. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]🕸 Altar of Memories: Giant Ice Spider Hard Mode[/b][/h3][p]🔹 Get ready to face a new challenge! A new Hard difficulty has been added to the Altar of Memories: face off against the Frostbite Giant Ice Spider. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️ IMPROVEMENTS & CHANGES[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ GENERAL[/b]
[/h3][p][b]🔸 Artifact Expeditions: [/b]Rewards have been streamlined. Junk loot has been removed, and completing an expedition now grants Copper directly, without the need to sell items separately.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🔸 Altar of Memories Rankings Rewards: [/b]With the introduction of the new Hard difficulty in the Altar of Memories, ranking rewards have been adjusted:[/p][p]    ✔️ The rewards previously tied to the former top difficulty, Stormshower Plains – Stormhorn Unicorn, have been shifted to the new top-tier challenge, Frostbite - Giant Ice Spider.[/p][p]    ✔️ This adjustment applies to all non-equipment rewards. Tiered equipment rewards remain specific to each dungeon.[/p][p]    ✔️ Lower-difficulty dungeons have also been adjusted, with their rewards moved up one tier to match the next-highest difficulty.[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p align="center"][b]Altar of Memories[/b][/p][/th][th][p align="center"][b]Ranking Rewards[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Shores of Dorne - Blue Cockatrice[/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Removed[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Frozen Cave - Giant Ice Spider[/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Removed[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Valley of Gold - Ironbeak Griffin[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]Changed[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Shores of Dorne - Cockatrices[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]Changed[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Stormshower Plains - Stormhorn Unicorn[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]Changed[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Frostbite - Giant Ice Spider[/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]New[/b][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][b]🍰 [/b]A new time-limited buff item [b]100 Days Celebration Cake[/b] has been added, which applies the following effects for 30 minutes upon use:[/p][p]🔹 Attack Power +10%[/p][p]🔹 Critical Strike Damage +10%[/p][p]🔹 Rage Consumption -15%[/p][p]▸ This item can be obtained through events held in celebration of the 100-day milestone.[/p][p][/p][p]🔸 The difficulty of certain Guidebook missions, including Side Quests, the Altar of Memories, and selected Field Content, has been reduced to ensure a smoother progression experience.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🎊 NEW EVENTS[/b][/h2][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3183280/announcements/detail/536611691635409323?snr=2___"]👉 100 Days of Kingsroad: Special Events[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛒 SHOP[/b][/h2][p]🔸New items have been added to the shop. Please check the in-game shop for more details.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️BUG FIXES[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Backend server optimizations have been implemented to improve overall stability.
[/p][h3][b]⚜️ COMBAT & GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where characters could occasionally fall off cliffs in certain Beyond the Wall Expedition stages.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue in Altar of Lost Memories - Kraken where ink projectiles disappeared before hitting the ground.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where World Boss Black Shadow Drogon could sometimes freeze during combat. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where World Boss Black Shadow Drogon could become immune to damage for a period of time under certain conditions. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where some effects of the Assassin’s Strike Combo IV Mastery: Elimination did not trigger correctly. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the damage of the Assassin’s Dagger Throw skill did not increase properly when leveled up. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the defeating the Elite Solder in the Enemy Hideout “Woods Fortress” did not count towards the mission under certain conditions. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue that prevented the completion of the Enemy Hideout “Raven’s Rock Fortress” under certain conditions. 
[/p][h3][b]⚜️ QUESTS & NPCS[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Added additional unskippable dialogue lines in cutscenes for the seasonal side quests “The Crown of Love and Death” and “Prisoner of the Iron Islands.”[/p][p]🔸 Fixed unnatural NPC movements during the tournament sequence in the seasonal side quest “The Crown of Love and Death.”[/p][p]🔸 Fixed collision issues when using the Follow Path feature.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where certain enemies in the North’s Enemy Hideout “Coastal Fortress” could move outside the intended area. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ CONTROL & INPUT [/b][/h3][p]🔸 Added fences and adjusted terrain on select bridges in Brightwater Keep to prevent frequent falls.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ UI/UX & VISUAL [/b][/h3][p]🔸 Implemented various UI/UX improvements.[/p][p]🔸 Updated certain quest dialogue for clarity.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where wild animals could occasionally spawn beneath the terrain.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]We appreciate your continued support and feedback as we work to improve your experience in the game. As always, we remain committed to providing you with the best possible gameplay experience. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of our community!  [/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img]

[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies.[/p][p]This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/b]team. [/p][p][/p][p]As part of our ongoing commitment to maintaining a fair and enjoyable gaming environment, we regularly monitor for abnormal gameplay behavior and the use of unauthorized programs.[/p][p] [/p][p]In accordance with our operational policies and Terms of Service, we have applied account restrictions to users found repeatedly violating these guidelines despite prior notice. [/p][p] [/p][p]Affected users will receive an in-game message detailing their restriction.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]⚠️ Please note that all individual rankings associated with accounts found using unauthorized programs, including Altars, Content, Wormwalks, Beyond the Wall, and other game modes, have been deleted and cannot be restored. notes.title: Upcoming Update Preview
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies.[/p][p]This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/b]team.[/p][p] [/p][p]Today, we’d like to give our players a [b]sneak peek at the upcoming content[/b] that will be added during Season 2: Highgarden Grand Festival.[/p][p] [/p][p]Check out the details below to get a glimpse of what’s in store. From fresh challenges to engaging new adventures, there’s plenty to look forward to, and we hope you’re as excited as we are to experience everything Season 2 has to offer![/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h3][b]🌍 World Level System[/b][/h3][h3] [/h3][p]To provide players with greater challenges and a stronger sense of accomplishment, we are introducing the [b]World Level System[/b].[/p][p] [/p][p]This system is designed to[b] elevate the difficulty and rewards[/b] of repeatable content across the entire open world, bringing a new sense of excitement and tension into environments you’ve already grown familiar with.[/p][p] [/p][p]With the World Level System, all repeatable content in the open world will scale according to the selected level. The world will automatically adjust to match this level, ensuring that every encounter reflects the challenge you’ve chosen.[/p][p][i]🚨 Please note that rewards from one-time rewards will not scale.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Players will unlock the World Level system after completing the final quest currently available in the main story (Stormlands - Crow’s Nest) and certain stages of the Wormwalks Challenge. When entering a World Level, both content difficulty and rewards will scale accordingly.[/p][p] [/p][p]This update will introduce World Levels 1 and 2, offering tougher enemies and a higher level of challenge for players ready to test their skills.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h3][b]🏰 Altar of Memories – Hard Difficulty[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p]With the introduction of the World Level System, a new Hard Difficulty is coming to the Altar of Memories.[/p][p] [/p][p]The first boss players will face on Hard Difficulty is the Giant Ice Spider. Its appearance is far more menacing, and it now wields stronger, more unpredictable skills that push players beyond the challenges of the normal version.[/p][p] [/p][p]Defeating the Giant Ice Spider on Hard Difficulty will reward[b] new tier equipment[/b], giving you every reason to prepare for these intense and strategic battles. Sharpen your skills and get ready to face a tougher, more formidable foe than before.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h3][b]🛡️ Tier 6 Equipment[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p]Higher-tier rewards will also be available as another part of the new World Level System.[/p][p] [/p][p]At World Level 1, players will be able to obtain materials for Tier 6 equipment. These materials are not limited to specific Ferocious Beasts. [b]All Ferocious Beasts at this level will drop Tier 6 crafting materials[/b], and you will be able to challenge any beast at this level to collect them.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Tier 6 equipment will be craftable once your character reaches level 37 and your Estate reaches level 25, which allows you to upgrade your Forge to level 8.[/b] All Ferocious Beast byproducts will be exchangeable while in World Level 1 and above.[/p][p] [/p][p]Players will be able to use World Level content to collect these materials and craft the new Tier 6 equipment, preparing themselves for even more challenging adventures ahead.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]This update is only the beginning for World Level content.[/p][p] [/p][p]We are already preparing even more diverse World Level experiences for future seasons, and detailed information will be shared in an upcoming Developer Note later this month.[/p][p] [/p][p]We hope you’ll stay excited as we continue expanding World Level content and introducing new additions to enhance your adventures.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you for being part of our growing world.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]	[/p]

notes.title: 8/13 (Wed) Bans Against Unauthorized Program Usage
notes.notes:

On the next page, follow the instructions to log in with your Netmarble or Twitch account.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/c1c6b55dc370b8242501468a316ae84b60512858.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3] [b]📢 Additional Notes[/b][/h3][p]🔹 To participate in Twitch Drops, your Netmarble ID account must be linked to your Twitch account. [/p][p]🔹 Once you claim your first reward, you cannot switch to another account. [/p][p]🔹 Your Netmarble ID and Twitch accounts will remain linked throughout the Twitch Drops event period and will automatically be unlinked after the event concludes. [/p][p]🔹 Twitch Drops viewing rewards are limited to once per account during the event period based on watch time, and will be delivered to your in-game mailbox. [/p][p]🔹 Twitch Drops viewing rewards have an expiration date. It is highly recommended that you claim your rewards from your Twitch Inventory before they expire, and then claim them from the [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/i]Twitch Drops Page within 30 days of claiming them in your Twitch Inventory, otherwise they will be deleted. [/p][p]🔹 Please note that using any abnormal methods to obtain Twitch Drops rewards may result in rewards being withheld, revoked, or lead to additional actions.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Meet a variety of streamers playing [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] during the Twitch Drops event, and don’t miss out on the special rewards![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p]

notes.title: 8/7 Update Notes [Updated on 8/7 02:45 PT]
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/661d50962b015bc14ff1bc13d0cadb05b0d26953.gif"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies.
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/b]team.[/p][p] [/p][p]Our latest update ushers in [b]Season 2: Highgarden Grand Festival[/b], bringing fresh adventures and exciting new content to Westeros.[/p][p]
Join the celebration with brand-new seasonal quests, bounties, and a brand-new Season Pass featuring exclusive rewards, including the coveted Laurels of Victory weapon skin.[/p][p][/p][p]Season 2 also expands Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Wormwalks with unique seasonal mechanics, while improvements to skills, artifacts, and gameplay balance ensure a more thrilling experience for all players.
[/p][p]Additionally, we’ve included a variety of system enhancements and bug fixes to smooth your journey through the realm.
[/p][p]Dive into the full details below.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]1️⃣ \[New Content][/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]2️⃣ \[Improvements & Changes][/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]3️⃣\[New Events] [/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]4️⃣\[Shop][/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]5️⃣\[Bug Fixes][/u][/b][/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🍷 NEW CONTENT[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]🌸 Season 2: Highgarden Grand Festival[/b][/h3][p]♦️ Season 2: Highgarden Grand Festival officially begins. [/p][p]     ✔️ The new seasonal content is available after completing the main quest [b]“Report to Lord Roose Bolton”[/b]. [/p][p]     ✔️ The new seasonal quests and bounties are available after completing the main quest [b]“Talk to Maester Seymour”[/b] in Highgarden. [/p][p]♦️ A brand new Season Pass is now available. [/p][p]♦️ Clearing seasonal content will allow you to progress Season Pass missions, and increase your pass level, unlocking exclusive seasonal progression elements along the way. [/p][p]♦️ Reach the final tier of the Season Pass to unlock the new exclusive [b]Laurels of Victory Weapon Skin[/b]. [/p][p]     ✔️ The  weapon skin can be equipped via Equipment ➜ Wardrobe. [/p][p]     ✔️ After reaching the final Season Pass tier, additional versions of the weapon skin for other classes can be purchased from the shop. [/p][p]♦️ Two new side quests (The Citadel’s Lost Giant & The Crown of Love and Death) and bounties themed around “Highgarden Grand Festival” are available. [/p][p]♦️ The quest “The Crown of Love and Death” will become available after completing “The Citadel’s Lost Giant”. [/p][p]♦️ Beyond the Wall Expeditions and seasonal Wormwalks have been updated for Season 2. [/p][p][/p][p]📢 The world level system, previously announced in the most recent developer note, will be added in an update in the near future along with tier 6 equipment and a Hard difficulty for Altar of Memories - Giant Ice Spider. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]🌹 Seasonal Content & Exclusive Effects \[Updated on 8/7 02:45 PT][/b][/h3][p]♦️ The seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Wormwalks feature exclusive seasonal mechanics. [/p][p]♦️ Participating in these seasonal activities does not consume RP, but instead uses a separate pool of reward attempts. [/p][p]♦️ When progressing through Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Seasonal Wormwalks, the season-exclusive effect [b]Trial of Fervor[/b] will be active, along with the Fervor Gauge. [/p][p]▸ These seasonal effects or traits do not apply to the original Wormwalks stages. [/p][p][b]     ✔️ Trial Gauge: [/b]The Trial Gauge gradually fills whenever certain conditions are met. Once the gauge reaches certain thresholds, you will suffer significant damage and harmful effects. The conditions for charging the Trial Gauge differ between Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Wormwalks. 
[b]     ✔️ Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expedition: [/b]Fervor gradually builds up when taking damage from enemies. 
[b]     ✔️ Seasonal Wormwalks: [/b]Fervor gradually builds up over time during combat or when taking damage. [/p][p]▸ Gaining a barrier instantly removes all active Trial of Fervor debuffs. While the barrier is active, you are immune to the harmful effects of the Trial Gauge.[/p][p]♦️ Season Growth Points earned from the Season Pass can be used to enhance traits specific to Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Seasonal Wormwalks.[/p][p]♦️ Rankings have been added for Season 2 of Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Wormwalks. [/p][p]     ✔️ Each set of rankings includes a weekly ranking, calculated and rewarded every week, and a final ranking, determined based on performance across the entire season.
[/p][p][b]📢 Clear rewards will be provided based on the number of Beyond the Wall Expedition tickets owned prior to the maintenance on August 6th. [/b]
[/p][h3][b]🏺New Artifacts[/b][/h3][p]🔹3 new Artifacts have been added.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][th][p][b]Grade[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Name[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Type[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Rare[/p][/td][td][p]Bronze Harpy Statue[/p][/td][td][p]Active[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Epic[/p][/td][td][p]Laughing Tree’s Tattered Cloth[/p][/td][td][p]Passive[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Legendary[/p][/td][td][p]Crown of Winter Roses[/p][/td][td][p]Active[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]➕ [b]Content Expansion[/b][/h3][p]♦️ Wormwalks Challenge has been expanded from stage 50 ➜ 55. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️ IMPROVEMENTS & CHANGES[/b][/h2][h3][b]
⚜️ GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸 A leaderboard for Wormwalks Challenge has been added. [/p][p]▸ Please note that these rankings do not have rewards. [/p][p]🔸 You can now use any jewelry of the same grade and slot as material when recasting, rather than being limited to identical pieces.[/p][p]     ✔️ You can still use identical jewelry when recasting, which reduces the number of materials needed compared to using other different pieces.[/p][p]🔸 The maximum recast level for legendary jewelry has been increased from 5 ➜ 7. [/p][p]🔸 Added support for DualSense and other controllers on mobile devices. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ SKILLS[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Certain skills have been grouped together. [/p][p]🔸 When you level up one skill in a group, all skills within that group will level up simultaneously. [/p][p]     ✔️ The skill point cost for leveling up a grouped skill remains the same as before, with no additional points spent. [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p][b]Before[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]After[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]✔ Strike Combo I[/p][p]✔ Strike Combo II[/p][p]✔ Strike Combo III[/p][p]✔ Strike Combo IV[/p][/td][td][p]Strike Combo[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]✔ Evasion Attack [/p][p]✔ Sprint Attack (Light)
✔ Sprint Attack (Heavy)[/p][/td][td][p]Moving Attack[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]✔ Sneak Attack [/p][p]✔ Mighty Strike[/p][p]✔ Parry-linked Attack[/p][/td][td][p]Special Attack[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]📢 [b]Please note that as a result of the skill grouping changes, all skill and mastery levels will be reset upon your first login after the update. Please be sure to re-allocate your skill and mastery points. [/b][/p][p]🔸 The naming convention for + Skill Effects obtained through refinement has been changed. [/p][p]    ✔️ For example: Merciless Strike + ➜ Merciless Strike (Enhanced)[/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]🗡️ KNIGHT[/b][/p][p]🔸 Damage from the first two hits from Strike Combo IV has been increased. [/p][p]🔸 The skill effect and cooldown for Boost Morale & Boost Morale (Enhanced) have been adjusted. [/p][p]    ✔️ Damage Taken Reduction: 25 - 37.5% ➜ Active Skill Damage Increase: 20%[/p][p]    ✔️ Cooldown: 30 seconds ➜ 24 seconds[/p][p][/p][p][b]🪓 SELLSWORD[/b][/p][p]🔸 Damage from the first two hits from Strike Combo III has been increased. [/p][p]🔸 Damage from the first three hits from Strike Combo IV has been increased. [/p][p]🔸 The cooldown and effect duration of the Roar & Roar (Enhanced) skill have been adjusted. [/p][p]    ✔️ Cooldown: 30 seconds ➜ 24 seconds[/p][p]    ✔️ Damage Increase effect duration increased (8 seconds ➜ 12 seconds).[/p][p]    ✔️ Berserk Reforge Effect duration increased (8 seconds ➜ 12 seconds).[/p][p]    ✔️ Vitality Reforge Effect duration increased (8 seconds ➜ 12 seconds).[/p][p]🔸 The duration of the Rampage skill has been increased to 12 seconds. [/p][p]🔸 The duration of the Defense Decrease effect on enemies from Rampage (Enhanced) has been increased (10 seconds ➜ 12 seconds).[/p][p][/p][p]⚔️ [b]ASSASSIN[/b][/p][p]🔸 Damage from the first three hits from Strike Combo III has been increased. [/p][p]🔸 Damage from the first three hits from Strike Combo IV has been increased. [/p][p]🔸 The Bloodburst effect stacks are no longer shared with other characters. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ OTHER[/b][/h3][p]🔸 The maximum number of normal enemies that can be stunned by Legendary Artifacts has been increased (4 ➜ 10).[/p][p]🔸 The buff radius for Active Artifact Skills that can affect party members has been significantly increased. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]🤝 ALLIANCE[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Alliance missions have been revamped. [/p][p]    ✔️ Alliance Mission Chance Recharge Ticket items have been removed. In exchange, Alliance Coins will be granted based on your Alliance Level as shown below.[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p][b]Alliance Level[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Distributed Alliance Coins[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]1-4[/p][/td][td][p]0[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]5-9[/p][/td][td][p]750[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]10-14[/p][/td][td][p]1,500[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]15-19[/p][/td][td][p]3,000[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]20+[/p][/td][td][p]5,200[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p]🔸 Personal Missions are now divided into daily and weekly missions. [/p][p]    ✔️ Daily missions can be completed once per day, while weekly missions can be completed once per week. [/p][p]🔸 The alliance check-in missions have been removed from Guidebook > Daily Missions. [/p][p]🔸 Guidebook > Weekly missions have been adjusted, with improved rewards for the final stage. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]❄️ SEASON 1 CHANGES[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Season 1 bounties will remain accessible even after the end of season 1. [/p][p][b]   ✔️ Winterfell Bounties: [/b]Smudge & Black Manta[/p][p][b]   ✔️ Prerequisites: [/b]You must have completed the Winterfell Main Quest “The North Remembers” and side quest “Order of Wolves”. [/p][p]🔸 Season 1 field monsters have been removed, and the item “\[Season] Ironborn's Loot” will no longer drop. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]
🎊 NEW EVENTS[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536609788663955804"]👉 \[Highgarden Grand Festival: Season 2 Events][/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536609788663955804"]👉 \[August Events: Trials, Missions, and More][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛒 SHOP[/b][/h2][p]🔸New items have been added to the shop. Please check the in-game shop for more details.[/p][p]🔸A new Battle Pass and Season Pass have been added. [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536609788663955798"]👉 \[Battle Pass: Blackfish in the Moonlight][/url][/p][p]    🗓️ Available until the September 24 maintenance[/p][p]    ⚠️ The Premium and Premium+ versions of the Battle Pass can be purchased [b]until September 23, 10:59 PM (PT)[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536609788663955800"]👉 \[Season Pass: Highgarden Grand Festival][/url][/p][p]    🗓️ Available until the September 24 maintenance[/p][p]    ⚠️ The Premium version of the Season Pass can be purchased [b]until September 23, 10:59 PM (PT)[/b].[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️BUG FIXES[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Backend server optimizations have been implemented to improve overall stability.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the weekly contribution of offline Alliance members would not update after a reset. [/p][p]🔸 Cooldowns for Artifact Skills and Active Skills will now be shared when moving between the single world and multi-space areas. [/p][p]🔸 Cooldowns for Artifact Skills and Active Skills will now reset upon entering a dungeon.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ COMBAT & GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3][p]🔸 You can now move while using draughts. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the “Ferocious Beast Codex clue acquired” message would be incorrectly displayed upon defeating a Ferocious Beast for a subsequent time. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the horn break gauge for the Ferocious Beast: Angry Bull would occasionally not increase properly. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the QTE buttons would occasionally not appear during certain Ferocious Beast encounters. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the purchase limit was displayed incorrectly for some account-limited items in the Shadowcat Parts Exchange Shop. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the Sneak Attack button could reappear during an ongoing Sneak Attack, causing an error message to be displayed.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where NPCs could appear duplicated after clearing a Bandit Camp under certain conditions. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the name and difficulty of the current “Beyond the Wall Expeditions” stage were displayed incorrectly on the results screen after a failed attempt. [/p][p]🔸 Adjusted certain text to better clarify the activation conditions of certain random Amulet effects.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the Amulet option “deals more damage when attacking enemies with less than 50% HP” was being applied incorrectly under certain conditions. [/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where stat increases from Amulet effects were not displaying correctly on jewelry.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where players could skip the intro cutscene in Altar of Memories: Stormhorn Unicorn, and attack before combat began. [/p][p]    ✔️ As a result, players will no longer be able to move into the combat area until the battle officially starts.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where being knocked outside the combat zone during certain content prevented players from progressing.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the second attack of Merciless Strike (Enhanced) skill would occasionally fail to trigger.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the Onslaught Draught was not consumed properly in certain situations.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the effect of the Agile Movement skill was occasionally not properly removed after use..[/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ QUESTS & NPCS[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where certain pathfinding indicators were not displaying correctly during the main quest “The Bastard and the Sellsword”. [/p][p]🔸 The location of certain Lost Letters in the White Harbor area have been adjusted. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ WORLD [/b][/h3][p]🔸 The location of the Cliffside signpost has been adjusted. [/p][p]🔸 A new Rosewater Bridge signpost has been added in the Highgarden region. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ UI/UX & VISUAL [/b][/h3][p]🔸 Various UI/UX improvements have been made. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where the progress for some Legacy Reclaimed Artifact achievements was not displayed properly. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where some terrain objects appeared to be floating.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where hotkeys would not work properly when selecting rewards after clearing content. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]We appreciate your continued support and feedback as we work to improve your experience in the game. As always, we remain committed to providing you with the best possible gameplay experience. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of our community![/p][p]

notes.title: Developer Note: Season 2 & The Road Ahead
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/e0da14f614f65e3e0770ee76bc0b550e4b848fbe.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Hello, this is JANG, the Executive Producer of Game of Thrones: Kingsroad.[/b] [b] 

[/b]Season 1: The Drowned God Wakes, which kicked off with the addition of the Kraken Raid, is soon coming to an end. As we look back on the journey of our very first season, we want to extend our heartfelt thanks to everyone who played, battled, and explored alongside us. Your dedication, feedback, and enthusiasm helped shape an unforgettable start to what lies ahead. 

In this developer’s note, we’re excited to give you a first look at what’s coming in Season 2, along with a preview of some of our long-term development plans. 

Behind the scenes, our team is already hard at work laying the foundation for major updates that will significantly change and shape the future of the game. These long-term efforts are focused on expanding core systems, enhancing gameplay depth, and delivering fresh experiences for all players. 

We’re preparing a wide range of impactful new features, including a [b]weapon swap system [/b]that will allow each class to wield two different weapon types, as well as [b]comprehensive enhancements to multiplayer content[/b] that will deepen cooperative play.  

Because these systems are deeply interconnected and technically complex, delivering them quickly poses a significant challenge. That said, development is progressing steadily, and we’re committed to keeping you informed every step of the way. Future developer notes will include regular updates so you can follow along as these features and systems continue to develop. 

Thank you, as always, for your continued support. We’re excited for what’s ahead and hope you’re just as eager to experience the future of [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i]. 

With that, let’s dive into the details in today’s Developer Note. 
[/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]
🔧 IMPROVEMENTS [/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]💍 1. Jewelry System Upgrade[/b][/h3][p]
We’re excited to introduce a significant upgrade to the jewelry crafting system that brings more flexibility while preserving meaningful strategy. Previously, recasting jewelry required players to use identical pieces as materials, which often made the process limiting and resource-heavy. 

With the upcoming update, you’ll be able to use different types of jewelry as material when recasting. This change is designed to ease inventory pressure and give you more freedom in how you approach crafting. However, using identical jewelry pieces will still offer an advantage, as the number of materials required will vary based on the pieces used. 

This improvement is part of our broader efforts to make crafting systems more intuitive, rewarding, and better suited to a variety of playstyles.
[/p][h3][b]⚔️ 2. Skill Progression Grouping[/b][/h3][p]
 We’ve heard the feedback regarding leveling up multiple Strike Combo skills, and we’re making some adjustments to how these abilities progress.

Currently, Strike Combo I, II, III, and IV function as separate skills, each requiring individual leveling and skill point investment. As a result, most players often focus on a single combo, which can limit build variety.

To streamline progression, we’ll be grouping these four combo skills into a single “Strike Combo” group. Moving forward, investing in Strike Combo will level up all four types simultaneously, reducing unnecessary micromanagement and making progression feel more impactful as characters are developed, while allowing  smoother skill management with more tactical freedom. 
[/p][h3][b]🎮 3. Mobile Controller Support[/b] [/h3][p]
With the launch of Season 2, Game of Thrones: Kingsroad will officially support [b]Dualsense controllers and a range of mobile gamepads[/b] across both iOS and Android platforms. This addition is aimed at giving players more freedom in how they experience the game, whether on the go or from the comfort of a controller setup. 

Our development team remains focused on delivering smooth, responsive controls that feel intuitive across all supported devices. Controller support will continue to be a priority, and we’re committed to delivering ongoing improvements to refine and enhance the overall gameplay experience. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]📢 UPDATE[/b][/h2][p]
[/p][h3][b]🎊 1. Seasonal Content[/b][/h3][p]
The upcoming update will mark the beginning of [b]Season 2: Highgarden Grand Festival[/b]. [/p][p]
Season 2 unfolds in the heart of Highgarden, where the realm gathers to celebrate the royal marriage of Margaery Tyrell and Tommen Baratheon. Amid the vibrant festivities and blooming gardens, however, a dark mystery begins to unfold. 

Upon arriving in Highgarden, players will encounter Maester Theobald, who brings unsettling news. The body of a giant, once entombed beneath the Citadel, has mysteriously vanished. Known as Valter, a knight sworn to the minor House Lyndale, the giant’s disappearance sets off a chain of events that soon draws you into a deeper mystery.

Adding to the intrigue, a bastard son of House Lyndale has also arrived in Highgarden to take part in the prestigious tournament. His presence may hold the key to uncovering the truth behind Valter’s fate.

This season’s storyline invites you to explore a tale where celebration meets suspicion, and where love, legacy, and loss are tightly woven together. Step into the mystery and experience a brand-new questline set against the backdrop of Highgarden’s grandeur. 

Going forward, seasonal content is planned to follow a regular release cycle of approximately 7 to 8 weeks. Each season will bring new adventures, challenges, and features to explore, and we hope you’ll continue to look forward to what’s next as the world of Kingsroad evolves. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]🌍 2. World Level System[/b][/h3][p]
To keep the open-world both challenging and engaging, we’re introducing a new [b]world level system[/b]. This new feature dynamically adjusts the difficulty across the game’s world by scaling monster strength and other content based on the set world level. 

As the difficulty rises, so do the rewards, turning familiar territories into fresh battlegrounds with higher stakes and greater rewards. Whether you’re hunting for a tougher challenge or revisiting earlier zones with renewed intensity, the world level system is designed to make every adventure feel vibrant and rewarding. 

This feature is scheduled to launch in an update shortly following the release of Season 2.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🚀 UPCOMING DEVELOPMENT PLANS [/b][/h2][p]
Beyond the immediate updates, our team is deeply engaged in several major long-term initiatives aimed at fundamentally enhancing the [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/i]experience. 

Here’s a glimpse of what’s on the horizon: [/p][h3][b]
🎨 1. Graphical Improvements[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’re in the process of executing a comprehensive graphical overhaul to bring the world of [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] to life with greater depths and visual fidelity. This includes improvements to character models, animations, lighting, environmental detail, and visual effects. Our aim is to create a more immersive and atmospheric experience that better captures the tone and intensity of Westeros. 

In addition to these visual upgrades, we’ll be reworking the prologue and tutorial sections more broadly. These early game areas will not only receive visual enhancements but also structural and narrative improvements. By refining the game’s pacing and overall presentation, we hope to deliver a more engaging introduction that sets the tone for your journey ahead, whether you’re a first-time player or returning veteran. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚔️ 2. Combat Impact Improvements [/b][/h3][p]
To heighten the sense of immersion in battle and better capture the brutal, unforgiving atmosphere of the original IP, we’re introducing new dismemberment effects that will trigger upon defeating enemies. 

This visual addition is designed to reinforce the ruthless tone of the battlefields of Westeros, delivering an experience that goes beyond simple hit feedback. Our goal is to amplify the weight and intensity of combat, making each strike feel more grounded, visceral, and satisfying. We believe this improvement will deepen the overall immersion and bring the harsh realities of war in Westeros to life in a more impactful and authentic way. 
[/p][h3][b]🗡️ 3. Weapon Swap System [/b][/h3][p]
To break away from repetitive combat patterns and add new layers of strategic depth, we’re currently developing a [b]weapon swap system[/b] that will allow players to switch weapons in real time during battle. This feature is designed to expand combat options and introduce dynamic new playstyles for each class. [/p][p]
For example, Assassins who typically rely on dual daggers will be able to incorporate rapier-based combat, while Knights who wield greatswords can switch to a sword-and-shield setup for more adaptive, defensive engagement. [/p][p]⚠️ [i]Please note that the above weapon pairings may be subject to change as development progresses. 

[/i]By enabling real-time weapon swapping, this system aims to disrupt static combat routines and maintain a higher level of player engagement throughout encounters. 

Skill chaining, precise weapon transitions, and cooldown management will be increasingly important, with performance depending heavily on player mastery. We believe this will add meaningful depth to combat and allow skilled players to shine through refined decision-making and execution. 

To support this system, an additional main weapon slot will be added, giving players more flexibility in building and customizing their loadouts. [/p][h3]
 [b]🔗 4. Enhanced Multiplayer Features[/b][/h3][p]
While the game’s single-player narrative remains a core pillar, we’re expanding multiplayer functionality to encourage more meaningful player interaction across repeatable content, including existing field activities and instance dungeons. These updates aim to provide more opportunities for both cooperation and competition. 

We’re also developing new alliance-based cooperative content where groups can compete for rankings, fostering long-term group play. In addition, more competitive PvE experiences are in the works, such as raid-style random coop encounters that will bring players together in real time, creating opportunities for memorable moments with others. These features are still under development, and we’ll be sharing more details as we move forward so you can stay updated. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]👀Content Preview[/b][/h2][p]
In addition to what we’ve shared above, here’s a visual preview of other content we have planned for future updates. Take a look at what’s coming later, and thank you for staying with us as we continue to grow and improve.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/797d10ea948413f587a02e9a57b0a7cf6b24aa19.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🎁 Developer Note Rewards[/b][/h2][p]
As a token of our gratitude for your continued love and support for [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i], we’ve prepared the following rewards for all players: 

[b]Rewards: [/b][/p][p]🔹 Copper Pouch x3[/p][p]🔹 30 RP Recharge Ticket x1[/p][p]🔹 Golden Dragon x500[/p][p]
That wraps up today’s developer note.

We want to assure you that we are consistently reviewing all valuable feedback submitted. Our commitment is to incorporate as much of it as possible to create an even better gaming experience for everyone.

Thank you again for being part of the [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] journey.[/p][p]

Sincerely,[/p][p][b]JANG[/b][/p][p]Executive Producer, Game of Thrones: Kingsroad
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.notes:

We appreciate your patience and understanding as we work to ensure fair play for everyone.[/p][p] [/p][p]For more detailed information, please refer to our [url="https://help.netmarble.com/en/terms/terms_of_service_en_?lcLocale=en"][b]\[Terms of Service][/b][/url].[/p][p]  [/p][p]If you have questions or concerns regarding your account, please contact Customer Support. [/p][p] [/p][p]We're committed to providing a fair gaming experience for all players, and we appreciate your cooperation.[/p][p]

notes.title: Notice Regarding Jewelry Enhancement Issues
notes.notes:
[p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies.[/p][p]This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/b]team. [/p][p][/p][p]We have recently identified two issues related to jewelry enhancement: one where a specific sequence of steps allowed jewelry to exceed the maximum enhancement level, causing effects to be upgraded beyond the intended limits, and another where using an already enhanced piece of jewelry as material granted more EXP than intended. [/p][p][/p][p]First and foremost, we would like to sincerely apologize to all players for any confusion or inconvenience caused by these issues. [/p][p][/p][p]This was an unintended enhancement method that could significantly affect the balance of the game. Therefore, it has been fixed as of the update on July 23rd, and it is no longer possible to obtain jewelry with excess stats. [/p][p][/p][p][b]In addition, all jewelry enhanced beyond the intended level will be reverted to their correct values during the next maintenance on August 6th (PT). Any materials used for these enhancements will be returned based on our internal guidelines.  [/b]
[/p][p]🚨 Please be advised that any abnormal use of jewelry enhanced beyond a certain threshold prior to the maintenance on August 6th (PT) may result in strict penalties in accordance with our operational policies. [/p][p][/p][p]We sincerely apologize once again for any inconvenience this may have caused, and we will be providing the compensation outlined below to all players as a gesture of our appreciation for your understanding and continued support. [/p][p][/p][p]☑️[b] Compensation Details[/b][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p][b]Distributed after the July 23 Maintenance[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Distributed after the August 6 Maintenance[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]🔹 Jewelry Polish x40[/p][p]🔹 Gemstone x160[/p][p]🔹 Silver Ore x70[/p][p]🔹 Gold Ore x30[/p][p]🔹 Copper x200,000[/p][/td][td][p]🔹 Legendary Jewelry (Random) x1[/p][p]🔹 Jewelry Hardener x30[/p][p]🔹 Jewelry Effect Locker x35[/p][p]🔹 Copper x100,000[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p]⚠️ Please note that the above compensation will not be provided to accounts found to have engaged in abnormal usage beyond a certain threshold related to this issue. (Materials used for jewelry enhancement will still be returned as normal.)[/p][p][/p][p]We will continue to do our utmost to provide you with an enjoyable experience in [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img][/p]
