[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/661d50962b015bc14ff1bc13d0cadb05b0d26953.gif"][/img]
[/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team. 

Our July 9 update introduces new limited-time events, along with a series of fixes for known issues and overall gameplay improvements.[/p][p][/p][p]Please refer to the details below for more information.[/p][p][/p][p]1️⃣\[Improvements & Changes][/p][p]2️⃣\[New Events] [/p][p]3️⃣\[Bug Fixes][/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️ IMPROVEMENTS & CHANGES[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Items can now be purchased in the shop for up to a maximum of 100 per purchase. [/p][p]The maximum quantity for bundle purchases in the shop has been increased from 30 to 100 per purchase. [/p][p]🔸 Kraken Amulet Designs can now be used in bulk.[/p][p]🔸 The blacksmith in Crow’s Nest now crafts equipment with Shadowcat Leather instead of Boar Leather. [/p][p]🔸 The cost to reset the Season Trait Tree has been reduced from 1,000 Copper to 100 Copper. [/p][p]🔸 The rankings for the previous Beyond the Wall Expeditions, which were marked as (Ending Soon), have now been removed. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️REWARDS [/b][/h3][p]🔸 The rewards for Black Shadow Drogon have been adjusted. [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,"][tr][th][p][b]Rank[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Jewelry Polish[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Gemstone[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Copper[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]1st[/p][/td][td][p]9 > [b]12[/b][/p][/td][td][p]15 > [b]20[/b][/p][/td][td][p]6,000 > [b]7,800[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]2nd/3rd[/p][/td][td][p]7 > [b]8[/b][/p][/td][td][p]9 > [b]17[/b][/p][/td][td][p]5,000 > [b]6,600[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Others[/p][/td][td][p]7 > [b]8[/b][/p][/td][td][p]7 > [b]14[/b][/p][/td][td][p]4,000 > [b]5,400[/b][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p]🔸 The exchange limit for the following items in the Shadowcat Parts Exchange Shop has been increased:[/p][p][b]   ✔️ Legendary Equipment Selection Box: [/b]1 ➜ 2[/p][p][b]   ✔️ Copper: [/b]5 ➜ 15[/p][p][b]   ✔️ Equipment Hardener: [/b]2[b] [/b]➜ 6[/p][p]🔸 Items acquired from Ferocious Beasts can no longer be discarded. [/p][p]▸ Further information will be provided at a later date for players who obtained Shadowcat materials prior to the update but discarded them.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️BALANCE[/b][/h3][p]🔸 The Dragon Hunter enemy that spawns in the Bandit Camp “Dragon’s Hunter Rest” in Crow’s Nest has been downgraded from Boss to Elite, and his HP has been reduced. [/p][p]🔸 The number of enemies that appear in the Crow’s Nest Enemy Hideout “Raven’s Rock Fortress” has been reduced. [/p][p]▸ This adjustment was made to reduce combat difficulty due to high enemy density. [/p][p]▸ While the total number of enemies has been decreased, EXP and Copper rewards from the remaining enemies have been increased to ensure that total gains are not negatively impacted. [/p][p]🔸 The Boss-grade enemy appearing in “Raven’s Rock Fortress” now grants increased EXP and Copper upon defeat. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🎊 NEW EVENTS[/b][/h2][p][b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536605983645897221"]👉 7/9 Events: Master of Steel & March of Glory[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️BUG FIXES[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Backend server optimizations have been implemented to improve overall stability.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️COMBAT & GAMEPLAY [/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]🔸 Historic Site: Witch of the Forest[/b][/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where Historic Site: Witch of the Forest could not be completed as intended. [/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where players could die under certain conditions in Historic Site: Witch of the Forest. [/p][p][b]   ✔️ [/b]Fixed an issue where falling into water during Historic Site: Witch of the Forest would not result in character death. [/p][p][/p][p][b]🔸 Occupied Site: Griffin’s Cove[/b][/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in terrain during battle in Occupied Sites: Griffin’s Cove. [/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where ladders could not be used correctly while clearing Occupied Site: Griffin’s Cove. [/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where certain quests in Occupied Site: Griffin’s Cove could be cleared without being accepted under certain conditions. [/p][p][/p][p][b]🔸 Enemy Hideout: Raven’s Rock Fortress[/b][/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in terrain within Enemy Hideout: Raven’s Rock Fortress. [/p][p]   ✔️ Adjusted the placement of some enemies within Enemy Hideout: Raven’s Rock Fortress. [/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where NPCs tied to a mission objective would remain spawned on the map after clearing Enemy Hideout: Raven’s Rock Fortress. [/p][p][/p][p][b]🔸 Wormwalks[/b][/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where the “Kill enemies with ranged attacks” objective could not be cleared under certain conditions in Wormwalks. [/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where the knockdown animation was not triggered upon being hit by “Lightning Strike” while clearing Wormwalks. [/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where rewards were not received under certain conditions upon clearing Seasonal Wormwalks. [/p][p][/p][p][b]🔸 Beyond the Wall Expeditions[/b][/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where attacks on the initial group of wolves within the “Clear Wolf Den” mission in Beyond the Wall Expeditions made it difficult to proceed with the quest. [/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where Wolf Leader enemies in Beyond the Wall Expeditions were not properly affected by hitstun effects. [/p][p][/p][p][b]🔸 Kraken Raid[/b][/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue during the final phase of Kraken Raid where both the tentacles and main body could still be damaged after the boss was defeated. [/p][p]   ✔️ Adjusted Kraken Raid so that if the boss’s HP is reset mid-fight, any damage dealt prior to the reset is no longer counted toward the rankings.[/p][p]   ✔️ Fixed an issue where the post-defeat cutscene for the Kraken Raid would cause the raid to fail if it did not end within the clear time. [/p][p][/p][p][b]🔸 Other[/b][/p][p]  ✔️ Alliance effects will no longer be removed upon death. [/p][p]  ✔️ Fixed an issue where trading rewards from Griffin’s Cove provided items with an unusually low sale value. [/p][p]  ✔️ Removed the level requirement when exchanging Intact Shadowcat Leather Scraps. [/p][p]  ✔️ Fixed an issue where World Boss Drogon would target and cast skills on recently resurrected players. [/p][p]  ✔️ Fixed an issue where the “Balance” House Sigil Board would occasionally not unlock even after meeting the required conditions. [/p][p]  ✔️ Fixed an issue where HP Tinctures would occasionally not be consumed when used under certain conditions. [/p][p]  ✔️ Fixed an issue where the Merciless Strike+ skill (Sellsword class) could be used repeatedly without consuming Rage after triggering the first hit. [/p][p]  ✔️ Fixed an issue where an error message would occasionally appear during matchmaking for Altar of Memories, preventing the player from being matched to a party. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ QUESTS & NPCS[/b][/h3][p]🔸 Fixed an issue in the seasonal side quest “Prisoner of the Iron Islands” where the Research Log could be obtained multiple times. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue in the seasonal side quest “Prisoner of the Iron Islands” where rapidly defeating the Ironborn that appeared in the Tallhart Port ship after inspecting the caged prisoner blocked quest progress. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue in the main quest in Crow’s Nest where a barrier spawned too early during the boss fight, preventing entry. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue that prevented traveling to other areas if the main-quest boss in Crow’s Nest was left undefeated. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where respawning during quests in Crow’s Nest could incorrectly place the character at the lighthouse. [/p][p]🔸 Adjusted the positions of certain NPCs and wildlife in Crow’s Nest. [/p][p]🔸 Adjusted spawn locations for certain Peddlers. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed missing dialogue lines in certain side quests. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where a Riddle quest was displayed upon every login.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where “The Wolves in the Woods” quest could not be progressed under certain conditions. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where crafting a Legendary-grade item did not count towards completing the Guidebook Mission 5-10: Craft Epic or better equipment. 
[/p][h3][b]⚜️CONTROL & INPUT [/b][/h3][h3]🔸 Adjusted the location of Raven’s Rock Signpost in Crow’s Nest. [/h3][p]🔸 Adjusted the location of the broken signpost for Bitterleaf Ledge in Crow’s Nest. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚜️ UI/UX & VISUAL [/b][/h3][p]🔸 Overall improvements to UI/UX have been implemented. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed various in-game typos. [/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where some in-game text was either missing or displayed in an incorrect language.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed an issue where certain environmental or gathering objects appeared to be floating. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]We appreciate your continued support and feedback as we work to improve your experience in the game. As always, we remain committed to providing you with the best possible gameplay experience. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of our community!  [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img]
 


[/p]

notes.title: 7/9 Maintenance Notice [Updated on 7/9 03:10 AM (PT)]
notes.notes: [p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies.[/p][p]This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/i]will be undergoing maintenance on July 9 (PT) as we prepare for a new update.[/p][p][/p][p]Read on for more details about what’s to come.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h3]☑️[b] Maintenance Schedule[/b][/h3][p]🔹 July 9, 07:00 PM - 11:10 PM (PT)[/p][p][i]▸ The maintenance schedule is subject to change.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]☑️ [b]Maintenance Compensation[/b][/h3][p]🔹 30 RP[/p][p]🔹 Draught/Concoction Random Box x5[/p][p]▸ [b]Claim Period[/b]: After the 7/9 Update - July 11, 01:00 AM (PT)[/p][p][/p][h3]☑️[b] Maintenance Details \[Updated on 7/9 03:10 AM (PT)] [/b][/h3][p]🔹 New Events[/p][p]🔹 Bug Fixes & Improvements[/p][p]▸ Further details about the update will be provided in an upcoming notice.[/p][p][/p][p][b]⚠️ Please note that players on mobile devices will be unable to access the game after the maintenance unless the latest update has been installed. We strongly recommend downloading the update if you have not already done so.  [/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][u][url="https://forum.netmarble.com/got/view/3/116"]\[Go to Recommended Update Notice][/url][/u][/b][/p][p][/p][h3]📌 [b]Additional Notes[/b][/h3][p]🔹Due to potential changes in quest progress and other game content, we strongly recommend logging out of the game from a safe area before the maintenance begins. [/p][p]🔹The Web Shop will be unavailable while maintenance is in progress.[/p][p]🔹We strongly recommend completing daily content and claiming daily rewards before the maintenance takes place, as the daily reset will occur during this time.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]We will continue to do our utmost to provide you with an enjoyable experience in [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: [NPC+] Season 1 Payment Information
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies. [/p][p]This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/b]team. [/p][p][/p][p]We would like to thank all of the creators who participated in the Season 1 of [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/i]Partner Creator Plus. We sincerely appreciate your passion and the creativity you brought to Season 1.[/p][p][/p][p]Please refer to the detailed instructions below to submit your Season 1 payment request.[/p][p]
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------   [/p][p][/p][h3][b]☑️ Submission Period for Payment Documents[/b][/h3][p][b]🔹 July 16, 12:00 AM - July 26, 11:59 PM (PT)[/b]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[/p][h3]
[b]⚠️ Important Things to Check Before Submitting Your Payment Request [/b][/h3][h3] [/h3][p]1️⃣ Please make sure to [u][b]submit your payment request[/b][/u][b] [/b]within the designated submission period. [/p][p]» A payment request must be submitted within this designated period for the payment to be processed for this season. Any outstanding settlements from the pre-season or Season 1 will not be processed if requests are not submitted within this period.[/p][p][b]» Please be sure to include your bonus points in your payment request.[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]2️⃣ [u][b]Use the designated format[/b][/u][b] [/b]upon sending your payment request submission information through email. (Refer to the instructions below for more information.)[/p][p][/p][p]3️⃣ Partner Point payments are processed in USD, so please provide a bank account that can accept USD transactions. [/p][p][/p][p]4️⃣ Payments will not be processed if the submitted documents are invalid:[/p][p]▸ If the submitted documents do not clearly show bank details, such as account information or the SWIFT code.[/p][p]▸ If the numbers in the submitted documents are not clearly identifiable.[/p][p]▸ If unofficial documents, such as screenshots or copies, are submitted. [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚠️ Instructions for Submitting Account Verification (in English)[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Please submit an official document that includes the following details, all written in English: [/p][p]▸ Account Number (or IBAN) [/p][p]▸ Account Holder’s Name [/p][p]▸ Bank Name [/p][p]▸ Bank Address [/p][p][/p][p]» Please refer to the sample image below for reference. [/p][p]» Documents written in local languages will not be accepted—[u][b]make sure to submit all documents in English only[/b][/u]. [/p][p]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/d7995e36010d90c7d4b33253eb16d7453ecf6bd6.jpg"][/img][b]» Please contact your bank for instructions on how to obtain an account verification document in English. [/b][/p][p][b]» Accounts that cannot process USD transactions cannot be used. [/b][/p][p][b]» Please note that there will be no additional payment period after the upcoming one as the Partner Creator Plus program will  be indefinitely suspended. Please make sure to submit your payment request within the designated period. [/b][/p][p]
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- [/p][h3][/h3][h3][b]☑️ How to Submit a Payment Request [/b][/h3][p] [/p][p]1️⃣ Go to the [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/i]Partner Creator Plus Page [/p][p][url="https://creator.netmarble.com/en/got"][b]🔗 Game of Thrones: Kingsroad Partner Creator Plus[/b][/url][/p][p] [/p][p]2️⃣ "Log in" - "My Page" - [b][u]"Go to Payment"[/u][/b][/p][p]» The payment request page will open on July 16, 12:00 AM (PT). [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/92be18441e4a099bcc80a274fdf75f3a3e19d46a.jpg"][/img]3️⃣ Fill out the payment request details by email, and make sure to attach the required payment information and documents before submitting. [/p][p]» Click the “Copy” button next to the attachment section and paste the copied Payment Request Information (Email Body) content into the body of your email. [/p][p]

notes.title: 6/27 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies. [/p][p]This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/b]team.[/p][p][/p][p]A server patch is scheduled to address several issues identified in the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Please see below for more details.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]☑️ Patch Schedule[/b][/h3][p]🔹June 27, 02:30 AM - 02:40 AM (PT)[/p][p]▸ The patch schedule is subject to change.[/p][h3]
 [b]☑️ Patch Details[/b][/h3][p]🔹 Server stabilization improvements will be implemented. [/p][p]🔹 An issue where push notifications are not received on mobile devices will be fixed. [/p][p]🔹 An issue where the Cutting Mutilation skill does not apply Bloodburst stack damage will be fixed. [/p][p]▸ After the patch, Cutting Mutilation will consume existing Bloodburst stacks and deal bonus damage based on the number of stacks consumed, as intended. [/p][p]🔹 An issue preventing progress on Guidebook Mission 7-4 after the most recent update will be fixed. [/p][p]🔹 An issue where the HP recovery effect of the 5 piece Brute set only triggers once after logging in will be fixed.  [/p][p]🔹 An issue where the attack speed bonus from the 5 piece Mauler set is not properly applied while Fury is active will be fixed. [/p][p]🔹 An issue where Trait Tree stats were not properly reflected in the Character Info screen for certain characters after the update will be fixed.[/p][h3]
[b]📌 Additional Notes[/b][/h3][p]🔸Due to potential changes in quest progress and other game content, we strongly recommend logging out of the game from a safe area before the patch is applied.[/p][p]🔸Please refrain from using daily content and buff items until after the patch has been completed, as game connection may be unstable. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]We will continue to do our utmost to provide you with an enjoyable experience in Game of Thrones: Kingsroad.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you. [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 6/26 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/661d50962b015bc14ff1bc13d0cadb05b0d26953.gif"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, Lords and Ladies.[/p][p]This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/b]team.[/p][p] [/p][p]Our June 26 update brings the first major content drop since launch, and with it, the arrival of [b]Season 1: The Drowned God Wakes[/b].[/p][p] [/p][p]This new season introduces the Kraken Raid, where a powerful new enemy and valuable rewards await. The newly added Amulet system also brings fresh ways to enhance your strength and customize your build.[/p][p]  [/p][p]A new difficulty level for World Boss Drogon has also been added, offering a greater challenge for seasoned players alongside a host of new content. This update also brings limited-time seasonal events, a range of system improvements, and a round of bug fixes for known issues.[/p][p] [/p][p]Check out the full details below.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]1️⃣ New Content[/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]2️⃣ Improvements & Changes[/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]3️⃣New Events[/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]4️⃣Shop[/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]5️⃣Bug Fixes[/u][/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛡️ NEW CONTENT[/b][/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]⚔️ Season 1: The Drowned God Wakes[/b][/h3][p]🔹Season 1: The Drowned God Wakes officially begins.[/p][p]▸ The new season is available after completing the main quest [b]Report to Lord Roose Bolton[/b].[/p][p]🔹Clearing seasonal content will advance Season Pass missions. As the pass level increases, you can unlock exclusive seasonal progression elements along the way.[/p][p]🔹A brand-new season pass is now available.[/p][p]🔹Reach the final tier of the season pass to unlock the exclusive [b]Krakencoil Weapon Skin[/b].[/p][p]     ✔️ The weapon skin can be equipped through [b]Equipment ➜ Wardrobe[/b].[/p][p]     ✔️ After reaching the final season pass tier, additional versions of the Krakencoil weapon skin for other classes can be purchased from the shop.[/p][p]🔹New side quests and bounties themed around “The Drowned God Wakes” are available.[/p][p]     ✔️ These side quests and bounties will remain accessible even after the season ends.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]❄️ Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions[/b][/h3][p]🔹The previous Beyond the Wall Expedition has been revamped into the seasonal Beyond the Wall Expedition.[/p][p]    ✔️ Ranking rewards for the original Beyond the Wall Expeditions will be calculated based on standings just before the Season 1 update, and will be distributed sequentially starting July 1st (PT).[/p][p]🔹Several of the original Beyond the Wall Expedition effects have been adjusted or removed, and the related shop items have been reworked.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]❄️ Seasonal Wormwalks[/b][/h3][p]🔹A seasonal version of Wormwalks has been added, available alongside the original Wormwalks content.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]❄️ Seasonal Content & Effects[/b][/h3][p]🔹The seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Wormwalks feature exclusive seasonal mechanics.[/p][p]🔹Participating in these seasonal activities does not consume RP, but instead uses a separate pool of reward attempts.[/p][p]🔹When progressing through Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Seasonal Wormwalks, the season-exclusive effect [b]Trial of Steel[/b] will be active, along with two new gauges: [b]Heat [/b]and [b]Erosion[/b].[/p][p]▸ These seasonal effects or traits do not apply to the original Wormwalks stages.[/p][p]     ✔️ [b]Heat Gauge: [/b]Builds up upon landing Active Skills on enemies, granting buffs that aid combat based on its accumulation.[/p][p]     ✔️ [b]Erosion Gauge: [/b]Builds up upon landing Strike Combos on enemies or when damage is taken, applying debuffs that hinder combat effectiveness as it accumulates.[/p][p]🔹Beyond the Wall Expedition Season Growth Points & Wormwalks Season Growth Points earned through the Season Pass can be used to enhance traits related to Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Seasonal Wormwalks.[/p][p]🔹New rankings have been added for Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Seasonal Wormwalks.[/p][p]     ✔️ Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expedition Rankings and Seasonal Wormwalks Rankings consist of interim rankings, which are counted and settled every two weeks. Final rankings are counted and settled over the entire season period (6 weeks).[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]🗺️ New Region: Crow’s Nest[/b][/h3][p]🔹The new region [b]Crow’s Nest[/b] is now available.[/p][p]🔹New main quests, as well as side quests and encounter quests have been added.[/p][p]🔹The side quest “Silent Lighthouse” is available after completing the prerequisite quest “Red Book” and clearing the Occupied Site “Griffin’s Cove”.[/p][p]     ✔️ Although the “Silent Lighthouse” quest is a direct continuation of “Red Book”, it begins with a character located inside of Griffin’s Cove, so the Occupied Zone must be cleared before it becomes accessible.[/p][p]🔹Additional regional content is now available, including:[/p][p]     ✔️ Bounties[/p][p]     ✔️ Ferocious Beast[/p][p]     ✔️ Echoes of the Past[/p][p]     ✔️ Enemy Hideout[/p][p]     ✔️ Gods’ Havens[/p][p]     ✔️ Historic Sites[/p][p]     ✔️ Occupied Sites[/p][p]     ✔️ Bandit Camps[/p][p]🔹Exploration Progress rewards for stages 3 and 4 have been added to the Stormlands region.[/p][p]🔹New items have been added to the Tribute Exchange Shop, and the exchange limits for certain items have been increased.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]🏺New Artifacts[/b][/h3][p]🔹3 new Artifacts have been added.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][th][p][b]Grade[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Name[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Type[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Rare[/p][/td][td][p]Black Driftwood[/p][/td][td][p]Passive[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Epic[/p][/td][td][p]Marksman's Quiver[/p][/td][td][p]Active[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Legendary[/p][/td][td][p]The Broken Sword[/p][/td][td][p]Passive[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]🦑 Kraken Raid[/b][/h3][p]🔹The new co-op content [b]Kraken Raid [/b]has been added.[/p][p]🔹Access the dungeon through the [b]Weirwood located within Storm’s End[/b], in the Stormlands.[/p][p]🔹Designed for 4-player parties, raid rewards can be earned based on the number of dungeon completions (2 charges per week, with a maximum accumulation of 4).[/p][p]🔹Defeating the Kraken grants a chance to obtain [b]Amulet Core [/b]crafting materials.[/p][p]🔹A new leaderboard for Kraken Raid rankings has been added.[/p][p]🔹New achievements related to the Kraken Raid have been added. [b]

[/b][/p][h3]💎 [b]Amulet System[/b][/h3][p]🔹Visit the [b]Amulet Workshop [/b](accessible via Raven Messenger > Amulet Workshop or the actual Amulet Workshop in Renan’s Rest) to craft and polish Amulets.[/p][p] 🔹A total of 9 Amulets have been added (3 Rare, 3 Epic, and 3 Legendary).[/p][p]🔹All Amulets provide fixed effects, along with additional random effects based on their rarity.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="183,291"][tr][th colwidth="183"][p][b]Amulet[/b][/p][/th][th colwidth="291"][p][b]Fixed Effects[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="183"][p]Kraken’s Heart Amulet[/p][/td][td colwidth="291"][p]✔ Ranged Attack Damage Increase[/p][p]✔ HP[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="183"][p]Kraken’s Wrath Amulet[/p][/td][td colwidth="291"][p]✔ Active Skill Damage Increase[/p][p]✔ HP[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="183"][p]Kraken’s Grasp Amulet[/p][/td][td colwidth="291"][p]✔ Strike Combo Damage Increase[/p][p]✔ HP[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][h3]➕ [b]Content Expansion[/b][/h3][p]🔹Wormwalks has been expanded from stage 40 to 50.[/p][p]🔹A new difficulty tier for World Boss Drogon is now available. This version of Drogon can be accessed from the [b]Scorched Plain [/b]in the Stormlands region.[/p][p] [/p][h3]➕ [b]Additional New Content[/b][/h3][p]🔹New emojis and emotes have been added.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️ IMPROVEMENTS & CHANGES[/b][/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]⚜️GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸The maximum character level has been increased to [b]level 50[/b].[/p][p]🔸Set Research levels have been expanded to [b]level 50[/b].[/p][p]🔸Two new Equipment Sets and Set Effects have been added: [b]Guardian [/b]and [b]Tempest[/b].[/p][p]🔸Level requirements for crafting Tier 3 to 5 equipment have been eased.[/p][p]🔸Using Ruin Runners or Relic Finders for Artifact Expeditions no longer consumes worker stamina.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚜️COMBAT[/b][/h3][p]🔸The Momentum penalty for fighting enemies with higher Momentum has been removed.[/p][p]    ✔️ Visual effects indicating low Momentum will still appear, even though the penalty no longer applies.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚜️CHANGES TO CONTENT REWARD ACQUISITION[/b][/h3][p]🔸Beyond the Wall Expeditions and Altar of Memories will no longer require RP to obtain rewards. Instead, rewards are now granted by using up the available reward attempts for each activity.[/p][p][b]    ✔️ Beyond the Wall Expedition: [/b]Entry will be restricted once all reward attempts have been used.[/p][p][b]   ✔️ Altar of Memories & Kraken Raid: [/b]Entry remains possible even after reward attempts are exhausted, but no rewards can be earned.[/p][p]🔸With this new reward system, reward counts will be automatically consumed and rewards will be granted upon clearing the content. As a result, the unclaimed dungeon reward system will no longer apply.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🎊 NEW EVENTS[/b][/h2][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3183280/announcements/detail/591771368562885852?snr=2___"][b]👉 Ongoing Events in Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b][/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛒 SHOP[/b][/h2][p]🔸New items have been added to the shop. Please check the in-game shop for more details.[/p][p]🔸A new Battle Pass and Season Pass have been added.[/p][p] [/p][p][b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536605983645892926"]👉 Battle Pass: Echoes of the Storm and the Wolf[/url][/b][/p][p]    🗓️ Available until  August 6, 10:59 PM (PT)[/p][p]    ⚠️ The Premium and Premium+ versions of the Battle Pass can be purchased [b]until July 23, 10:59 PM (PT)[/b].[/p][p] [/p][p][b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536605983645892909"]👉 Season Pass: The Drowned God Wakes[/url][/b][/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][h2]
[b]🛠️BUG FIXES[/b][/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]⚜️GENERAL[/b][/h3][p]🔸Backend server optimizations have been implemented to improve overall stability.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where patch resources were repeatedly downloaded on each login.[/p][p]🔸The rules for creating new channels have been updated:[/p][p][b]   ✔️ Before:[/b] New channels were created only when all existing channels reached full capacity.[/p][p][b]   ✔️ After:[/b] New channels will now be created once all existing channels reach 80% capacity.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚜️SHOP[/b][/h3][p]🔸Fixed a bug where incorrect text would be displayed when selecting certain shop items.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚜️GAMEPLAY & COMBAT[/b][/h3][p]🔸Recommended levels for side quests in Storm’s End and Felwood regions have been adjusted based on the starting level of each chapter.[/p][p]🔸Interaction times for gadgets in repeatable RP-consuming content have been reduced for smoother gameplay.[/p][p]🔸Adjusted terrain in the Historic Site in Oldtown to allow for smoother movement via jumping.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where certain interactable objects in Historic Ruins could not be activated.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue in Altar of Memories - Shores of Dorne Blue Cockatrices where the second Cockatrice would not appear if the first was defeated too quickly.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where the recommended momentum for Echoes of the Past in the Stormlands were displayed incorrectly.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where the level 3 description for certain effects in Beyond the Wall Expedition displayed a value of 0%.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue in [b]Explore cliff paths[/b] in Beyond the Wall Expedition where the tree could not be cut down, preventing progress.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where the rewards pop-up would occasionally not display immediately after defeating a Ferocious Beast.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where using bait would sometimes fail to spawn a Ferocious Beast.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where dying to the Ferocious Beast Black Elk could sometimes cause players to spawn in the Stormlands.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where the Wormwalks rewards displayed on the results screen did not match the actual rewards received.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where the Bandit Camp in the Gift region could not be completed under certain conditions.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where Wormwalks rewards could not be acquired under certain conditions.[/p][p]    ✔️ The rewards that could not be acquired previously due to the above issue will be distributed sequentially after the update.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where certain class-specific equipment could be used by other classes.[/p][p]🔸The respawn rate of equipment chests in certain areas has been adjusted.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where certain treasures chests in Bandit Camps could not be opened. [/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where Ambition was occasionally consumed during Beyond the Wall Expedition. [/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where certain field content could not be cleared under certain conditions.  [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚜️QUESTS & NPCS[/b][/h3][p]🔸A prologue skip feature has been added.[/p][p]🔸Players can now jump directly to a Peddler’s location by using the shortcut button on the world map when they spawn.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where certain tutorial quests embedded in the main questline could not be progressed under certain conditions.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where monsters in certain quests in Brightwater Keep had lower-than-intended health values.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue in Storm’s End where selecting certain dialogue options triggered the wrong battle.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where the Peddler occasionally did not appear in Storm’s End.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚜️CONTROL & INPUT[/b][/h3][p]🔸After using fast travel, players will now be automatically placed on their mount.[/p][p]🔸Adjusted the location of the Mainhall Signpost in Renan’s Rest.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where ladders in certain areas occasionally could not be interacted with.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue in the Historic Site in Mole’s Town where the lever could not be activated.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where certain objects would appear when using the Search function in Castle Black, but were not actually present in the environment.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where certain structures within the Seven Sunset Septry Enemy Hideout could not be moved under certain conditions. [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚜️UI/UX & VISUALS[/b][/h3][p]🔸General UI and UX improvements have been made.[/p][p]🔸A new toggle helmet option has been added to the wardrobe for outfits that include helmets.[/p][p]🔸The equipment crafting UI now shows your Set Collection progress.[/p][p]🔸Terminology related to Relics has been standardized; all relevant items are now consistently referred to as [b]Artifacts[/b].[/p][p]🔸Fixed inconsistencies between dialogue text, subtitles, and voice lines during certain quests.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where a black screen could persist in some situations during cross-play between PC and mobile.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where random Jewelry effects were not displayed when viewing an offline character’s equipment.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where reconnecting to the game during a cutscene could occasionally result in a black screen and prevent further gameplay.[/p][p]    ✔️ If you continue to experience this issue after the update, please try reconnecting after waiting a few minutes (approximately 5 minutes) to allow the scene to reset properly.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where a black screen would occasionally occur during combat while progressing certain quests. [/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where a red dot notification would appear in Manor Management Office > Manage Trade even when there is nothing left to check. [/p][p]🔸Production information for individual workers has been improved to show the full range of output (minimum to maximum) per cycle, rather than only the minimum.[/p][p]🔸Crafting material item description tooltips now include information on which items they can be used to craft. [/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]We appreciate your continued support and feedback as we work to improve your experience in the game. As always, we remain committed to providing you with the best possible gameplay experience. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of our community!

notes.title: Developer Note | Season 1: The Drowned God Wakes
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/e0da14f614f65e3e0770ee76bc0b550e4b848fbe.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Hello, this is JANG, the Executive Producer of Game of Thrones: Kingsroad.[/b] 

 As we prepare for our next big step, we want to take a moment to recognize everyone who’s been with us along the journey. Since the earliest days of Early Access,[i] Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/i]has grown with the support of a passionate and dedicated community. More than a month after the official launch, the continued interest and thoughtful feedback remain a great source of encouragement for the team.

With Season 1 just around the corner, the team has been feeling a mix of excitement and pressure. We’re eager to finally share the content that’s been prepared, while also working hard to improve the overall quality and incorporate community feedback wherever possible. It’s been a busy and intense time for the entire team.

Following up on our previous developer note, where we introduced the core concept behind the upcoming season, today’s note will dive deeper by covering improvements made based on community input, an overview of how the season system works, and the current state of preparations. 

There’s a lot to look forward to as new adventures unfold with the season update.

Let’s get started.   [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h2][b]⚔️ UPDATE[/b]
[/h2][h3][b]1. Season Content[/b][/h3][p][b]Season 1: The Drowned God Wakes[/b] is on the horizon. 

This season introduces the Kraken, faithfully adapted from A Song of Ice and Fire lore as a massive, squid-like creature said to dwell in the far northern reaches of the Sunset Sea. It also serves as the sigil of House Greyjoy. 

Clearing seasonal content will advance Season Pass missions. As the pass level increases, players will unlock exclusive seasonal progression elements along the way.  

This unique progression system, which is only active during the season, encourages new builds and strategies each time. By stepping outside the boundaries of standard content loops, the season system offers a distinct and fresh path for standalone progression with every update.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]2. Seasonal Wormwalks & Beyond the Wall Expeditions[/b][/h3][p]In line with the new season structure, both Wormwalks and Beyond the Wall Expeditions will be reworked to integrate seasonal progression.

The existing “Wormwalk Challenges” will remain unchanged, while a brand-new, season-exclusive Seasonal Wormwalks mode will be introduced.

Both Seasonal Wormwalks and Seasonal Beyond the Wall Expeditions will feature season-exclusive progression elements, offering fresh growth mechanics and new gameplay experiences.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]3. New Artifacts[/b][/h3][p]Three new Artifacts will be added, including the legendary-grade Artifact [b]The Broken Sword[/b].[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][b]Grade[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Artifact[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Type[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Rare[/p][/td][td][p]Black Driftwood[/p][/td][td][p]Passive[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Epic[/p][/td][td][p]Marksman's Quiver[/p][/td][td][p]Active[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Legendary[/p][/td][td][p]The Broken Sword[/p][/td][td][p]Passive[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3][b]4. Seasonal Quests[/b][/h3][p]New quests will be added, set against the backdrop of the Iron Islands invasion and religious revelation, which serve as the central themes of the season. Additional quests tied to the lore of the new legendary Artifact [b]The Broken Sword[/b] will also be introduced.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]5. Crow’s Nest Region Expansion[/b][/h3][p]Following the official release, the first regional expansion will unfold in the heart of the Stormlands: [b]Crow’s Nest[/b].
[/p][p]This expansion weaves a complex and layered narrative of infiltration, psychological warfare, and political conflict, delivering the dark, grounded storytelling that defines [i]Game of Thrones[/i].

Griffin’s Roost has fallen into turmoil after Ronnet Connington pledged loyalty to Baratheon in King’s Landing, and the natural fortress has now been seized by traitorous mercenaries colluding with one of the Great Houses. Now, this battleground lies at the heart of the upcoming regional expansion.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/d244b0ba0d3f8a41c740adfb8ffa7b8dd553c942.jpg"][/img][/p][p]However, the truth surrounding Griffin’s Roost goes far beyond mere warfare.

Within its shadow, those who conceal ambition in silence, those who cling to the past, and those who have compromised for survival become the [b]key figures surrounding Griffin’s Roost[/b], each carrying their own beliefs and desires as they stand before the player’s choices.[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="128,"][tr][td colwidth="128"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/492d557a16ca6b9cfa8a541aa9ad92349ba4bc6b.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][b]Edgar Storm[/b][/p][p][i]“We will need every possible aid if we are to reclaim Griffin's Roost.”[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="128"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/f48b0445bc7690116555d41a0dd95f28fef9c1b1.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][b]Tyra Connington[/b][/p][p]“[i]It was only a matter of time before Stannis took the lands from me.[/i]”[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="128"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/bf7217784d5d4c456d70ce0004e81933bc374e74.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][b]Lester Morrigen[/b][/p][p]“[i]If Your Grace is to march anywhere, then Griffin's Roost must be reclaimed no matter the cost.[/i]”[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="128"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/92b96d9c41c7118f82c71aade9d2638cc8b1623a.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][b]Danilo[/b][/p][p]“[i]I don’t usually kill for free. So why this one, you ask? Because it sounds like fun.[/i]”[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p]The Crow’s Nest storyline marks the beginning of a campaign to suppress a rebellion, under direct orders from the King.[/p][p][/p][p]Stannis Baratheon dispatches the player to the battlefield to reclaim [b]Griffin’s Roost[/b], the stronghold of the traitorous Lord Ronnet Connington, who colluded with the remnants of House Lannister.[/p][p][/p][p]Though presented as a northern plea for aid, his true ambition is clear: [b]to bring order to the Stormlands and restore stability to the realm[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Now is the time to enter a tale of betrayal, political intrigue, and pivotal choices that will define the truth.[/b][/p][p] [/p][h3][b]6. Kraken Raid[/b][/h3][p]We previously introduced the Kraken Raid: Kraken in an earlier developer note. For this update, we’re excited to give a first glimpse of the Kraken in action with exclusive gameplay footage.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]▶️ Watch Kraken Raid Gameplay[/b][/p][previewyoutube="UJBlXPVP_Jo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Join forces with your party and face off against the massive Kraken, a formidable foe that will test your teamwork and strategy. Prepare for an epic battle unlike any other.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]7. Amulet System[/b][/h3][p]With the upcoming addition of the Kraken Raid, a new progression feature called the Amulet System will be introduced. Players will craft and upgrade Amulets using materials earned as rewards from the Kraken Raid. [/p][p][/p][p]This update will include three Amulet types across different rarities, and a new Amulet slot will be added to the equipment interface, allowing players to equip one Amulet at a time.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]8. World Boss[/b][/h3][p]We’re well aware that the current difficulty of World Boss Drogon is low, making it challenging for everyone to participate. With the upcoming Season 1 update, a new difficulty for the World Boss Drogon will be introduced in Crow’s Nest, our new region.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h2][b]⚜️ IMPROVEMENTS AND UPCOMING CONTENT[/b][/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]1. RP-Based Content Adjustments[/b][/h3][p]Since launch, many players have expressed concerns about the limitations caused by RP. To help alleviate this, both Altar of Memories and Beyond the Wall Expeditions will be updated to no longer require RP to claim rewards.[/p][p][/p][p]Instead, each activity will use its own independent reward count, and players will be able to claim rewards as long as they have remaining reward counts.[/p][p][/p][p]The upcoming Kraken Raid will follow the same structure, offering rewards based on a separate count without consuming RP.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]2. Momentum Penalty Removal[/b][/h3][p]The momentum penalty that was applied in battles based on momentum differences will be removed in the upcoming update.[/p][p][/p][p]This change is designed to give players greater flexibility when engaging enemies, even with lower momentum. With precise control and strategy, these encounters will become more approachable.[/p][p][/p][p]If there are any enemies you’ve been hesitant to challenge, this update will offer the perfect chance to face them head-on.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]3. Mobile UI & Controller Support[/b][/h3][p]There’s been a great deal of feedback regarding the mobile experience, particularly around the UI and controller support for players on mobile devices. Our team is currently conducting a comprehensive review of these areas, and long-term improvements are in the works. Specifically, we’re working on improving gamepad and controller functionality on mobile, and we’re also preparing for Steam Deck support among other various enhancements.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]4. Equipment[/b][/h3][p]We understand that the limited availability of Hardener items has made it challenging to customize equipment and jewelry effects to suit different playstyles. We are actively exploring long-term solutions to make these materials more accessible in the future. Additionally, we’re working to ease overall progression through improved content rewards and adjustments to the season pass, allowing for a wider range of flexible builds.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]5. Other Improvements[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]⮞ Set Collection Tracking in Equipment Crafting[/b][/p][p]Players currently need to switch between the Equipment Crafting and Collection menus to track their set collection progress. In the upcoming update, this information will be displayed directly within the Equipment Crafting UI.[/p][p][/p][p][b]⮞ Improved Mount Behavior for Fast Travel[/b][/p][p]To reduce friction during fast travel, players will automatically be mounted upon fast traveling, eliminating the need to manually mount again after moving to another destination.[/p][p][/p][p]⮞ [b]New Helmet-Inclusive Outfit Option[/b][/p][p]New outfits featuring helmets are planned for the update. When equipped, players will have the option to toggle the helmet’s visibility on or off.[/p][p][/p][p]⮞ [b]Tutorial Skip for Alternate Characters[/b][/p][p]To streamline progression for alternate characters, a tutorial skip option will be added, allowing players to bypass unnecessary steps when leveling new characters on the same account.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]That concludes today’s developer note.[/p][p][/p][p]We want to thank the community for all the valuable feedback and insights shared so far. The team carefully reviews all of it to ensure that player voices are heard and reflected in the ongoing development of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Season 1 has been designed to offer a fresh and engaging experience, delivering new challenges and opportunities for players to explore. We’re excited to see how the community embraces this next chapter.[/p][p][/p][p]Looking ahead, we remain committed to transparency and collaboration, and we’ll continue sharing updates on upcoming features, improvements, and plans in future developer notes.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being a part of this journey with us.[/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p][b]JANG[/b][/p][p]Executive Producer, Game of Thrones: Kingsroad
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Developer Note: What’s Next for Kingsroad
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/e0da14f614f65e3e0770ee76bc0b550e4b848fbe.gif[/img]

[b]Hello, this is JANG, the Executive Producer of Game of Thrones: Kingsroad.[/b]

We want to extend our sincerest gratitude to everyone who has joined us on this long journey—from our initial Early Access launch all the way to our official release.

Since launch, we've been closely listening to the invaluable feedback you've shared. Our development team has been working hard not only to resolve immediate issues, but also to shape the long-term direction of our post-launch updates.

Today, we’re excited to share the first details of what’s next: [b]Season 1[/b] is on the horizon.

This will be our first major post-launch update, bringing new content, storylines, and systems that mark the beginning of an ongoing seasonal experience. We’ll have more to share soon, including a full roadmap, but today’s note includes an early preview of what to expect.

Today’s update focused primarily on addressing key stability issues and major concerns identified after launch.

Now that the update is live, we wanted to use this opportunity to share with our players where things currently stand and give everyone a sneak peek at what’s coming next as we approach our next major update.


[h2][b][Improvements and New Content][/b][/h2]
 
[h3][b]1. Improved Patch Download Stability on Mobile Devices[/b][/h3]
We’ve made key improvements to address issues that were affecting patch file downloads on mobile devices. With this update, the download and installation process should now be significantly more stable and reliable. 

In addition, we’ve resolved several progression-blocking bugs that occurred during gameplay. These fixes should result in a smoother, more consistent experience for players on mobile platforms.

[h3][b]2. Character Appearance Change Feature[/b][/h3]
We’re excited to introduce a highly requested feature: the ability to change your character’s appearance.

Starting with the update on June 25th (PT), a new item—Character Appearance Change Coupon—will be added to the game. With this item, you’ll be able to freely customize both your character’s gender and appearance.

To celebrate the update, we’ll be giving all players a free Character Appearance Change Coupon—so you can jump back in and reimagine your character any way you like.

[h3][b]3. New Raid Content[/b][/h3]
Prepare for our first major content update: the [b]Kraken Raid[/b].

This new raid will be available on a weekly basis and won’t consume RP to participate. It’s designed to be a challenging new experience for players at all levels—and we can’t wait to see how you rise to the occasion.

[h2][b][Updates][/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/fabb4add42193f68b42051f35f1e342aa3f72983.png[/img]

[h3][b]1. Season 1: The Iron Islands and the Kraken[/b][/h3]
Our first major content update introduces a brand-new seasonal experience: [b]Season 1 – The Iron Islands and the Kraken[/b].

Brace yourselves! [b]Season 1: ‘The Iron Islands and the Kraken’[/b] is just around the corner, plunging you into the heart of an invasion sweeping in from across the sea. Get ready to forge a new saga with thrilling storylines and gameplay features designed to elevate your entire Westeros experience!

We’ll be introducing our new seasonal content across two developer notes.
In today’s update, we’re giving you an early look at the season’s story setup and the upcoming Kraken Raid.

[i][b]“The Salt Throne shall tremble.”[/b][/i]

Following a revelation from the Drowned Priests, many Ironborn have begun their advance towards the North. In the name of the Drowned God, they depart their isles, launching an invasion armed with the power of the sea and their indomitable iron will.

This season plunges you into the chaos unleashed from the Iron Islands, the North's desperate struggle to resist, and your own saga unfolding at the epicenter of the conflict.

[h3][b]2. The Kraken Raid: Challenge the Depths[/b][/h3]
In a previous dev note, we promised to introduce content that wouldn’t require RP to participate—and now it’s almost here.

Our first large-scale raid, [b]The Kraken Raid[/b], is set to make its debut.

[previewyoutube=i8LvJhVhN8Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Gather your allies! Journey through the Stormlands’ Altar of Memories to access the new raid dungeon.

A true terror has surfaced: off the coast of a remote Iron Islands isle, [b]a colossal Kraken[/b] has emerged from the ocean's abyss. This formidable beast poses a significant threat.

You'll need to team up with other skilled players to confront this massive creature. This new raid encounter is designed to test your group with:
[list]
[*] Unique environmental interactions.
[*] Challenging boss mechanics to decipher and overcome.
[*] Intense cooperative combat where smart strategies and tight teamwork are crucial for victory.
[/list]Face this challenging encounter weekly, with no RP cost to participate. Assemble your team and prepare to battle the Kraken!


[h2][b][Additional Information][/b][/h2]
 
[h3][b]1. Compensation for Artifact Expedition Adjustments[/b][/h3]
We’d like to take a moment to address the recent changes made to the Artifact Expedition system.

We’ve heard feedback from many of our Early Access players regarding concerns around fairness following the system update. Please know that your passion and dedication throughout the Early Access period have not gone unnoticed—and we remain deeply grateful for your support.

To ensure fairness under the newly adjusted system introduced after launch, we’ll be reviewing the total number of Artifact Cart items used during Early Access and provide compensation calibrated to what would have realistically been obtainable under the improved system.

This will require the development of new tracking and support features, so we ask for your patience as we work through this process. We’re aiming to have everything ready by June 12th, at which point we’ll follow up with more information outlining the eligibility criteria, compensation details, and distribution timeline.


[h3][b]2. Further Notice Regarding Recovery of Founder’s Packs[/b][/h3]
We’d also like to share an update on the unintended distribution of Founder’s Packs to accounts that had not purchased them. Although the initial recovery process has been completed, we’ve received considerable feedback concerning the absence of clear information regarding players who had already claimed the packs.

We are currently preparing an additional recovery operation for remaining accounts, and have been developing and testing new tools to ensure accurate retrieval of the affected items.

Once testing is complete, we’ll proceed with individually tracking and recovering any remaining misdelivered items. We’ll provide a follow-up notice once this process has been finalized.


That concludes today’s developer note.

We have a lot more to share about the next major update—so much, in fact, that we’ve split it across multiple notes. We’ll return soon with Part 2, where we’ll dive deeper into our upcoming seasonal content and more.

There are plenty of exciting reveals still to come. As mentioned in our last developer note, we’re also preparing a full update [b]roadmap[/b]—stay tuned!

Our team carefully reviews every piece of feedback shared across all our communities. We’re committed to delivering meaningful improvements and doing everything we can to make your experience in [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] as enjoyable as possible. While some changes may take time, we’ll continue pushing forward—and we appreciate your patience and continued support.

Sincerely,
[b]JANG[/b]
Executive Producer, Game of Thrones: Kingsroad

👉[url=https://forum.netmarble.com/got/view/12/66][b] [Game of Thrones: Kingsroad Official Forum][/b][/url]

notes.title: 6/3 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/661d50962b015bc14ff1bc13d0cadb05b0d26953.gif[/img]

Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team. 

Thank you for joining us on this epic journey with the official launch of [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i]. As we settle into this new era, our team is committed to ensuring a smooth and enjoyable experience for everyone.

This patch focuses on resolving a number of known issues and includes some quality-of-life improvements.

You can find the full list of changes below.

[b]1️⃣ [New Events]
2️⃣ [Adjustments & Bug Fixes] [/b]


[h2][b]🎊 NEW EVENTS[/b][/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536604072953774199][Go to Events][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/3183280/announcements/detail/536602812925083836?snr=2___][New Trial Race & Bonus Time Events][/url]


[h2][b]🛠️ ADJUSTMENTS & BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
 
[h3][b]⚜️ GENERAL[/b][/h3]
🔸Backend server optimizations have been implemented to improve overall stability.

[h3][b]⚖️ BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h3]
The Assassin class skill [Agile Movement] was previously causing an unintended large reduction to the enemy’s Daze gauge in a single hit. This issue has now been fixed with an appropriate adjustment to the skill.

🔸The Daze damage dealt by the enhanced evasion attack after using the Assassin’s [Agile Movement] skill has been adjusted.
🔸The Hitstun effect applied to enemies by the Assassin’s enhanced evasion attack after using [Agile Movement] has been removed.

[h3][b]⚔️ COMBAT & GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3]
🔸Fixed an issue where the associated Momentum did not increase accordingly when leveling up certain skills past a certain threshold.
🔸Fixed an issue where players were unable to move during the main quest [Travel to Last Hearth].
🔸Fixed an issue where using the escape function in Last Hearth’s Multi Space area caused characters to become stuck in terrain.
🔸Fixed an issue where attempting to create an Alliance with an already existing name would display a [Logic Error] message.
🔸Fixed an issue where resetting the Trait Tree under certain conditions could cause associated Skill Points to be lost.
▸ Lost Skill Points due to this issue will be sequentially returned after June 4, 01:00 AM (PT).
🔸Fixed an issue where RP would occasionally not recharge after logging out of the game for a period of time.
🔸Fixed an issue where Trading Routes for certain regions occasionally did not unlock despite meeting all conditions.
🔸Rewards obtained from defeating wildlife near the [Secluded Hut] Bandit Camp in the Stormlands have been changed.
🔸Fixed an issue where the Attack Speed Increase stat was not being applied properly.
🔸Fixed an issue where the Red Cockatrice’s attacks in the Altar of Memories dungeon did not apply the intended Attack Speed Decrease effect.
🔸Fixed an issue during Beyond the Wall Expedition where the Attack Speed Decrease effect based on the Cold Gauge was not applied.
🔸Fixed an issue in [Explore cliff paths] in Beyond the Wall Expedition where the tree could not be cut down, preventing progress.
🔸Fixed an issue in which [Bandit Camp in the Gift] could not be cleared under certain conditions.
🔸Adjusted the push notification frequency for Production, Trade, and Relic Expedition activities.
🔸Fixed an issue where the weekly mission [Defeat World Bosses] could not be cleared properly.
🔸Fixed an issue where the quest information was not displayed properly when reconnecting to the game in the World Boss Drogon area.
🔸Fixed a visual issue where the Boar Territory Signpost was not displayed in the Storm’s End Exploration Progress.
🔸Fixed an issue where players could not receive rewards upon clearing Wormwalks with a full inventory.

[h3][b]🛒 SHOP[/b][/h3]
🔸New items have been added to the shop.
🔸Fixed an issue where tapping on the Joffrey’s Outfit in the Suggested tab did not bring up the purchase pop-up.

[h3][b]⚜️ QUESTS & NPCS[/b][/h3]
🔸Fixed an issue where the stats for Elite enemies encountered during the side quest [Blood in the Water] in Storm’s End were incorrectly low.
🔸Fixed an issue preventing players from leaving the quest area during the main quest [Forbidden Knowledge].
🔸Fixed an issue where the Peddler would occasionally fail to appear in the Stormlands.
🔸Fixed an issue where the chest could not be interacted with during the Stormlands side quest [Nowhere to Return To].
🔸Fixed an issue where progress could be occasionally blocked during the main quest [Allies of the North].
🔸Fixed an issue where there was a delay in door interactions during the side quest [The Men of Kings and Queens].
🔸Fixed an issue where Elite Enemy kills were not being properly counted in certain Enemy Hideouts.
🔸Fixed an issue where players could occasionally get stuck in terrain, preventing them from moving during the main quest [Red Priest].
🔸Fixed an issue during the side quest [The Attack on Knifesbend] where a black screen would appear at the start of combat.
🔸Fixed an issue where the “Mount” icon would persistently be displayed under certain conditions during the main quest [Allies of the North].
🔸Fixed an issue where some servant NPCs had delayed movement during the main quest [Infiltrating the Keep].
🔸Fixed an issue where some dialogue was not displayed properly in certain side quests in the Stormlands.
🔸Fixed an issue where tutorial cutscenes would occasionally not play, preventing game progression.

[h3][b]📌 UI/UX & VISUAL[/b][/h3]
🔸Fixed an issue where certain enemy attack animations were not playing appropriately for the situation.
🔸Added an option to lower lighting effect quality in the graphics settings.
🔸Fixed an issue where some in-game text was displayed in an unintended language.
🔸Fixed an issue where the ranged attack cancel button was not visible on iOS devices.
🔸Fixed an issue where the effect for the [Violent Charge] skill was displayed even if no enemies were hit.
🔸Fixed an issue where the quantity of rewards acquired from defeating a Ferocious Beast was displayed incorrectly when receiving 2x rewards while the inventory was full.
▸ Please note that while the displayed number was incorrect, the correct amount of rewards was properly granted.
🔸Fixed an issue where the teleportation barrier would not appear during zone transitions in certain situations.
🔸Fixed an issue in Altar of Memories: Unicorn where the hands of players holding a lance were positioned awkwardly.
🔸Fixed an issue in Beyond the Wall Expedition where footprints were incorrectly placed during the blizzard stage.
🔸Fixed some awkward visual effects during the Ferocious Beast - Giant Bear encounter.
🔸Improved visibility on certain skill effects used by the Ferocious Beast - Infected Boar.
🔸Fixed an issue where certain tutorial overview entries were not displayed.
🔸Fixed an issue where Portuguese language settings would revert to an unintended language.
▸ Please note that this issue can now be fixed by downloading the new version of the game through your platform of choice after the update.
🔸Fixed an issue where owned equipment was not refreshed when entering the [Change Random Equipment Effects] menu after reforging a piece of equipment.
🔸The Emergency Escape button image has been changed for improved visibility.
🔸The images of [Intact/Good-quality Pelts] acquired upon defeating Ferocious Beasts have been changed for improved visibility.

 
We appreciate your continued support and feedback as we work to improve your experience in the game. As always, we remain committed to providing you with the best possible gameplay experience. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of our community!

notes.title: Game of Thrones: Kingsroad (PC) Review
notes.notes:
Game of Thrones has had a rocky past, with an incredible HBO series until the final few seasons, and the books looking like they’ll never be finished. Not to mention, we are seemingly getting spin-off after spin-off, trying to recapture that same cultural lightning in a bottle. But when you look at such a massive franchise, it’s strange how few of the games associated with it have really stood out.

There was the 2012 RPG by Cyanide that had some charm but ultimately felt clunky and limited. Telltale’s episodic Game of Thrones offered some strong writing but suffered from technical issues and pacing problems. For a world full of political intrigue, massive battles, and unforgettable characters, the game offerings have felt underwhelming. That is, until Game of Thrones: Kingsroad…with a few caveats.

Set around the events of Season 4, Kingsroad takes a more grounded and personal angle on the epic fantasy saga. You play as a bastard from House Tyre, a lesser-known Northern... Read more

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/661d50962b015bc14ff1bc13d0cadb05b0d26953.gif[/img]

Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team. 

The wait is over—[i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] is officially live!
Your journey through Westeros begins today.

For a comprehensive overview of new content and improvements introduced at launch, please refer to the May 19th Update Announcement below:
[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/3183280/announcements/detail/591771368562885884?snr=2___]👉 [5/19 Update Announcement][/url][/b]

In today’s update, we’ve also expanded language support and resolved several known issues to ensure a smoother gameplay experience for all.

Please see the details below.

[b][u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536602812925083833]1️⃣ [Improvements & Changes][/url][/u][/b]
[b][u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536602812925083833]2️⃣ [New Events][/url][/u][/b]
[b][u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536602812925083833]3️⃣ [Fixes & Improvements] [/url][/u][/b]


[b]▸ Click on each section to navigate to the corresponding content.[/b]
 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h3][b]📜 IMPROVEMENTS & CHANGES[/b][/h3]

[b]🌐 General [/b]
🔹 Portuguese and Turkish have been added as selectable language options. 

[b]⚔️ Combat[/b]
🔹 Aggressive wildlife enemies will now grant EXP upon defeat. 
✔️ Non-aggressive wildlife no longer grants EXP. 

[h3][b]🎉 NEW EVENTS[/b][/h3]
[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/3183280/announcements/detail/591771368562885858?snr=2___][Go to Events][/url][/b]

[h3][b]🛠️ FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3]

[b]⚜️ Combat & Gameplay [/b]
🔸 Fixed an issue where Tier 4 rewards for the Gift, the North, and Reach Exploration rewards could be claimed per character, despite being intended to be account-based.
✔️ To ensure fairness with newer players, Tier 4 rewards will be doubled compared to the previous amount.
✔️ If you claimed the Tier 4 reward before the May 19th update but didn't receive it on all your characters, the remaining unclaimed rewards will be distributed to those characters later.
🔸 Fixed an issue where World Boss: Drogon was spawning earlier that intended. 
🔸 Fixed an issue causing abnormal pathfinding during certain main quests. 
🔸 Fixed an issue where Trade rewards from before the update on May 19 could not be claimed under certain conditions. 
🔸 Fixed an issue where the Peddler would occasionally spawn multiple times under certain conditions. 
🔸 Fixed an issue that caused World Boss progress to reset in specific scenarios. 
🔸 Fixed an issue where defeating Ferocious Beasts occasionally did not complete the quest. 
🔸 Fixed an issue in which some Treasure Chests in Enemy Hideouts were not spawning according to their schedule. 
🔸 Fixed an issue where players could obtain certain Ferocious Beast items (Intact Boar Molar/Intact Wild Boar Fat/Intact Wild Boar Heart) in quantities exceeding the total required for exchanges. 
🔸Fixed an issue preventing players from re-entering the [b]Stormlands [/b]during quest progression after leaving the area, unless using a signpost.

[b]⚜️ Quests & NPCs[/b]
🔸 Fixed an issue where characters would occasionally fall through the terrain during certain main quests. 
🔸 Fixed an issue preventing progress in the Beyond the Wall Expedition tutorial upon reconnecting to the game. 
🔸 Fixed a visual issue where items were overlapping in the hands of certain NPCs in Occupied Sites. 

[b]⚜️ Controls & Input[/b]
🔸 Fixed an issue where hit animations for Infected Wolves were not visible during ranged attacks. 

[b]⚜️ UI/UX & Visual[/b]
🔸 The path display feature is now also accessible from the Options tab within the character creation screen. 
🔸 Fixed an issue where in-game text was not displayed correctly in certain content. 
🔸Fixed an issue where the component icons were not displayed in the product tab for Joffrey’s Outfit.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We’re committed to delivering the best possible experience as you begin your adventure across Westeros. From epic battles to political intrigue, countless challenges and rewards await—and this is only the beginning.

Thank you for joining us on this journey. We’ll continue listening, improving, and expanding the world of [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] together with you.

See you on the Kingsroad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Account Linking Guide for Cross-Platform Play
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif[/img]

Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team. 

Get ready to experience the full scope of Westeros wherever you go!

[i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] officially launches on May 21 (PT)—and with it comes full cross-platform support across PC (Steam, Epic Games, and more) and mobile (iOS and Android). Whether you’re strategizing on your mobile device or exploring Westeros from your desktop, your adventure can continue uninterrupted.

To enjoy a seamless experience across platforms, you’ll need to make sure your account is properly linked to a supported login method on each device. This ensures that your progress, purchases, and characters are accessible no matter where you play.

Check the steps below to link your account and prepare for launch.

[h3][b]☑️ Supported Account Linking Platforms
[/b][/h3]
🔹Netmarble ID
🔹Google
🔹Apple
🔹Facebook
🔹Steam
🔹Epic Games

▸ Please note that linking your account is required if you wish to play the game through the Steam or Epic Games platforms.

[h3][b]🔗 How to Link Your Account
[/b][/h3]

[b]1️⃣ In-Game
[/b]
🔹Launch the game and go to [b]Menu[/b] → [b]Options[/b] → [b]Info[/b] → [b]Account Linking[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/6986f7895e89ee5d7d2184d821b8f490212dd0b8.jpg[/img]

[b]2️⃣ Web [url=https://members.netmarble.com/auth/signin][Link][/url][/b]

🔹Log in to your account → [b]Manage Linked Accounts[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/e9081a9336900fbe5f77f0deb1b67f04b4d851fc.jpg[/img]

[b]💠 💻PC Play → 📱Mobile Play:
[/b]🔹 If you started playing Game of Thrones: Kingsroad on PC, your personal account for the platform you chose (Steam or Epic Games) will be automatically linked.
🔹 To continue playing with your existing in-game account information on mobile, you will need to link an additional login method that’s supported on mobile.
▸ Supported Mobile Platforms: Netmarble ID / Google / Apple / Facebook
 
[b]💠 📱Mobile Play → 💻PC Play:
[/b]🔹 If you started playing Game of Thrones: Kingsroad on mobile, you will need to link an additional account for the platform you wish to use on PC to play with your existing account.
▸ Playing through the Netmarble PC Launcher allows you to use the same platform linking information as your mobile account.
▸ If you start the game on PC without linking your mobile account, a new game account will be created under the login platform you use (Steam or Epic Games).


[h3][b]📌 Additional Notes on Account Linking[/b][/h3]
▸ Please double-check your account details before proceeding with any linking. We may not be able to assist with issues caused by user error during the linking process.
▸ If you lose access to a linked platform account other than your Netmarble ID (e.g. Google, Facebook), we will be unable to assist in retrieving your login credentials. In such cases, please directly contact the customer support service of the corresponding platform.

We encourage all players to complete their account linking in advance to enjoy a smooth cross-platform experience across PC and mobile.

Thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to seeing you in Westeros.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg[/img]
