notes.title: 5/19 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/661d50962b015bc14ff1bc13d0cadb05b0d26953.gif[/img]

Greetings, Lords and Ladies.

This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team.

As we count down to the global launch, we’re excited to bring our Early Access players a special update packed with new content.

Our May 19 update brings exciting new content and improvements to set the stage for the journey ahead:

🔹[b]New Region: The Stormlands[/b] – Explore a freshly unlocked area filled with new enemies, quests, and rewards.
🔹[b]Expanded Dungeon Challenges[/b] – Additional difficulty levels have been added across multiple dungeons—push your limits and reap the rewards.

To celebrate the upcoming official launch, we’ve also prepared a series of in-game events for everyone to enjoy.
We've also made several bug fixes and quality-of-life updates, many of which came directly from your feedback.

Check out the full patch notes below for all the details—and thank you for being part of the adventure from the very beginning.

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/591771368562885883]1️⃣ [New Content][/url][/b]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/591771368562885883]2️⃣ [Balance Adjustments][/url][/b]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/591771368562885883]3️⃣ [Improvements & Changes][/url][/b]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/591771368562885883]4️⃣ [New Events][/url][/b]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/591771368562885883]5️⃣ [Shop][/url][/b]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/591771368562885883]6️⃣ [Bug Fixes][/url][/b]

[b] ▸ Click on each section to navigate to the corresponding content.[/b]

 
[h2][b]🛡️ NEW CONTENT[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]⚔️ New Region: The Stormlands[/b][/h3]
🔹 The Stormlands have been added as a new explorable region.
🔹 New main story and side quests tied to the Stormlands are now available.
🔹 New content within the Stormlands include:
✔️ Ferocious Beast
✔️ Bandit Camps
✔️ Echoes of the Past
✔️ Historic Sites
✔️ Occupied Sites
✔️ Gods Haven
🔹 The Stormlands Token Exchange Shop has been added.
🔹 Exploration Gauge rewards are now available for the Stormlands.
🔹 11 new House Sigils have been added, specific to the Stormlands region.
🔹 2 New House Sigil Advancement boards have been added.
✔️ [Symmetry] House Sigil Advancement Board ➜ Available at the Stormlands Regional Currency Exchange Shop.
✔️ [Crown] House Sigil Advancement Board ➜ Available as a reward from the [Lord’s Virtue] event.
🔹 A new concoction [Herb Tea of Focus] and a new draught [Onslaught Draught] have been added.
🔹 With the addition of new Lost Letter collectibles in the Stormlands, new products have been added to the Tribute Exchange Shop accordingly.
🔹 Additional inventory expansion tools can be obtained in the Stormlands, allowing further inventory expansion.
✔️ Basic Inventory and Equipment Inventory available expansion limits have been increased by 1 stage. (Max: Stage 6 ➜ Stage 7)
✔️ HP Tincture max capacity expansion limits have been increased by 1 stage. (Max: Stage 4 ➜ Stage 5)

[h3][b]⚔️ Expanded Content Levels[/b][/h3]
🔹 Wormwalks has been expanded to Stage 40.
🔹 Beyond the Wall has been expanded to Stage 4.
🔹 A new Altar of Memories dungeon [Stormshower Plains Stormhorn Unicorn] has been added.

[h3][b]⚔️ Max Level Cap Expansion & New Equipment Tier[/b][/h3]
🔹 The level cap has been raised from 40 to 45.
✔️ The level requirement for certain achievements, previously set at level 50, have been lowered to level 45.
🔹 New achievements related to Momentum have been added.
🔹 With the addition of Tier 5 equipment, a new Set Collection is now available.
🔹 The maximum level of the Renan’s Rest Forge has been increased from Level 6 to Level 7 to accommodate the new equipment tier.
✔️ Upon reaching Estate Level 21, players can upgrade their Forge to Level 7, unlocking the ability to craft Tier 5 equipment.

[h3][b]⚔️ New Artifacts[/b][/h3]
🔹 Four new Artifacts have been added.
✔️ (1 Legendary, 1 Epic, 2 Uncommon)
✔️ The new Artifacts can be acquired from Artifact Expeditions.

[h3][b]⚔️ Emotes[/b][/h3]
🔹The emote system has been added.
▸ You can access emotes by selecting the emotes icon in the lower right corner of the chat window.
 
[h3][b]⚔️ Other New Additions[/b][/h3]
🔹 New achievements have been added, in relation to the Stormlands, the Unicorn, and Drogon.
🔹 Set Research levels have been expanded. (40 ➜ 45)
🔹 A Stage 5 Exploration Gauge reward has been added for the Gift.


[h2][b]⚖️ BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]⚜️ General[/b][/h3]
🔸 The maximum limit for natural HP regeneration when not in combat has been adjusted. (40% ➜ 100%)
🔸 The interval for natural HP regeneration when not in combat has been adjusted. (Every 3 seconds after transitioning to a non-combat state ➜ Every 1.2 seconds after transitioning to a non-combat state)
🔸 HP Tincture effectiveness has been increased. (35% of Max HP ➜ 40% of Max HP)
🔸 [Quick Dodge] now consumes fewer dodge stacks upon use. (2 stacks ➜ 1 stack)
🔸 The recovery time for dodge stacks has been adjusted. (Recovers 1 stack every 7.5 seconds ➜ 5 seconds)
🔸 The base amount of HP Tinctures you can carry has been increased. (4 ➜ 6)
🔸 The base amount of projectiles you can carry has been increased. (4 ➜ 6)
🔸 Interacting with HP Tincture Supply Chests in the field now grants an immediate HP recovery effect.
🔸 Additional spawn locations for HP Tincture Supply Chests have been added in the field.

[h3][b]⚜️ Sellsword[/b][/h3]
🔸 The duration of the [Destruction] effect has been increased. (10 seconds ➜ 12 seconds)
🔸 The Destruction effect now grants an additional attack speed increase while active. (Upon applying Destruction, gain +5% attack speed for 8 seconds)
🔸 The targeting logic for the [Violent Charge] skill has been improved.

[h3][b]⚜️ Knight[/b][/h3]
🔸 The amount of Valor stacks required to convert to [Fighting Spirit] have been reduced. (8 ➜ 6)
🔸 The Rage consumption decrease rate per Valor stack has been adjusted. (1.5% ➜ 2%)

[h3][b]⚜️ Assassin[/b][/h3]
🔸 The maximum stack count for Bloodburst has been adjusted. (12 ➜ 8)
🔸 The damage per Bloodburst stack has been adjusted. (3,000 - 36,000 ➜ 4,500 - 36,000)
🔸 The Refinement Effects for the Artifact [Rhaegar's Ruby] have been changed to reflect the maximum Bloodburst stack adjustment.
✔️ Refinement Effect 5: Daze damage per Bloodburst stack has been changed.
✔️ Refinement Effect 7: The increase in damage taken per Bloodburst stack has been changed. (2.5 ➜ 4)
🔸 The damage dealt by the poison debuff applied by the [Poison] skill has been decreased. (Minimum damage 8,000 ➜ 5,500)
🔸 An effect that increases Daze damage taken by poisoned enemies has been added. (4% increase, up to 5 stacks)

[h3][b]⚜️ Traits[/b][/h3]

[b]🔸Ferocious Strike[/b]
✔️ Strike Combo damage has been adjusted. (15% ➜ 12%)
✔️ The Attack Power increase and duration gained upon landing a Strike Combo have been adjusted. (1.5% ➜ 1.8%, 15 seconds ➜ 5 seconds)
✔️ The Life Steal rate applied at maximum stacks has been adjusted. (5% ➜ 1.2%)

[b]🔸 Heat of the Battlefield[/b]
✔️ The damage increase for Rage consuming skills has been adjusted. (12.5% ➜ 15%)
✔️ The Rage Recovery during combat has been adjusted. (1 per second ➜ 3 per second)

[b]🔸 Endless Battle[/b]
✔️ Critical Strike Damage has been increased. (15% ➜ 17.5%)
✔️ The Critical Strike Rate gained for 5 seconds upon landing an attack has been increased. (1% ➜ 1.5%)
✔️ The additional Critical Strike Damage gained at maximum stacks has been increased. (20% ➜ 25%)

[h3][b]⚜️ Draughts[/b][/h3]
🔸 The Critical Strike Damage Increase value of the [Force Draught] has been adjusted. (100% ➜ 35%)
🔸 The damage increase against Human enemies and damage reduction from Human enemies provided by the [Executioner's Venom Ointment] have been adjusted. (30% ➜ 8%)
🔸 The damage increase against Beast enemies and damage reduction from Beast enemies provided by the [Beast Venom Ointment] have been adjusted. (30% ➜ 8%)
🔸 The damage increase against Wight enemies and damage reduction from Wight enemies provided by the [Obsidian Venom Ointment] have been adjusted. (30% ➜ 8%)
🔸 The duration of concoctions has been increased (5 minutes ➜ 30 minutes). Accordingly, their crafting recipes and vendor prices have been adjusted.
🔸 The cooldown after using a concoction has been reduced. ( 30 minutes ➜ 5 minutes)
 

[h2][b]📜 IMPROVEMENTS & CHANGES[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]🗡️ General[/b][/h3]
🔹 The Pathfinding feature is now available on PC.
🔹Certain areas within Castle Black and Last Hearth have been converted to multi-instance zones.
🔹 Only the highest-level character within an account will now be displayed for overall class Momentum/Level rankings.
🔹 New signposts have been added, and the locations of some existing signposts have been adjusted.
🔹 The clear time ranking rewards for Altar of Memories and Beyond the Wall Expedition will now be partially increased based on the difficulty level.
✔️ While rewards for lower-tier rankings have been decreased, the highest rewards have been increased.
🔹 The [Spend RP] daily mission requirement has been reduced from 120 to 80.
🔹 A new Path Display feature has been added, that visually shows your movement route when setting a destination.
✔️ This feature is available on both PC and mobile and can be toggled on/off in the game options. 
✔️ Please note that this feature is currently in Beta, and some display functions may not fully be optimized yet.

[h3][b]🗡️ Currency[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]🏹 Copper[/b][/h3]
🔹 The amount of Copper acquired from completing repeatable content has been increased.
✔️ The amount of Copper obtainable as rewards for weekly mission stages has been increased, and some rewards have been changed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/83b0106775b2f3338c7749d96c298072dc9805b2.jpg[/img]

✔️ Copper rewards for Bandit Camps, Enemy Hideouts, Ferocious Beasts, Echoes of the Past, Altars of Memories, and Beyond the Wall Expeditions have been increased.
✔️ Enemy Hideout reward chests now have a chance to drop equipment fragments.
✔️ Copper rewards from Enemy Hideout reward chests have been increased.
🔹 The amount of Copper obtained from selling Rare Jewelry has been increased.
🔹 Characters below level 14 can now revive without any cost.
🔹 All common goods icons now display a Copper mark.
🔹 Items marked with the Copper icon will be included when using the [Sell Goods] feature at merchants and are meant to be sold for Copper. 

[h3] [b]🗡️  Ferocious Beasts[/b][/h3]
🔹 [Pelt Scrap] items can now be obtained upon defeating a Ferocious Beast.
✔️ Upon defeating Ferocious Beasts, you now have a chance to obtain one of the following: Intact Pelt Scrap, Good-quality Pelt Scrap, Intact Pelt, Good-quality Pelt.
✔️ Intact/Good-quality Pelt Scraps can be exchanged for Intact/Good-quality Pelt items with Ferocious Beast Maesters.

[h3][b]🗡️  Production[/b][/h3]
🔹 Worker production abilities have been changed.
🔹 The cost per production cycle for workers has been reduced, and their rewards have been increased. (Also  applies to workers that are already currently hired)
🔹 The production items for some workers have been changed.
🔹 The number of available worker slots has been increased based on your Manor Management Office level.

[h3][b]🗡️ Trade[/b][/h3]
🔹 New trade offers are now available, replacing all previous ones.
🔹 With the exception of Whale Oil, trade goods will no longer be used as items you offer in trades. Instead, they can now be sold for Copper.
🔹 The amount of Copper obtained when selling all trade goods at merchants has been significantly increased.
🔹 Any original trade goods you possessed have been converted into common goods items.
✔️ We recommend selling these items, as they no longer have any use other than being sold.
🔹 New items [Candlesticks] and existing common goods items from Artifact Expeditions such as [Silver Spoon] and [Porcelain Doll], along with common goods from Ferocious Beasts, will now appear as trade items.
🔹  Trade slots will now be provided it at lower Manor Management Office levels.

[h3][b] 🗡️  Artifacts[/b][/h3]
🔹 Legendary Artifacts are now guaranteed from Expeditions after a certain number of attempts.
✔️ The Artifact Expedition UI will now display the "Legendary Artifact Drop Rate" instead of "Incredible Expedition" chances. (While this number might appear lower than the previous "Incredible Expedition” chances, which included Legendary + Epic Artifacts, the actual overall chance of acquiring Legendary Artifacts has been slightly increased.)
✔️ As the guaranteed expedition result has been adjusted from Epic - Legendary to a guaranteed Legendary, the way worker stats boost artifact acquisition rates has been rebalanced.
🔹 Overall chances of obtaining Epic to Legendary Artifacts during Artifact Expeditions has been increased.
✔️ The increase is even more significant for lower Expedition levels.
🔹 The number of required Expeditions for a guaranteed Artifact Expedition has been reduced.
🔹 The number of required Expeditions to level up your Artifact Expeditions at lower levels has been reduced.
🔹 The sell price of common goods items obtained as Artifact Expedition rewards has been increased. (This includes Abandoned Tools, Silver Spoons, and Porcelain Dolls.)

[h3][b]📢 Retroactive Adjustment for Guaranteed Rewards[/b][/h3]
🔹 Since the required number of Expeditions for guaranteed Legendary Artifact rewards is reduced, any excess progress you've already made will be applied retroactively.
🔹For example:
✔️ Previously, the guaranteed reward required 120 Expeditions, for which you had already completed 110 Expeditions (10 remaining)
✔️ After the update, the requirement is reduced to 90.
🔹Your progress is now shown as -20 remaining, since you’ve already exceeded the new requirement.
🔹Once you run just one more Expedition, you will immediately receive the guaranteed reward.
🔹After receiving the reward, your counter continues from the surplus you had—20 extra + 1 new run = 21 completed toward the next guaranteed drop (which now requires 90 again), so your new remaining count will be 69.

[h3][b]✅ No progress is lost in this change.[/b][/h3]
Please note that while the remaining count may appear negative in some cases, this is a visual side effect of preserving your extra progress—it does not mean you are missing out on any rewards.

We appreciate your understanding!

[h3][b]🗡️ Combat[/b][/h3]
🔹 The difficulty in combat and certain quests in early-game areas has been adjusted.
🔹 The difficulty of some bosses encountered during the main questline has been reduced.
🔹 Mounts will no longer be visible upon entering Echoes of the Past.
🔹 Certain enemies in the Dreadfort region now drop consumables upon defeat.
🔹 The Beyond the Expedition buff has been reduced from 5 stages to 3 stages, and the effect of each stage has been adjusted accordingly.
 

[b][h3][b]🎊 NEW EVENTS[/b][/h3]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/3183280/announcements/detail/591771368562885858][Go to Events][/url][/b]

[h3][b]🛒 SHOP[/b][/h3]
🔸 New items have been added. Please check the in-game shop for more details.
🔸 11 new Stormland House Sigils have been added to the Uncommon - Epic Sigil Box.
✔️ Purchase limits for House Sigil Box Bundles have been reset.
🔸 Stormlands House Sigils have been added to the item pool of Random House Sigil Boxes purchaseable from the exchange shop.
✔️ Purchase limits for the items in question have also been reset.
🔸 New Epic Artifacts have been added to the Epic Artifact Selection Box.
✔️ Purchase limits for the box in question have been reset, and the purchase count has been changed from 2 to 1.
🔸 The Rare - Legendary Jewelry Box has been removed from the Royal Favor Exchange Shop, and the Uncommon - Epic Jewelry Box / Epic - Legendary Jewelry Box have been added instead.
🔸 The conditions and durations of some conditional pop-up products have been adjusted.
✔️ Some packs may reappear, and they will be available for repurchase even if you previously purchased them.
🔸 [Crude Equipment Fragment] items have been added to the Alliance Shop.
🔸 The maximum purchase period for House Tyre Monthly Subscription has been changed from 5 years to 3 years.
✔️  If you have already purchased it beyond 3 years, your purchase duration will remain unchanged.
🔸 With the addition of a new equipment tier, relevant items have been added to various exchange shops:
✔️ Alliance Token Exchange Shop: Added Exceptional Equipment Fragments
✔️ North/Reach Regional Currency Exchange Shop: Added Exceptional Equipment Selection Box
🔸 The price of Rare Jewelry (Random) in the North/Reach Regional Currency Exchange Shop has been adjusted.

[h2][b]🛠️ FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]⚜️ General[/b][/h3]
🔸 Backend server optimizations have been implemented to improve overall stability.

[h3][b]⚜️ Combat & Gameplay[/b][/h3]
🔸 When using the [Ignite Weapon+] and [Poison+] skills, nearby enemies will now be hitstunned.
🔸 A feature to individually reset Skill Mastery nodes has been added.
🔸 The locked chest in the Bandit Camp in Winterfell can now be opened without a key. Existing keys can now be sold or discarded.
🔸 Fixed an issue in Echoes of the Past where using Dodge skills while stunned would prevent movement.
🔸 Fixed an issue where skills couldn’t be canceled in Wormwalks under certain conditions.
🔸 Fixed an issue where Beyond the Wall Expedition occasionally couldn’t be started.
🔸 Fixed an issue where characters could fall under the terrain when hit under certain conditions.
🔸 Several skill and buff/debuff descriptions have been revised or clarified.
🔸 Fixed an issue where the visual effects and damage application range of some enemy projectile attacks did not match.
🔸 Fixed an issue where additional rewards obtained with a Repeat Expedition Certificate after clearing Altar of Memories were not displayed in the final results window.
🔸 Fixed an issue where the Trait Activation button would sometimes appear even when there were insufficient Trait Points.
🔸 Fixed an issue where the Assassin class’ Strike Combo Mastery level 4 HP Recovery effect would sometimes trigger even when the attack did not hit the enemy.
🔸 Fixed an issue where the attack and defense increase rates of the Night’s Watch buff in [Beyond the Wall Expedition] were displayed incorrectly.
🔸 Mobs that spawn in Brightwater Keep resurrection areas have been adjusted.
🔸 Fixed an issue where Lost Letter notifications still appeared upon playing with a different character even after the related Tribute had already been acquired.
🔸 The knockback effect upon being hit by an enemy using a two-handed sword has been removed.
🔸 Certain pathfinding routes have been adjusted.
🔸 The remaining stamina recovery time for hired workers is now displayed, and workers will now recover stamina even if rewards from Production/Trade/Artifact Expedition tasks have not been collected.
🔸 The respawn cycle of some equipment chests in the field have been adjusted.
🔸 Fixed an issue where mounts couldn’t be unmounted in under certain conditions.
🔸 Fixed an issue where some equipment set effects were occasionally not applied correctly.
🔸 Hunters near Ferocious Beasts now only craft bait specific to each beast.
🔸 The Assassin class’ control movement has been improved.
🔸 Using a Legendary Active Artifact skill will now also stun nearby enemies.

[h3][b]⚜️ Quest & NPC[/b][/h3]
🔸 Fixed an issue where certain quests or encounters could not progress under certain conditions.
🔸 Fixed an issue where the Peddler notification would sometimes indicate a different location than their actual position.
🔸 Fixed some awkward appearances or animations of certain NPCs.
🔸 Fixed an issue where the screen would flicker when teleporting during main quest progression.
🔸 Fixed an issue where the quest objective marker would flicker.
🔸 Fixed an issue where mount speed was restricted under certain situations during some quests.
🔸 The reward acquisition methods for some quests have been changed.
🔸 Fixed an issue where items with no remaining duration were not being removed from the Scavenger’s reward list.

[h3][b]⚜️ Control & Input[/b][/h3]
🔸 Fixed some awkward character animations, such as movement and skill usage.
🔸 Fixed an issue where movement to some inaccessible areas was possible.
🔸 Fixed an issue where doors that had already been interacted with would still be highlighted when using the search function.
🔸 The location of some gatherable resources have been adjusted, and the interaction range for these resources has been improved.
🔸 Fixed an issue where some hidden elements that should not be visible were being detected from a long distance when using the search function.
🔸 Fixed an intermittent issue where equipment shortcut keys would not work during combat.

[h3][b]⚜️ UI/UX & Visual[/b][/h3]
🔸 Various UI/UX improvements have been made.
🔸 Some in-game typos have been corrected.
🔸 Fixed an issue where some in-game names, dialogue, etc., would be displayed in the wrong language.
🔸 A dedicated tab for quest items has been added to the inventory.
🔸 Each Alliance member’s offline time will now only be visible to the Alliance Leader and Captain.
🔸 Your Estate (Renan’s Rest) has been added to Key Locations within the world map.
🔸 Fixed an issue where some terrain objects were not positioned correctly.
🔸 Markers will now be displayed above undiscovered signposts.
🔸 Loading screen images and tips will now be displayed when teleporting throughout the world.
🔸 Upon equipping House Sigils on Advancement Boards, they will now be sorted based on their Momentum, which fluctuates according to whether they are friendly or hostile.
🔸 Fixed an issue where the default skin color would be displayed upon dying outfits.
🔸 Fixed an issue where the screen would rotate excessively when the camera was locked on and the distance to the enemy was too close.
🔸 Fixed an issue where the background would not be displayed when clicking the Options icon in the character selection screen.
🔸 Fixed an issue where World Map favorites would disappear under certain conditions.
🔸 Fixed an issue where buttons would sometimes not function correctly when using a game controller under certain conditions.
🔸 Fixed an issue where the minimum expected value for Artifact Restoration would also be displayed as 100% if the actual expected maximum exceeded 100%.
🔸 Fixed a visual issue where multiple equipment options appeared selectable from an Equipment Selection Box.
🔸 Fixed incorrect text shown in the quest window after reconnecting in the World Boss zone.
🔸 Fixed an issue where players could access the Artifact Expedition tab via content notifications even without purchasing the Mail Crow item.


We remain committed to ensuring your journey through Westeros is as rewarding and engaging as possible. Every update, adjustment, and addition is made with the goal of creating a better gameplay experience for all adventurers—whether you're just starting out or already deep into your conquest.

Thank you for your continued passion and support.
We’ll keep working to make Game of Thrones: Kingsroad a world worth returning to.

notes.title: Developer Note: From Early Access to Official Launch
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/e0da14f614f65e3e0770ee76bc0b550e4b848fbe.gif[/img]

[b]Hello, this is JANG, the Executive Producer of Game of Thrones: Kingsroad.[/b]

The official launch is just around the corner! With less than a week to go, the whole team is buzzing with excitement and a touch of nerves after all the hard work we’ve poured in.

We truly appreciate everyone who has been waiting patiently for the official release, and we hope you’ll continue to show your support as we head into launch.

With the official release so close, we know many of you are curious about what kind of updates to expect.

So today, we’d like to take a moment to share more details about the upcoming launch update—along with a deeper look at some of the topics we touched on during our recent AMA.

First and foremost, Early Access exclusive packages on Steam will no longer be available for purchase as of May 21st. With the official launch, [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] will be free to play for everyone.

If you haven’t had a chance to experience the game yet, this will be the perfect opportunity to begin your adventure across the vast continent of Westeros.

Furthermore, we extend our deepest gratitude to all of our Early Access players who have been with us since March. Your support has been instrumental in reaching this milese of our official launch. We’re excited to keep building this story together, and we hope you’ll continue to follow along as it unfolds.

Throughout the Early Access period, we have carefully listened to your valuable feedback, and we aim to implement many improvements based on your suggestions in the official launch and upcoming updates. We remain committed to fostering an open dialogue with our community and will continue to listen as the game evolves.

Lastly, as a token of our appreciation, we’ve prepared a special gift for everyone who joined us during Early Access—you’ll find the details at the end of this developer note, so be sure to read through to the end!

[h2][b]1. Region Expansion: The Stormlands[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/09f423fd524d1098a644f9474a28d81334bcd724.jpg[/img]

The centerpiece of our official release is the regional expansion into the Stormlands.

This marks the beginning of a significant new chapter, as the threat of the White Walkers looms large and the protagonist ventures into this new area on a desperate quest for answers. There, you will face new and formidable threats, including a mysterious plague and the zealous Red Priests of R’hllor.

Prepare to explore entirely new territories, unravel captivating storylines, and unearth a wealth of new content that awaits in this iconic region of Westeros. We can’t wait for you to experience the adventures that lie ahead.


[h2][b]2. Progression Expansion[/b][/h2]

With the new region comes the opportunity for your characters to grow even stronger. Brace yourselves for thrilling encounters with ferocious new beasts and formidable enemies that surpass any you've faced thus far. To meet these challenges, your characters will have a chance to reach new heights of power.

We’re raising the maximum character level from 40 to 45, introducing higher-tier equipment to discover and craft, expanding set research levels, and adding new House Sigils to further customize your forces.

Furthermore, we’re adding new difficulty levels to existing content such as Wormwalk and Beyond the Wall Expedition for those seeking to truly test their limits. Prepare to push your characters to their absolute potential.

[h2][b]3. New Altar of Memories Boss[/b][/h2]

A new trial awaits within the Altar of Memories.

Whispers carried on the northern winds speak of elusive Unicorns, creatures of myth said to roam the wild and isolated island of Skagos, far beyond the Wall's icy reach. Now, one of these creatures will manifest as a formidable new boss, testing your strategic prowess and the strength of your characters in unprecedented ways.

We're thrilled to offer you a first glimpse of the Unicorn before the update goes live:


[h2][b]4. Official Launch Events[/b][/h2]

In celebration of the official launch of Game of Thrones: Kingsroad, we're rolling out a series of engaging in-game events!

We're happy to announce the return of fan-favorite Test Race and Bonus Time events from Early Access. These will be back on a weekly rotation with a variety of formats designed to keep the fun going and the rewards flowing.

Get a first look at the schedule for the returning Test Race and Bonus Time events following the official release:

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/8febb045b6d4ffff9c475b9e8df57ed5a8c60502.png[/img]
* Please note that the event schedule provided above is subject to change.

Popular events like Bonus Time will continue to run regularly, and we're actively developing new formats to bring you even more engaging and rewarding experiences. We're also preparing a variety of special events to celebrate the official launch—so stay tuned!


[h2][b]5. Improvements[/b][/h2]

Next, we’d like to delve into some of the specific improvements and refinements we’ve been working on, many of which were discussed during our previous AMA session.

[h3][b]🔸Copper Economy Improvements[/b][/h3]

One of the most frequently raised topics—and the first we’d like to address—is the state of our in-game currency economy. In particular, the scarcity of Copper has been a significant point of feedback, and we're committed to addressing this directly with two key changes in the official release update.

First, we will be [b]implementing an overall increase to the Copper rewards across repeatable content[/b].

Building upon this, we're also significantly boosting the Copper payouts in specific content. This will allow you to strategically focus on certain activities if Copper acquisition is your priority, making Copper farming a more viable and rewarding endeavor.

Second, as we discussed in our previous AMA, we will be[b] improving the efficiency of the Production & Trade systems[/b].

While some players made good use of these systems during Early Access, we observed that overall engagement remained low—largely due to underwhelming returns and a lack of compelling synergy between the production and trade mechanics.

This isn't just a minor adjustment of numbers. Our goal is to forge a meaningful and rewarding gameplay cycle between Production and Trade, making these systems a worthwhile investment of your time and resources.

To achieve this, we’ll be reducing the Copper cost of production, increasing the rewards you can earn, and boosting the overall trade efficiency.

With these comprehensive changes, developing your Renan’s Rest Estate will evolve into a much more dependable and consistent source of Copper, directly benefiting your long-term progression.


[h3][b]🔸Artifact System[/b][/h3] 

Next, let's delve into the upcoming enhancements to the Artifact system. We've carefully considered the significant feedback we received during Early Access and are implementing meaningful changes based on your experiences.

Our initial vision for the "Incredible Expedition" outcome was to provide a reliable opportunity to acquire Legendary Artifacts, even if they were alongside Epic-grade rewards. We designed the system with the intention that the probability of a Legendary find would feel reasonable, especially at higher Expedition levels.

However, your feedback, coupled with our internal data analysis, revealed a clear disconnect between our design and your actual experience. Many of you felt that obtaining Legendary Artifacts remained frustratingly difficult, even with consistent participation in Expeditions.

To directly address this, we've made two key decisions:

Firstly, any guaranteed Artifact Expedition result achieved after a set number of attempts[b] will now always reward you with a Legendary-grade Artifact[/b].

Secondly, we're[b] reducing the number of Expeditions required to reach this guaranteed Legendary reward[/b].

In addition to these changes, we're also slightly increasing the overall drop rates for Epic and Legendary Artifacts during Expeditions, with a more substantial increase at lower Expedition levels. Our overarching goal with these adjustments is to create a more positive and rewarding Artifact experience overall.

We also recognize that these significant changes might not feel entirely fair to those who have already invested heavily in Artifact Expeditions under the previous system. To address this, we will be providing Expedition Cart items as compensation, based on your current Artifact Expedition level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/fcaab8de79da1b5d73b8c580c4f515422b3c5ff0.png[/img]

▸ Compensation will be granted based on the highest Artifact Expedition level within your account.
▸ The level used to determine the compensation will be based on your level at the time of the official release, on May 21st.
▸ More details regarding the distribution will be provided in a future announcement.


[h3][b]🔸Ferocious Beasts[/b][/h3]
 
When we first envisioned the Ferocious Beasts encounters, our design aimed to offer a distinct experience compared to the Altar of Memories. While the Altar of Memories was structured around co-op play with guaranteed rewards after a certain number of victories, Ferocious Beasts were intended as solo challenges with randomized loot instead.

However, we’ve seen that this lack of guaranteed rewards in Ferocious Beasts encounters has led to long-term frustration—especially for players who go extended periods without receiving the rewards they’re after.

To directly address this feedback, we're introducing a new system in the official release update. This will allow you to exchange accumulated resources earned from defeating Ferocious Beasts for guaranteed rewards after a set number of victories.

Going forward, each Ferocious Beast you defeat will grant you a new item – Pelt Scrap (name subject to change). By collecting a specific quantity of these Pelt Scraps, you'll be able to trade them for the core rewards associated with each Ferocious Beast.

Our goal with this change is to provide a more dependable path to obtaining the rewards you're seeking, while still preserving the inherent challenge and satisfaction of overcoming these powerful creatures.

[b]➤ Bear Pelt Scrap (Example)[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/7fd062442c06bcb495054301700568905762ee71.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5b896c454df476775d13c70649c5615eca181911.png[/img][/url]

[h3][b]🔸Class Balance[/b][/h3]
 
With the official release update, we will also be implementing some small-scale balance adjustments.

Our primary goal is to cultivate a dynamic combat environment where each class's unique passives—such as Fighting Spirit and Sanguine Crush—become more integral to your active strategies in battle. You'll find the comprehensive details of these specific changes outlined in the upcoming official release patch notes.

Looking beyond launch, we remain committed to the ongoing refinement of class balance through iterative updates. Our aim is to ensure that each class feels distinct, offers a rewarding playstyle, and remains a viable and compelling choice throughout your entire adventure.

[h3][b]🔸Difficulty Adjustments[/b][/h3]

Throughout Early Access, the development team has been closely monitoring quest-related death rates and the overall difficulty curve of enemies encountered in the main storyline.

Some bosses—like the Giant—already received their first balance adjustment during Early Access, based on player feedback and data. As we approach the official release, we're committed to further smoothing out any difficulty spikes in battles that might feel overly abrupt or punishing.

In addition to these general adjustments, we also conducted thorough mobile testing during Early Access, carefully reviewing play patterns and quest success rates on mobile devices. Our findings indicated that a higher percentage of mobile players experienced difficulties in the earlier main quests compared to PC, with combat encounters showing a noticeably lower success rate.

To ensure a smoother progression through the main quest for all players, we’ve identified the need for further difficulty adjustments. To this end, we plan to increase the base maximum capacity for HP Tinctures and projectiles, and we're also making HP Tinctures more readily available during combat situations. Furthermore, we'll be improving the health regeneration rate outside of combat to enhance your overall gameplay experience. 

Beyond these changes, we are also reducing the cooldown time for dodge stacks and decreasing the stack cost per dodge, aiming to provide a more fluid and responsive combat experience.

Moving forward, we will continue to actively analyze gameplay data, including death rates and challenging sections, and make ongoing adjustments to difficulty levels and boss patterns to ensure a balanced and engaging experience for all players.

 
[h3][b]🔸Regional Currency[/b][/h3]
 
We’ve observed that some players who have completed all current content available in Early Access are intentionally farming North Tokens by replaying lower-level content in the region of the North to further strengthen their characters.

We understand the motivation behind this, and for future updates, we're actively exploring ways that will allow you to earn North Tokens through engaging with higher-level content as well. This means you won't feel compelled to return to lower-level zones solely for currency acquisition. While this improvement won't be part of the official release, it's something we plan to introduce in a subsequent update.
 

[h3][b]🔸Appearance Change[/b][/h3]
 
Next up, we're thrilled to finally address a feature that has been highly requested by our community:  the ability to change your character's appearance.

We’re planning to introduce a ticket that will allow you to modify various character customization options—including facial features, hairstyle, and even gender.

This feature won’t be available at the time of the official release, but we’re aiming to release it in an update scheduled for June. More details will be shared through a future announcement.


[h3][b]🔸Pathfinding System[/b][/h3]
 
During the Early Access phase, we focused on enhancing the mobile experience and introduced an intuitive pathfinding system. This feature allows your character to automatically navigate towards a designated point on the map while mounted, significantly streamlining travel and exploration for our mobile players.

The positive reception and substantial convenience improvements observed during mobile testing have reinforced our commitment to providing a smooth and enjoyable experience across all platforms. Therefore, we are excited to announce that the pathfinding system will also be integrated into the PC version of the game.

Looking ahead, we're also actively developing further enhancements to the mounted experience. Our goal is to provide greater freedom and accessibility while traversing the world. To that end, we're implementing functionality that will allow you to seamlessly perform various actions–such as accessing menus and opening the world map–even while actively using the pathfinding system. This will make travel and exploration feel more fluid and less restrictive, regardless of your preferred platform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/1d1d53097f2af26f40d375f8afc0f43cabeecbef.png[/img]
 
[h3][b]🔸RP System[/b][/h3]
 
As we highlighted in our previous developer video, a key priority for us is to expand the range of engaging content that doesn't heavily rely on RP. With each major update following the official release, you can expect to see new experiences added to the game, ensuring that everyone has plenty to enjoy without feeling constrained by RP limitations.

Through these regular content updates—along with the exciting launch-day events and the improvements we're making to rewards—our goal is to create a more balanced and enjoyable experience for all players, regardless of their RP reserves.

We continue to actively monitor your feedback regarding the RP system, and please know that your suggestions will be actively considered for future game operations. We encourage you to keep sharing your thoughts with us!

 
[h3][b]🔸Others[/b][/h3]

In addition to the major updates and improvements we’ve detailed above, we’ve also been diligently working on over 1,500 minor bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements since the start of Early Access—and we’re committed to continuing this work all the way through to the official launch.

Moving forward, we will continue to leverage the data gathered during Early Access along with your invaluable feedback to consistently enhance the game. We greatly appreciate your continued support and patience as we continue to refine and expand Game of Thrones: Kingsroad.

Many of you have also expressed interest in our long-term update plans. We're excited to announce that we will be sharing our post-launch update roadmap soon, so please stay tuned for more details!

Furthermore, as we touched upon in our previous AMA, the expansion of alliance-related features and the introduction of new co-op gameplay content are high priorities for us, even though they won't be part of the official launch. We're working hard on these updates, which we know many of you are excited about, and we're committed to introducing them over time as part of our ongoing roadmap.

To give you a little taste of the exciting content still to come, we'll leave you with a small glimpse of what's on the horizon. That brings us to the end of today's developer note.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/fabb4add42193f68b42051f35f1e342aa3f72983.png[/img]

Finally, we want to once again extend our sincere gratitude to each and every one of you who joined us during Early Access.
 
As we mentioned earlier, we've prepared a special thank-you gift exclusively for our Early Access players, with the details outlined below. Your support has been invaluable.

We remain dedicated to ensuring your journey through Game of Thrones: Kingsroad is as enjoyable and rewarding as possible, both now and in the many adventures to come.

[b]🎁 Reward Eligibility[/b]
- All players who participated in Early Access and purchased a Founder’s Pack

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/cc9c4f09ba267c426fad2eb10e96c21d6f2aeabe.png[/img]

[b]➤ Vardis Egen Outfit[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/6eb36c6c275643e7804602f3e501329d000547ae.png[/img]

Thank you once again for your passion, your feedback, and for walking this road with us.

We’ll see you in Westeros.


Sincerely,
[b]JANG[/b]
Executive Producer, Game of Thrones: Kingsroad

Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team. 

As we approach the official launch, today’s update—scheduled for May 14th (PT)—includes a number of minor improvements and fixes to ensure a smoother experience ahead of release.

Today’s update lays the groundwork for next week’s major release. A broader set of fixes, improvements, and new content is on the way, with details to be shared in a developer note later this week—so stay tuned! 

We appreciate your continued support and feedback as we make the final preparations.
Be sure to check out the patch notes below, and thank you for joining us on the road to Westeros.


[h3][b] ■ IMPROVEMENTS & CHANGES
[/b][/h3]
➤ When launching the game on mobile for the first time, players can now begin playing with minimal setup. A small initial download may occur, and additional resources will continue downloading in the background during the Prologue.
✦ If the download isn't completed by the end of the Prologue, the remaining resources will continue downloading after concluding the Prologue.
✦ When connected to Wi-Fi, additional resources will now download automatically without requiring any confirmation.


[h3][b]■ EVENTS
[/b][/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/591771368562884613][b][View Event Details][/b][/url]
New events have been added to give newer players in Early Access a helpful boost as we prepare for the official launch. While the rewards are designed to support earlier progression, players of all levels can still earn them. And don’t worry—there’s more on the way for higher-level players once we hit launch!


[h3][b]■ SYSTEM IMPROVEMENTS
[/b][/h3]
➤ Certain segments of the main quest [Faded Glory] have been shortened to improve overall pacing and progression.
➤ Rewards for early-game enemies in the main quest have been rebalanced, and some quests now grant slightly increased experience.
➤ On-screen text prompts have been added to guide players when first using the Mount feature. 


[h3][b]■ BUG FIXES & ADJUSTMENTS 
[/b][/h3]
➤ The Battle Pass: Oath of the Night’s Watch event period has been extended and will now run until June 18, 11:00 PM (PT). [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/3183280/announcements/detail/536597739399544858?snr=2___][b][Go to the Battle Pass Notice][/b] [/url]
➤ Fixed an issue where players who completed the [Homecoming] quest without defeating enemies in Queenscrown were attacked by invisible enemies upon returning to the area.
➤ Fixed an issue where the equipment shortcut key would occasionally not function during the tutorial.


Thank you for your continued support and passion throughout the early access period.
We’re excited to share more with you soon as we head toward the official launch of [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i].

Stay tuned for upcoming announcements—and as always, we welcome your feedback as we continue building a better experience together.

notes.title: Game of Thrones: Kingsroad May 8th AMA Summary
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif[/img]

Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team. 

Thank you to everyone who joined our AMA! We’ve gathered all of the questions and answers from our most recent AMA session. Check it out below!

💬 : Hello everyone! Welcome to Game of Thrones: Kingsroad's very first AMA

Thanks for joining our first AMA session and first off, a huge thank you for all the excitement and support you’ve shown for Game of Thrones: Kingsroad.
We’ve received a lot of great questions through our official Discord, so we'll get started by addressing some of the most popular ones first, then lead onto other questions from the community!

                      
💬 To start things off, many players have expressed their desires for Alliance-related activities and contents.
Many of the questions we received were about Alliances, including:

[b]❔ Will there be Alliance-exclusive activities, such as Alliance Boss Raids or large-scale battles?
For example, could we see scenarios where the entire alliance teams up to fight against enemies like the Boltons or Lannisters?

❔ Will alliances have their own castle or shared hub area?
Something that can be upgraded over time—where members can gather, take on special missions from an alliance board, and unlock buffs based on joint progress?

❔ Will the current member cap of 20 per alliance be increased in the future?

🗣️❓: Are there any plans to expand alliance features, like enabling alliances to fight each other for territory control?[/b]

💬 :  Great question!
Alliance content holds significant importance for our development team and will play a central role in our upcoming updates. We are committed to continuously expanding and enriching these features moving forwards.
As many of you have specifically mentioned, we are actively planning exclusive content tailored for Alliances, including dedicated spaces and engaging activities for members to enjoy together. In addition to these features, we will also be increasing the maximum number of members an Alliance can accommodate.

[b]🗣️❓: What does enriching and expanding embody? Could you be more precise?
[/b]
💬 :  We'll continue to share more concrete details about the expected timeline and specific content additions through our Developer Notes next week, so please stay tuned!

                       
💬 : Moving on, regarding Cosmetics

[b]❔: Will we be able to have cosmetic helmets and hoods later on?

❔: Have the developers ever considered adding more personalization and ownership features to Kingsroad — like weapon skins?[/b]

💬 : We definitely plan to introduce a variety of new outfits and skins, including new outfits featuring hats, helmets, and [b]weapon skins[/b] 👀 . These will be prioritized for upcoming updates and will be closely tied to future content releases.

                       
[b]🗣️❓: How are the lobbies for Drogon matched? Will it be possible to join the same Drogon if you are in a party but from different servers? I've attempted to fight Drogon with a friend before but we end up at different instances of the world boss.[/b]

💬 : Great question!
We've had many questions regarding the server/lobby system

[b]❔: Will we be able to change servers within region to do world boss fights with friends/alliance mates in another server? [/b]

💬 : Drogon lobbies are matched within the player's servers. 
While the option for server transfers are not available at the moment, we are actively exploring ways to implement event-based co-op content that allows players from different servers to team up and enjoy certain features together. For example, we’re also looking into systems where players from different servers can be matched for Drogon fights, similar to the mechanics in Altar of Memories. We’re considering various approaches, so please stay tuned for more updates!
                       
[b]🗣️❓: Is there any chance you'll add change appearance (face mostly) tickets in near future?
[/b]
💬 : We have some great news to share on this, please look forward to our Dev Notes next week!

                       
[b]🗣️❓: Will we have a possible collab event with content from House of the Dragon?
[/b]
❔: Have you considered releasing DLC in the future—perhaps something based on House of the Dragon or other key eras in the Game of Thrones universe? Since the world map already exists, it could be really interesting to explore DLCs that dive into different centuries or major events from Westeros' history.

💬 : If there's an opportunity to collaborate with other ASOIAF content, we'd love to do so!

                       
💬 :  Now onto the heavy hitters:
The community has expressed their desire to learn more about the upcoming content and the future plans regarding Game of Thrones: Kingsroad.

[b]❔: Do you have a roadmap for future updates / content?

❔: With the inclusion of more co op content, will we be getting 4 player, 8 player, and possibly 12 player dungeons and raids?

❔: Will the co-op system be further developed? Will it be expanded to include the open world? Will there be more co-op modes?

❔: Will be there more functions for friends/party? I would like to be able to see and do many things with friends or community.

❔ Will the co-op system be further developed? Will it be expanded to include the open world? Will there be more co-op modes? [/b]

💬 : In general, updates will advance the narrative with new chapters. But that’s not all—
We'd also like to share a bit about what we're currently developing for co-op content.
We are currently on the final development stages for a new type of PVE content: [b]raids[/b].
This is designed to offer a distinct gameplay experience compared to the already existing World Bosses and Altar of Memories. 
Our current design envisions a starting point of 4 players, with the potential to scale up to 8.
Players will be able to challenge themselves against a bigger threat, figuratively and literally.

That said, there are still a lot of factors we need to carefully consider in the process. For instance, as the group size increases, we need to appropriately scale the time investment and difficulty, which also might bring up challenges around matchmaking. We are giving this considerable thought and will strive to incorporate your feedback as much as possible.

Furthermore, given that multiplayer is a core element of Kingsroad, we are committed to continuously expanding the range of co-op content available, including both dungeon-based and field-based activities.

Adding onto this, we've also seen players having difficulty finding lobbies for certain contents - Altar of Memories for example
While the Official Launch and a massive influx of players would alleviate the issue, we do plan to add options that make multiplayer content more accessible, such as allowing gameplay with fewer participants. That said, given that we have other, more pressing issues to address, this particular feature is likely to be implemented at a later stage in the game's development as an update.

                       
[b]🗣️❓: Have you considered upping the loot tables/chance of specific loot? It feels like it takes way too many attempts to get a purple or an orange item from the Ferocious Beasts
[/b]
💬 : We hear you!
While Altar of Memories for example has a mileage system, Ferocious Beasts do not have such system, and it could feel frustrating for players going on a dry streak.
We'll be introducing a similar system to Ferocious Beasts as well in the coming weeks, where players will be able to obtain desired loots from Ferocious Beasts such as pelts deterministically.

                       
[b]🗣️❓: What areas of the game does the team feel currently needs the most attention when it comes to game balance (excluding RP which has already been stated)?
[/b]
💬: 🪙 The In-Game Currency Economy is our top priority atm, let us delve deeper on this.

We've touched on this topic on our previous Dev Notes briefly, we are planning to generally increase the amount of Copper rewarded from repeatable content that uses RP. Through this, our goal is to increase the fixed amount of Copper that players can steadily earn through daily gameplay, making repeatable activities feel more rewarding and meaningful.

We are also working on adjusting the currently underutilized Production and Trade systems into meaningful sources of Copper. 

More things will be revealed in our Dev Notes, but to give a brief rundown:
➤ We plan to significantly reduce the Copper cost required for Production activities, making it easier to gather materials repeatedly.
➤ The materials produced will then feed into Trading system, allowing players to regularly acquire materials required for growth, and Copper.
➤ To actively facilitate the above process, we'll be increasing the maximum number of worker capacity and also implement more varied ways for their stamina to regenerate.

                       
[b]🗣️❓:  Any plans to add more classes?
[/b]
💬: Any ideas? We'd love to hear them! We've received similar questions, such as:

❔: Do you plan to have new character classes in the future? I mean like: ranged class with for example bow and throwing knives and who has a pet for example a DireWolf who gets the enemies on melee while the character orders it and taking the aggro on him, like in MMO. Tank class with Shield and 1 hand weapon, who can resist tons of damage in one of the talent tree... I would like to have also something with 2 handed maul like is shown in enemies.

❔: Have you considered introducing new classes through the story itself? For example, allowing players to create a character like an Immaculate Spearman from Essos, with a unique starting path that doesn’t immediately share progression (like Momentum) with other characters—only converging when their storylines eventually cross. 

💬: To be upfront, adding a new class is no easy task. 

What we can say for certain is that new classes are always on our radar. However, we're not yet in a position to confirm when they'll be ready, and we appreciate your understanding. 

That said, we would love to keep hearing your thoughts. Just like the detailed suggestions we've already received about ranged or tank classes, your feedback is incredibly valuable—so please keep it coming!

                       
[b]🗣️❓: Any chance we could get a credits list of the Voice Actors? They all did such a fantastic job, it would be great to give them recognition for their awesome work! 🙂
[/b]
💬: We'll look into this 👀

                       
[b]🗣️❓: Will we have more solo content, similar to Wormwalk, without the need to spend RP?
[/b]
 💬: Definitely, expect single player content to have further expansions each major update.
There's also a new content that we're working on, but it's in the early development stages so we'll share more on this in the future.

                       
[b]🗣️❓: Will we be getting a storage chest in RR?
[/b]
 💬: The team would like to know more regarding storage space, would this be coming from a lack of bag space? Or from another perspective? (As in- even if there are enough spaces in the bag, some items belong in the storage for example)

[b]🗣️❓: : We need more ways to earn storage items—right now there are only a few sources, and we really need a non-token method or an increase in North/Reach Tokens or Alliance Shop options to make them more accessible.
[/b]
 💬: I see what you mean, the Official Launch will have more ways to expand Inventory Spaces in-game!


[b]🗣️❓: If you lived in Westeros, where would you live and what would you be doing?
[/b]
 💬: Sheep Farmer 🐑  somewhere in The Reach

                       
[b]🗣️❓: We still need answers on smaller topics like Crows and the Battle Pass—could you please address both? If they're going to be covered in an upcoming dev note, just a quick confirmation would be great. 🙂 

❔: Currently the Battle Pass has no functionality past the initial 45 levels.  In many F2P games players are encouraged to keep meeting established dailies with some form of currency with extended battle pass levels, such as much needed copper in GoT Kingsroad.  Is there any chance we can see a similar system put into place?  The ASPCA and Sheep of Westeros will thank you![/b]

 💬: While we do not have any concrete ideas to share at the moment, we'll definitely pass this onto the rest of the team. While we want Battle Pass rewards to be as rewarding as possible, we also have to be careful about not making it feel like too much of a chore.
We'll nag the dev team to add more Tribute rewards to the shop!

                       
[b]🗣️❓: When we are doing large bosses like Drogon, can we have the camera unlock so we can zoom out farther?
[/b]
 💬: We'll pass this onto the dev team as well!

                       
[b]🗣️❓: Please address this with a simple (yes/no) will it ever get fixed? 
Context: It completely ruined my immersion. A wolf attacked me right next to the guard, and they did nothing. They are like visual statues in their current state.[/b]

 💬: Sorry, we couldn't reply to this on time.
While making improvements to the immersion - as in natural NPC movements/interactions would certainly be something that we'd like to work on in the future, it's something that would have to be looked into later on, as this would require a big overhaul to how NPCs would interact.

                       
 💬: Alright, I think it's time to conclude today's AMA!

It was a great opportunity for us to be able to listen to our community firsthand.
Even though we couldn't reply to all of the questions that came up on this round, the entire dev team will be reading through the AMA contents.

We also have a Dev Note coming in the near future, so please look forward to that as well!

Thank you,
Game of Thrones: Kingsroad Team

Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team.

notes.title: Game of Thrones: Kingsroad Official Release FAQ
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif[/img]

Greetings, Lords and Ladies.
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team.

The wait is almost over! We are thrilled to reveal that the official launch date for Game of Thrones: Kingsroad is scheduled for [b]May 21st, 2025 (PT)[/b]. 

We extend our deepest gratitude for everyone who has been eagerly awaiting this moment for your patience and unwavering support. We appreciate your continued excitement as we move into the final preparations for you to officially experience the realm.

[h3][b] 1. Available Platforms Upon Official Release
[/b][/h3]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad will be launching on both mobile and PC.
On mobile, the game will be available through the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
On PC, it can be accessed via Steam, Google Play Games, our dedicated PC launcher, and the Epic Games Store.
Additionally, Game of Thrones: Kingsroad supports cross-play, allowing you to enjoy the same character across both mobile and PC platforms—so you can continue your adventure anytime, anywhere.

[h3][b]2. Available Regions Upon Official Release
[/b][/h3]At launch, the game will be available in approximately 200 countries across North America, South America, Europe, Oceania, and the MENA region.
However, please note that service in Asia will open at a later date due to additional localization work, as previously announced. https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/537722458840499318

We will provide further updates once the launch schedule for Asia is confirmed.

[h3][b]3. Gameplay Data
[/b][/h3]Currently, the game is available through Steam Early Access and limited Open Beta Testing (OBT) in select regions. 
Please note that any progress made during Early Access will not be reset at launch. You can continue your adventure and experience the newly added content using your existing character after the official release. 

[h3][b]4. Post-Launch Content 
[/b][/h3]After the official release, new areas and main episodes will be added, along with additional content like new Altar of Memories dungeons.
We’ll be sharing further details about upcoming content through future Developer Notes—so stay tuned!

[h3][b]5. Bridging the Gap Between Early Access and New Players
[/b][/h3]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad is fundamentally designed with a focus on single-player gameplay, and we are working to minimize any feelings of imbalance or unfairness that might arise from differences in progression. 
Above all, we have undergone extensive testing, including Open Beta Testing (OBT), to improve the game and make it more enjoyable and accessible for everyone. We encourage all players to focus on the inherent fun of progressing through the later stages and reaching the endgame content, rather than comparing progress with other characters. 

[h3][b]6. AMA Schedule and Future Improvements
[/b][/h3]We have been receiving a lot of valuable feedback and suggestions from players, and we’re truly grateful for all the input. We have been carefully reviewing the questions submitted through our official Discord in preparation for our upcoming AMA session in May. The AMA will take place on May 8th (PT), through which we will address questions that have been asked and engage in a broader discussion on topics of interest within the community. 
Make sure to be on the lookout for a separate announcement containing detailed information regarding the AMA schedule, participation channel, and instructions on how to join. 

[h3][b]7. Special Rewards for Steam Early Access Players
[/b][/h3]We would like to extend a heartfelt thank you to each and every one of you who joined our Steam Early Access. Your incredible enthusiasm and the insightful feedback you’ve provided have been invaluable in shaping the game’s development. 
As a token of our sincere appreciation, we have prepared a special reward exclusively for our Steam Early Access participations. 
Upon our official release, all Steam Early Access players will receive two unique items: an exclusive outfit and a distinctive House Sigil. 
Anyone who purchases the Steam Early Access before the official release will be eligible for these rewards. We will share details regarding their distribution in a future announcement closer to the release date. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/2e157ca5d37f11d9cf74cd1782905759c40b916b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/74c1c72b5bb6c5623fb6b4f818a7d78dd5691ab2.png[/img]

Our development team is dedicated to delivering an incredible adventure across the continent of Westeros, and we strive to incorporate as much of your valuable feedback as possible.
We recognize that our prior communication regarding patches may have been somewhat lacking, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. Moving forward, we are committed to more frequent and transparent communication through regular AMA sessions and Developer Notes.

We kindly ask for your continued anticipation and support as we approach the official launch.

Thank you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Developer Note: Addressing Feedback on Copper Adjustments & Future Improvements
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/e0da14f614f65e3e0770ee76bc0b550e4b848fbe.gif[/img]

Hello, this is the [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] Development Team. 

We have been closely following player feedback regarding the recent adjustments to how Copper was acquired using sheepskin and traits following the latest update. First and foremost, we would like to apologize for any inconvenience this change has caused to our players’ gameplay experience. 

We implemented this change after noticing that in certain scenarios, Copper was being acquired at rates beyond what was originally intended for game balance. From a long-term perspective, our goal to maintain game balance and a healthy economy made it a change we could not avoid. When a particular method becomes excessively efficient due to a system flaw, it can negatively impact the fairness and viability of other game content and progression. 

However, we fully understand and empathize with the frustration many players are feeling, especially those who already find it challenging to obtain Copper, and now have one less avenue available. Our development team has been consistently monitoring the imbalance between Copper supply and consumption through various data points, and we have internally recognized the need for improvement. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/94b0c20a70104ebdf86596691dcedfb1c4839ce7.png[/img]
[i]Daily Consumption vs. Acquisition Metrics // (Left: Consumption / Right: Acquisition)
[/i]
This adjustment is just one part of the solution, and we are well aware that a more fundamental one is required. We are currently exploring various methods to diversify Copper acquisition, increase the overall amount players can acquire, and adjust unnecessary consumption points. 

To give players a clearer picture of our plans, we are first considering a general increase in the Copper rewards for repeatable content that consumes RP. Our goal is to allow players to naturally earn more Copper simply by engaging with the repeatable field content in-game. Secondly, we are working to normalize the currently underperforming production and trade in the Estate and establish them as significant sources of Copper. We are preparing a major overhaul of the Production and Trade system in Renan's Rest to provide a passive source of Copper. (For example: Players will be able to hire a new type of workers who will generate greater amount of Copper over time)

These changes were initially planned to be implemented in the April 28th Update; however, they were excluded due to the need for further adjustments. Once again, we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this delay may have caused while these improvements are taking time to implement, and we are preparing a special gift to show our appreciation to our Early Access players. 

Until then, we will continue to monitor player experiences, and do our best to mitigate any difficulties through events and other means. We also look forward to engaging with diverse opinions during our upcoming AMA session. Thank you for your continued support and understanding. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 4/28 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/661d50962b015bc14ff1bc13d0cadb05b0d26953.gif[/img]

Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team. 

Today we bring you details regarding the update taking place on April 28th (PT). 

This update includes improvements and fixes for ongoing issues within the game. Be sure to check the patch notes below and enjoy your adventure! 

We always appreciate your feedback and are committed to continually improving your experience in [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i].


[h2][b]■ BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS 
[/b][/h2]
➤ Adjusted the reward drop rate for defeating sheep in the field. 
➤ Adjusted the activation chance and number of additional items gained upon activating the Master of Herbalism / Master of Hunting nodes in the Support Trait Tree. 

📢 We understand that Copper acquisition is an important aspect of your gameplay, and will continue to closely monitor and make improvements to the balance around it. To support players in the meantime, we will be running various events, such as the Weekend Bonus Time, leading up to the official release. Please refer to the following link for more information on these upcoming opportunities: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536600287259918921][New Events Await You in Game of Thrones: Kingsroad][/url]

Furthermore, as part of our ongoing efforts to improve Copper balance, we will be providing [b]100,000 Copper[/b] to all players via in-game mail (one time per account) upon logging in after the update.
🎁[b] Reward Claim Period:[/b] April 28th, 7:00 PM - April 29th, 8:00 PM (PT)


[h2][b]■ IMPROVEMENTS
[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]📌 Currency
[/b][/h3]
➤  Increased the quantity of bait crafted at once for Ferocious Beasts. 
↪ Elk: 1 ➜ 3
↪ Other Ferocious Beasts: 1 ➜ 2
➤ The base reward of daily free Copper acquired from the shop under Support/Convenience > Special Sale has been changed to a Copper Pouch. 
↪ Before: Copper x2,000
↪ After: Copper Pouch x1 (Obtain one of the following: 2,000/6,000/12,000/30,000 Copper) 
➤ Increased the reward for the first stage of Daily Missions (2,000 ➜ 4,000 Copper). 

[h3][b]📌 Combat
[/b][/h3]
➤ Improved the combat difficulty and quests in early areas. 
➤ Lowered the difficulty of the Echoes of the Past in the Dreadfort region. 
➤ Removed the entry requirement for the first Altar of Memories dungeon (Blue Cockatrice of the Shores of Dorne) and lowered the difficulty. 

[h3][b]📌 Other
[/b][/h3]
➤ The World Boss spawn cycle has been adjusted from every 1 hour to every 2 hours in order to allow more players to gather and enjoy battles together. 


[h2][b]■ Events
[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]📌 New Events
[/b][/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3183280/view/536600287259918921][b]👉 [New Events Await You in Game of Thrones: Kingsroad] 
[/b][/url]

[h2][b]■ Products
[/b][/h2]

[/b][/h3]

- Iron Bank Marks x50
- Golden Dragon x300
- Rare Ring Box x1
- Worn Stark Sigil x1
- Copper x10,000

[h3][b]📌 Founder’s Pack Sales Period Adjustment 
[/b][/h3]
➤  The sales end date for the Founder’s Packs and their upgrades has been adjusted. 


[h2][b]■ BUG FIXES
[/b][/h2]
 
[h3][b]📌 General Fixes
[/b][/h3]
➤ Backend server optimizations have been implemented to improve overall stability. 
➤ Fixed an issue where players could play the game after pressing the ESC button during game startup under certain conditions.  
➤ Fixed an issue where players were occasionally unable to claim the Episode Completion Package reward for clearing Episode 11 after completing all main quests.

[h3][b]📌 Combat & Gameplay Fixes
[/b][/h3]
➤ Fixed an issue where players could fall through the terrain when hit by the Giant Bear during combat. 
➤ Fixed an issue where players could not progress Bandit Camp [Whispering Farm] after leaving and re-entering mid-progress. 
➤ Fixed awkward attack animations for the boss in Bandit Camp [Whispering Farm]. 
➤ Fixed an issue where players were occasionally moved outside the terrain when hit while mounted. 
➤ Fixed an issue where characters could move through certain narrow gaps in terrain. 
➤ Fixed an issue where the HP recovery effect of the Assassin’s Seasoned Strike trait was not applied properly.
➤ Fixed an issue where bosses in Ferocious Beast battles continued chasing players after leaving the combat area. 
➤ Fixed an issue where Echoes of the Past would fail under certain conditions. 
➤ Fixed an issue where defeating the Red Cockatrice would not summon the Blue Cockatrice upon playing Altar of Memories - Cockatrices of the Shores of Dorne. 
➤ Fixed an issue where skills could not be swapped upon consuming certain draughts. 
➤ Fixed an issue where characters could become stuck and move abnormally during combat under certain conditions. 
➤ Fixed an issue where characters would move abnormally after reviving under certain conditions. 
➤ Fixed an issue where the World Boss Drogon would not spawn at certain times. 
➤ Fixed an issue where Ferocious Beast battles did not proceed normally under certain conditions. 
➤ Fixed an issue where reconnecting to the game during the Beyond the Wall Expedition tutorial would prevent further tutorial progress. 

[h3][b]📌 Quest & NPC Fixes
[/b][/h3]
➤ Fixed an issue where players were unable to progress White Harbor’s City Mystery [Wandering Minstrel's Poem] after reconnecting to the game while talking to Helga. 
➤ Fixed an issue where the quest [Negotiating Poison] occasionally did not track properly under certain conditions.  
 
[h3][b]📌 Control & Input Fixes
[/b][/h3]
➤ Fixed an issue where other characters’ movements were displayed awkwardly after rolling. 
➤ Fixed an issue where movable boxes in certain Historic Sites occasionally could not be interacted with.
➤ Fixed an issue where players had difficulty moving from on top of a box to another object after having moved the box in question in certain Historic Sites. 
➤ Fixed an issue where the character would dodge in a different direction after performing a Short Evasion after an Evasion Attack, even if no directional input was made. 

[h3][b]📌 UI/UX & Visual Fixes
[/b][/h3]
➤ Fixed an issue where the key to a treasure chest in a Bandit Camp in Highgarden could not be sold or discarded after it became useless. 
➤ Fixed an issue where the signpost information shown in World Map > Exploration Gauge > Signposts did not match the actual discovered signposts.
➤ Fixed an issue where some signpost names in World Map > Exploration Gauge > Signposts for each region were displayed in a different language.
