notes.title: 4/16 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/661d50962b015bc14ff1bc13d0cadb05b0d26953.gif[/img]

Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team. 

Today we bring you details regarding the update taking place on April 16th (PT).

This update includes skill balance adjustments and fixes for ongoing issues within the game. Be sure to check the patch notes below and enjoy your adventure!

We always appreciate your feedback and are committed to continually improving your experience in [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i].

[h2][b]■ BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS 
[/b][/h2]
The duration of Ignite and Poison Weapon skills was previously shorter than their cooldowns, making it difficult to maintain their buffs consistently. This created challenges in content such as Beyond the Wall Expeditions, particularly when fighting Wight enemies or trying to sustain a poison-based attack tempo.

To resolve this, we are extending the duration of these buffs while reducing their cooldown times.

➤ The duration and cooldown of the Ignite Weapon skill for Knight, Assassin, and Sellsword classes have been adjusted.
• Duration: 15 seconds ➜ 20 seconds
• Cooldown: 24 seconds ➜ 20 seconds

➤ The duration and cooldown of the Ignite Weapon+ skill for Knight, Assassin and Sellsword classes have been adjusted.
• Duration: 20 seconds ➜ 30 seconds
• Cooldown: 24 seconds ➜ 20 seconds

➤ The duration of the Poison and Poison+ skills for the Assassin class have been adjusted.
• Duration: 15 seconds ➜ 20 seconds

➤ The maximum projectile recovery rate has been fixed to 65%.

[h2][b]■ IMPROVEMENTS
[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]📌 Currency
[/b][/h3]
We’ve made several adjustments to address some feedback around Copper scarcity and the high cost of using HP Tinctures during gameplay.

➤ The number of Sweetgrass required to craft HP Tinctures has been reduced from 8 → 4, making them easier to produce and the materials easier to acquire.
➤ The cost of Copper per Alliance donation has been reduced from 5,000 → 3,000.
* Rewards per donation will remain unchanged.
➤ Due to the lowered donation cost, the amount of Copper received from exchanging Alliance Tokens has been adjusted from 6,000 → 4,500.
➤ The cost to purchase HP Tinctures upon revival in Altar of Memories dungeons has been reduced from 1,000 → 500 in order to support smoother multiplayer gameplay.
➤ The Copper earned from clearing Bandit Camps has been increased by 1.6x.
* The RP cost and other rewards will remain unchanged.
➤ Both the entry fee and rewards for minigames have been reduced to better align with overall balance.
➤ The fast travel fees for Renan’s Rest and Renan’s Rest Main Hall have been removed. It is now completely free to travel to these locations.

[h3][b]📌 Combat
[/b][/h3]
➤ The knockback effect from the skill combo used by two-handed sword Elite Enemies has been removed.
➤ All classes can now apply a hitstun effect to enemies when using Sprint Attack (Heavy).

[h3][b]📌 Other
[/b][/h3]
➤ Crafting time for all types of bait has been reduced from 5 seconds → instant (0 seconds).
➤ The number of available worker employment slots depending on your Manor Management Office level have been increased.
➤ The treasure chest in a Bandit Camp in Highergarden can now be opened without a key.
* Treasure Chest Keys currently in possession can now be sold or discarded.
➤ Access to the shop, Battle Pass, and Equipment management content is now unlocked right after completing the “Winter is Coming” quest.

[h2][b]■ BUG FIXES
[/b][/h2]
 
[h3][b]📌 General Fixes
[/b][/h3]
➤ Backend server optimizations have been implemented to improve overall stability.

[h3][b]📌 Shop Fixes
[/b][/h3]➤ Fixed an issue where players were occasionally unable to claim Episode Completion Package rewards upon clearing an episode.
* If you were affected by the above issue, the rewards in question will be claimable upon reconnecting to the game after the update.
* If the rewards still cannot be claimed after the update, please try fully closing and restarting the game in order to claim the rewards.
➤ Fixed an issue where certain items in the Reach Token Shop could be exchanged for North Tokens.

[h3][b]📌 Combat & Gameplay Fixes
[/b][/h3]
➤ Fixed an issue where Super Armor was not being applied while using Merciless Strike+.
➤ Fixed an issue where Quick Dodge could not remove the stun effect caused by the Giant Wight’s Roar skill during Echoes of the Past.
➤ Fixed an issue in the Cockatrices of the Shores of Dorne dungeon in Altar of Memories where the attacks from one of Red Cockatrice’s skills could not be avoided.
➤ Fixed an issue where destroying the lock on a double ladder with a ranged attack within Bandit Camps failed to lower the ladder.
➤ Fixed an issue where some bounty targets could not be attacked under certain conditions.
➤ Fixed an issue where the screen occasionally turned white during an Artifact Expedition.
➤ Some rewards obtainable from certain Enemy Hideouts have been changed.
➤ Fixed an issue where forcibly exiting from a Beyond the Wall Expedition prevented players from continuing the expedition afterward.
➤ Fixed an issue where rewards from Bandit Camps could be repeatedly claimed under certain conditions. 
* We are currently reviewing additional actions for accounts that gained an excessive amount of EXP through abnormal measures related to the issue above. Further information will be shared in a separate announcement in the near future. 

[h3][b]📌 Quest & NPC Fixes
[/b][/h3]
➤ Fixed an issue where NPCs occasionally wouldn’t move during the main quest [Infiltrating the Keep].
➤ Fixed an issue where some rewards couldn’t be claimed during the tutorial encounters, and corrected the positioning of certain NPCs.
➤ Fixed an issue preventing certain encounters in Oldtown from progressing.
➤ Fixed an issue where enemy stats in some Occupied Sites were abnormally low.
➤ Added markers to show the location of targets during certain bounty quests.
 
[h3][b]📌 Control & Input Fixes
[/b][/h3]
➤ Fixed an issue where it was possible to move through inaccessible areas.
➤ Fixed an issue where characters could occasionally fall through the map or into specific places, and would be stuck after dying and respawning. Characters will now be placed back into the world upon respawning after death.
➤ Fixed an issue where interacting with doors in certain situations would prevent movement and make the character uncontrollable.

[h3][b]📌 UI/UX & Visual Fixes
[/b][/h3]
➤ Fixed an issue where the default language was displayed incorrectly in unsupported regions.
➤ Fixed an issue where enemy names in some Occupied Sites were displayed in a different language.

We appreciate your continued support and feedback as we work to improve your experience in the game. As always, we remain committed to providing you with the best possible gameplay experience. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of our community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 4/1 Update Notes [Updated on 4/8, 02:00 AM (PT)]
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/661d50962b015bc14ff1bc13d0cadb05b0d26953.gif[/img]

Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/b] team. 

We’re excited to share the details of the update taking place on April 1 (PT)! This update includes a variety of issue fixes and improvements to enhance your experience. Please take a moment to review the patch notes below, and we hope you continue to enjoy your journey in the game!

[h2][b]■ CHANGES
[/b][/h2]
Before we get into the update details, we have an important announcement to share.

Previously, when purchasing a Founder’s Pack, the included outfits could only be equipped by one character. We’ve received feedback from many of you expressing disappointment about not being able to equip these outfits on other characters. 

After carefully reviewing your feedback, we’ve decided that[b] starting with this update, when you purchase the Founder’s Pack, you will receive three Northern / Wandering Crow outfit boxes, each applicable to a different class[/b].
* You can use the costume box after logging in with the character you wish to equip it on. 

For those [b]who have already purchased a Founder’s Pack that includes the previous outfits, we’ll be sending you two outfit selection boxes for the outfits you purchased soon[/b].

[h3][b]☑️ Founder's Pack Outfit Distribution [Updated on 4/8, 02:00 AM (PT)][/b][/h3]
[b]▪Items[/b]: 
- Northern Outfit x2
- Wandering Crow Outfit x2 (Accounts that purchased a Founder’s Pack: Deluxe or higher)
[b]▪Eligible Recipients[/b]: Accounts that purchased a Founder’s Pack before the 4/2 update
[b]▪Claim Period[/b]: April 8, 02:00 AM - May 8, 07:59 AM (PT)
* The items will be delivered to your in-game mailbox. Please make sure to claim them within the specified period, as unclaimed items will be deleted afterward.

We sincerely thank all of you who are enjoying the game through Early Access.

Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we will continue to listen closely to your suggestions as we work to provide an even more satisfying experience in [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i].

________________________________________
 
[h2][b]■ BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS 
[/b][/h2]
- Reduced the boss’s HP in the main quest [Forbidden Knowledge]. 
- Adjusted the balance in Wormwalk Stage 20 and above, and updated the recommended momentum. 
- Fixed an issue where the Blue Cockatrice’s poison damage was applied incorrectly. 
- Fixed an issue where the HP of some field monsters in the Dreadfort area was incorrectly applied.
- Adjusted the Assassin class’s poison max stacks so that the stun effect no longer removes the maximum stack. 
- Adjusted the Assassin class’s poison max stack stun effect to apply only to common monsters. 
- Added a cooldown before the Assassin class’s poison max stack stun effect can be applied to the same target again. 

[h2][b]■ IMPROVEMENTS
[/b][/h2]
- Adjusted the font of certain text for better readability. 
- Improved camera control so that it is no longer forcibly adjusted during certain main quests. 
- Expanded the detection range for completion points in certain sub-quests. 
- Added new voice lines and sound effects. 
- Modified certain sub-quests by removing intermediate rewards and incorporating them into the final rewards. 
- Added descriptions on where to acquire certain items and corrected typos. 

[h2][b]■ BUG FIXES
[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]General Fixes
[/b][/h3]- Fixed several issues that caused the game to crash.
- Fixed an issue where previously unexplored areas were displayed in certain situations.
- Fixed an issue where pathfinding did not provide the shortest route or caused broken paths.
- Fixed an issue where the red dot notification didn’t appear when rewards were available for collection.
- Fixed an issue where the wrong language was displayed in certain quests and dialogues, despite the selected language setting.
- Fixed an issue where a non-existent rarity was displayed in the Stable menu.
- Fixed an issue where the Wish Rewards in the results screen in Altar of Memories were showing a different item in certain situations.
- Fixed an issue where Altar of Memories rewards were incorrectly granted in certain situations.
- Fixed an issue where a “Fatal Error!” popup would appear when entering Beyond the Wall Expeditions in certain situations.
- Fixed an issue where players would fall below the terrain during combat with certain monsters.

[h3][b]Combat & Gameplay Fixes
[/b][/h3]- Fixed an issue in Wormwalk where skills couldn’t be cancelled under certain conditions.
- Fixed an issue in Wormwalk where monster damage was abnormally low in certain situations.
- Fixed an issue where recommended equipment was occasionally not displayed properly.
- Fixed an issue where detailed stats were not displayed upon upgrading Set Research effects.
- Fixed an issue where the [Marksman] 5-set effect description in Set Research was incorrect.
- Fixed an issue where it was occasionally not possible to defeat the World Boss [Drogon] and the [Ironbeak Griffin] in Altar of Memories.
- Fixed an issue where the effects of certain Artifact effects were not instantly applied.
- Fixed an issue where the refinement effects of certain Artifacts were not instantly applied.
- Fixed an issue where nearby normal enemies wouldn’t enter the Fear state by chance when executing an [Execution] attack.
- Fixed an issue where the information displayed in the [Finishing Strike] effect window in Beyond the Wall Expeditions did not match the actual effect.
- Fixed the issue where buffs did not stack properly for the [Agile Movement+] skill.
- Fixed an issue where the Rage gauge would recover when using certain Knight class skills.

[h3][b]Quest & NPC Fixes
[/b][/h3]- Fixed an issue where certain terrain could be passed through during the prologue.
- Fixed an issue where interactive gadgets would not disappear in certain sub-quests.
- Fixed an issue where NPCs would disappear unnaturally in certain sub-quests.
- Fixed an issue where a black screen would persist for an extended period during certain quests.
- Fixed an issue where gadget animations were not playing correctly in certain quests.
- Fixed an issue where tutorial progress was blocked during certain main quests.
- Fixed an issue in main quests where completing the mission would not register properly if you defeated an NPC from outside their line of sight.
- Fixed an issue in main quests where NPCs would fail to move after entering a dungeon or reconnecting while the NPC was accompanying the player.
- Fixed an issue where players could farm rewards by repeatedly defeating NPC monsters in certain quests/content.
- Fixed an issue in certain sub-quests where selecting the wrong crafting order prevented players from reselecting materials.
- Fixed an issue where the actions of some NPCs appeared unnatural during quest progression.
- Fixed an issue where NPC outfits appeared unnatural in certain areas.

[h3][b]UI/UX & Visual Fixes
[/b][/h3]- Fixed an issue where the screen did not refresh immediately after achieving group achievements.
- Fixed an issue where characters were unable to move in certain terrains during quests.
- Fixed an issue where the cloak color for certain classes was displayed incorrectly on some devices.
- Fixed an issue where red lines would occasionally appear around your character during gameplay.
- Fixed an issue where the weapon storage position was incorrectly placed when equipping the Dragonbane Outfit.
- Fixed an issue where the check-in event end message was showing up in certain situations.
- Fixed various positioning and overlap issues in certain UI/UX elements.

[h3][b]Controller & Input Fixes
[/b][/h3]- Fixed an issue where the cursor would occasionally become stuck in the top-left corner when playing with a controller.
- Fixed an issue where interact and heavy attack were mapped to the same button on the gamepad, but couldn’t be reassigned to the same button when changing key bindings.
* The interaction button is now labeled as [Interact/Special Attack].
* We highly recommend either resetting the Interact/Special Attack keys or re-mapping them after the update if you were originally playing with a controller. 
- Fixed an issue that prevented some buttons from working properly when using a controller in certain steps.

________________________________________

We appreciate your continued support and feedback as we work to improve your experience in the game. As always, we remain committed to providing you with the best possible gameplay experience. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of our community!

notes.title: Developer's Note
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/e0da14f614f65e3e0770ee76bc0b550e4b848fbe.gif[/img]

[b]Hello, this is JANG, the Executive Producer of [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i].
[/b]
Following multiple rounds of testing—including our Closed Beta and participation in Steam Next Fest—we’re excited to finally introduce[i] Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] to you through Steam Early Access, ahead of the game’s official launch. Our entire development team has worked passionately to prepare this product, and we’re thrilled to finally share it with you.

Over the course of internal and external tests, we’ve received consistent feedback from players across the world. Based on that input, we’ve made significant improvements and added new content. Key updates include:
[list]
[*] Improvements to co-op play systems (matchmaking, balancing) for a smoother global experience
[*] Adjustments to open-world mechanics and combat difficulty to better accommodate a wide range of player skill levels
[*] Localization quality improvements across supported languages
[*] General bug fixes and functional enhancements
[/list]We would be grateful if you could continue sharing your thoughts and suggestions during this Early Access phase. [url=https://help.netmarble.com//game/got][b][Customer Support][/b][/url]

To further strengthen communication with our players, we’ll also be hosting regular live-chat AMA sessions in a dedicated Discord channel exclusively for Early Access participants. We hope this space becomes a valuable place for discussion and feedback.

One of the biggest Early Access benefits will be expanded [b]co-op play content[/b]. During past tests, we received a lot of feedback regarding multiplayer experiences, and we agreed with many of those points. That’s why we’ve increased the number of co-op missions compared to previous builds and also added brand-new cooperative content with different gameplay styles.

Many of you also asked for support in additional languages. In response, we’re preparing to support [b]Portuguese[/b] and [b]Turkish[/b] at the time of official launch, with further language expansions under consideration.

Founder's Packs purchased for Early Access will remain usable after launch. However, please note that some in-game balance adjustments may occur based on Early Access data. If significant balance changes are required, we will provide appropriate compensation when the game officially launches—so rest assured.

During the Early Access period, you’ll be able to explore new regions and content not available in previous tests. This is your chance to get a head start on your adventure through Westeros—discover hidden stories, rare Relics, and uncover secrets before anyone else. We especially encourage you to check out the newly added storyline connected to Roose Bolton.

Thank you once again for your support.

Sincerely,
[b]JANG
[/b]Executive Producer, [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i]

notes.title: Partner Creator Plus - [Creator FAQ] [Updated on May 8, 12:22 AM (PT)]
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif[/img]

Greetings, Lords and Ladies.

For those looking to join the [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] Partner Creator Plus program, we've compiled this [b][Creator] FAQ[/b] to help you navigate the process and make the most of your partnership.

Please refer to the following for more details.

[h2][b]■ Table of Contents
[/b][/h2][b]1️⃣ How to Become a Creator
2️⃣ Creator Activities 
3️⃣ Creator Rank Management
4️⃣ Partner Points & Payments
5️⃣ Account Management
6️⃣ Other Information[/b]


[h2][b]1️⃣ How to Become a Creator
[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Q. What kind of service is the Game of Thrones: Kingsroad Partner Creator Plus Program?
[/b][/h3] A. The[i] Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] Partner Creator Plus Program is a creator support program that offers benefits to both content creators and players, helping everyone grow together.
 
Creators who produce content for the game will be rewarded, while they, in turn, contribute to the growth of both themselves and the community through high-quality content. Players will also have the opportunity to express their gratitude and support for the creators, creating a positive cycle of mutual growth.  
 
[h3][b]Q. What are the requirements to become a creator? 
[/b][/h3] A. The [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] Partner Creator Plus program is open to creators who are 20 years or older, have at least 500 YouTube subscribers, and have completed the prerequisite missions. 

Please visit the link below for more details regarding the prerequisite missions. 
[url=creator.netmarble.com/en/got][b]🔗 [Go to the Partner Creator Plus Website] 
[/b] [/url]
[h3][b]Q. How do I apply to become a creator? 
[/b][/h3]
A. You can apply through the dedicated application page, accessible from the main [i]Netmarble Partner Creator Plus[/i] website or through the link below.
[url=https://creator.netmarble.com/en/register][b]🔗 [Apply for Partner Creator Plus]
[/b][/url] 
Please make sure to read the Creator Terms of Service before applying.
[url=https://help.netmarble.com/en/terms/tos_npc_en][b]🔗 [Netmarble Partner Creator Plus' Creator Terms of Service]
[/b][/url]
[h3][b]Q. Why was my creator application rejected? 
[/b][/h3]
A. Your creator application may have been rejected due to incorrect information or failure to meet the eligibility requirements. 

If you were not selected this time, we encourage you to try again in the next season’s recruitment!
  
[h3][b]Q. Can I apply using a platform other than YouTube? 
[/b][/h3]
A. Currently, only YouTube channels are supported. 
We will provide further updates if additional platforms become available in the future. 
 
[h3][b]Q. Do I need to reapply for each season? 
[/b][/h3]
A. Once accepted, your creator status remains active unless you request to withdraw or face restrictions due to violations.  


[h2][b]2️⃣ Creator Activities 
[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Q. What is a Creator ID? 
[/b][/h3]
A. A Creator ID is a unique identifier that links creators and supporters. 
Supporters can enter a Creator ID to initiate support, and a portion of their in-game purchases will accumulate as points for the creator. 
* The accumulated points may vary depending on the payment method and platform. 
 
[h3][b]Q. How can I check my Creator ID? 
[/b][/h3]
A. Your Creator ID can be found on the Creator homepage and under your creator name in [My Page - Content Creator]. 
 
[h3][b]Q. Can I change my Creator ID? 
[/b][/h3]
A. Since the Creator ID is a unique identifier, it cannot be changed. 
Please be careful when setting it up for the first time. 
 
[h3][b]Q. How can I promote my activity as a creator? 
[/b][/h3]
A. Registered Partner Creators can utilize the [Creator Promotion Board] on the [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] official forum and Discord. 
High-quality content may also be featured on the official website’s recommended content page. 
 
[h3][b]Q. Are there any platform restrictions for creator activities? 
[/b][/h3]
A. While maintaining a YouTube channel is mandatory, you are not limited in broadcasting on other platforms (e.g. Twitch).

[h3][b]Q. Are there any precautions to consider when creating videos? [Updated on April, 12:25 AM (PT)][/b][/h3]
A. Certain BGM soundtracks and sound effects in Game of Thrones: Kingsroad may be copyrighted, which could lead to copyright issues. We recommend against the use of background music and sound effects when streaming or creating videos.

Additionally, using third-party programs that are not officially provided by the developer during gameplay for video creation may result in penalties.


[h2][b]3️⃣ Creator Rank Management [Updated on May 8, 12:22 AM (PT)]
[/b][/h2] 

[h3][b]Q. What are the criteria for each Creator rank? 
[/b][/h3]
A. The criteria for each Creator rank are as follows. 
 
[b][Pre-season]
- Diamond: [/b]50,000+ Subscribers, 500+ Supporters 
[b]- Gold: [/b]10,000+ Subscribers, 200+ Supporters
[b]- Silver:[/b] 3,000+ Subscribers, 100+ Supporters
[b]- Bronze:[/b] 500+ Subscribers, 10+ Supporters  
* These criteria may be subject to change. 
 
[h3][b]Q. What are the benefits of each Creator rank? 
[/b][/h3]
A. Partner Creators in[i] Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] earn a percentage of supporter contributions based on their rank. 
 
[b][Pre-season][/b]
[b]- Diamond:[/b] 5% /[b] Gold:[/b] 4% / [b]Silver:[/b] 3% / [b]Bronze:[/b] 2%
 * These rates may be subject to change. 

[h3][b]Q. How can I rank up as a creator? 
[/b][/h3]
A. Creator ranks are automatically reviewed and updated every hour. 
Once a new rank is assigned, the corresponding point accumulation rate (%) will also be updated. 
 
  
[h2][b]4️⃣ Partner Points & Payments
[/b][/h2] 

[h3][b]Q. What are the requirements for earning Partner Points? 
[/b][/h3]
A. The amount eligible for Partner Point accumulation depends on the platform on which the supporter makes a purchase. 
- PC Platform (Netmarble Launcher): 100% of the purchase amount 
- Steam/Mobile Platforms: 50% of the purchase amount 
The final accumulation rate is determined based on the Creator’s rank, and Partner Points are then distributed in proportion to the purchase amount. 
* The purchase amount is based on USD. The country-specific (currency-based) Partner Point payment criteria will be adjusted accordingly at the time of payment. 
 
[h3][b]Q. Where can I check my accumulated Partner Points?
[/b][/h3]
A. You can check your earned Partner Points through [My Creator Page - View Support Status]. 
 
[h3][b]Q. Do Partner Points expire? 
[/b][/h3]
A. Partner Points received from supporters are valid for one year and will expire sequentially after the expiration date. 
 
[h3][b]Q. How do I request payment? 
[/b][/h3]A. You can request payment for your accumulated Partner Points through [My Creator Page - Request Payment]. 
 
[h3][b]Q. What are the payment requirements? 
[/b][/h3]
A. To request payment, you must apply within the designated payment request period and meet the minimum payment amount. 
- Payment Application Period: To be announced 
* The payment request page will only be accessible during this period. 
* The payment schedule may be subject to change. Please check the [Payment] tab for more details. 
- Minimum Payment Amount: 50,000 Partner Points
 
[h3][b]Q. What do I have to know about the payment process? What are the required documents? 
[/b][/h3]
1. For Businesses
- Invoice, proof of legal entity, and a copy of bank account (Includes account holder, account number, and bank information)
 
2. For Individuals
- ID card and copy of bank account (Includes account holder, account number, and bank information)
 
For content creators residing outside of Korea, payment will be made in USD.
A foreign currency account is required to receive the payment in USD.
 
If the payment is in USD, the payment amount will be converted according to the average basic rate of exchange published by commercial banks in Korea during the season in which the payment request has been made.
 
Content creators residing outside of Korea may be obligated to pay taxes imposed by their country of residence on earnings paid by Netmarble. Please consult a tax advisor.


[h2][b]5️⃣ Account Management
[/b][/h2] 

[h3][b]Q. Why has my creator status been revoked? 
[/b][/h3]
A. Creator status may be revoked if violations according to the Netmarble Partner Creator Plus Policy & Compliance Guidelines. 
Violations include, but are not limited to, sharing or posting obscene or vulgar content, linking to explicit websites, etc. 
For more details, please review the Netmarble Partner Creator Plus Policy & Compliance Guidelines. 

If your creator contract is terminated, any unredeemed Partner Points will be immediately forfeited, and you will no longer be able to check your status or request rewards. If you wish to appeal, please contact Netmarble Customer Support.  
 
[h3][b]Q. Can I change my linked creator channel?
[/b][/h3]
A. Currently, only YouTube channels can be linked. 
We will provide further updates if additional platforms become available in the future. 
 
[h3][b]Q. I want to stop being a creator. 
[/b][/h3]
A. If you wish to stop your creator activities, please submit a 1:1 inquiry through Netmarble Customer Support to request withdrawal. 
You will be notified of the completion status through the customer support response. 
 
[h3][b]Q. Can I rejoin after stopping my creator activities? 
[/b][/h3]A. You may rejoin unless you were forcibly removed due to violations of the Partner Creator Plus Policy or other reasons. To rejoin, you must go through a new application process. 
 
[h3][b]Q. Will my creator status be revoked if I delete my game account? 
[/b][/h3]
A. If you registered with a Netmarble ID and then deleted it, your creator status will also be revoked and you will no longer be able to use any services. 
If you only delete your in-game account (without deleting your Netmarble ID), you can continue creator activities, but certain Partner Creator benefits may no longer be available.  
 
 
[h2][b]6️⃣ Other Information
[/b][/h2] 

[h3][b]Q. Can I apply for the Partner Creator program for multiple games? 
[/b][/h3]
A. There is no limit to the number of games you can apply for as a Partner Creator. However, you cannot create multiple creator accounts for the same game. 
 
[h3][b]Q. Can a creator also be a supporter? 
[/b][/h3]
A. Yes, creators can support other creators by participating in supporter activities. However, you cannot support yourself. 
 
 
We trust this [Creator FAQ] will guide you as you embark on your journey with [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] Partner Creator Plus. Your creativity and passion contribute to shaping the world of Westeros and beyond, and we deeply appreciate your commitment to the community.

Together, let us build a legacy that echoes through the ages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Partner Creator Plus - [Supporter FAQ]
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif[/img]

Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
 
We’ve put together a[b] [Supporters] FAQ[/b] to help guide those who wish to support the creators of [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] through the Partner Creation Plus program. 


Please refer to the following for more details.


[h2][b]■ Table of Contents
[/b][/h2][b]1️⃣ Supporter Activities
2️⃣ How to Use Coupons
3️⃣ Partner Points
4️⃣ Creator Management
5️⃣ Other Information
[/b]

[h2][b]1️⃣ Supporter Activities
[/b][/h2] 

[h3][b]Q. How do I support a creator? 
[/b][/h3]
A. If you’d like to support a [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] creator, you can do so through the [Support Now] link on the [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] Partner Creator Plus page. 

Enter the creator’s ID to begin your support. 
If you want to see more creators for [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i], you can discover a variety of them through [Recommended Content] or [Creator Promotion Page]. 
 
[h3][b]Q. How do I find a creator’s ID? 
[/b][/h3]
A. Search for the creator on the [Creator Ranking] page. 
A content creator’s ID will be displayed below their name. 
You can also check the creator ID on each creator’s homepage.  


[h2][b]2️⃣ How to Use Coupons
[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Q. How can I check the coupons I received from a creator? 
[/b][/h3]
A. You can view your coupons through [My Page (Supporter)] - [Received Benefits] - [History of Received Coupons].
 
[h3][b]Q. Are there any restrictions upon using coupons provided by creators? 
[/b][/h3]
A. Coupons from the same season can only be used once per account. If you received coupons for the same mission from multiple creators, you can only use one of the coupons. 
For example: If you receive a Season 1 Mission Coupon from both Creator A and Creator B, you can only use one of the two coupons. (Duplicate use is not allowed)
Also, please be aware that expired coupons cannot be used. Be sure to check the expiration date and use them before they expire! 
 
 
[h2][b]3️⃣ Partner Points
[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Q. How can I check my support history? 
[/b][/h3]
A. You can view your support history through [My Page (Supporter)] - [Past Support History]. 
 
[h3][b]Q. What happens to the Partner Points if I cancel a purchase? 
[/b][/h3]
A. If you cancel a purchase, the Partner Points from that transaction earned by the creator will also be canceled. 
 
[h3][b]Q. What is the support limit? 
[/b][/h3]
A. There is no specific support limit during a season. Supporter activities can continue throughout the entire season. 
Once a season ends, Partner Points can no longer be earned, and points will not accumulate until the beginning of the next season. 
 
[h3][b]Q. I made a payment without selecting a creator. Is there a way to get the points back? 
[/b][/h3]
A. If you didn’t enter a creator ID, there is no way to identify the creator you intended to support, so Partner Points will not be distributed. 
Partner Points are distributed starting from the moment you register your support by entering a creator ID. Partner Points will not be credited for payments made prior to registering a creator. 
 
 
[h2][b]4️⃣ Creator Management
[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Q. How do I cancel my support to a creator? 
[/b][/h3]
A. If you no longer wish to support a creator, you can stop supporting them through [My Page (Supporter)] - [My Support List] under the list of creators you support for each game. 
You can stop supporting a creator by selecting [Discontinue Support] below their name. 
 
[h3][b]Q. How can I change the creator I’m supporting? 
[/b][/h3]
A. You can only support one creator per game. If you wish to support a different creator, you must first cancel your current support. After canceling your current support, you can register the new creator’s ID by selecting the [Support] button on the creator’s page (from the Ranking page or creator’s homepage). 
You can also manage this through [My Page (Supporter)] - [My Support List] and remove the current creator before registering a new one. 
* Please note you can only discontinue creator support once a day, which is reset at 4 PM (PT) daily. 


[h2][b]5️⃣ Other Information
[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Q. I think a creator has violated the Content Creator Policy. How can I report this? 
[/b][/h3]
A. In accordance with Netmarble’s Creator Plus Policy, inappropriate behavior during broadcasts and content creation is strictly prohibited. Creators found violating this policy may be suspended. 
If you notice any inappropriate behavior in a creator’s content, please submit a 1:1 inquiry through our customer support center.  
When submitting your inquiry, please include the URL of the content in question along with screenshots of the issue so that it can be reviewed internally. 
 
[b][Creator Policy Violations]
[/b]1. Sharing or posting obscene or inappropriate content, linking to obscene sites, sending or spreading words, sounds, writing, pictures, photos or videos that cause humiliation, disgust, or fear to others. 
2. Engaging in, imitating, inducing or promoting illegal speculative activities or practices. 
3. Posting, distributing, collecting, or storing other people’s personal information without consent. 
4. Infringing on the rights of others, including intellectual property rights. 
5. Using another creator’s account or providing a creator account to others to repeatedly participate in Netmarble’s Partner Creator Plus events, claim rewards, or similar activities. 
6. Employees of the company (including affiliated companies) and their immediate family members (including spouses) using their own or others’ accounts to act as Netmarble Partner Creators. 
7. Engaging in behaviors that harm the emotional development of minors (e.g. excessive profanity, inappropriate clothing or remarks, etc.) or exposing content related to harmful substances or sites. 
8. Discriminatory or derogatory behaviors based on disability, region, religion, race, gender, etc.
9. Requesting others to progress in the game on your behalf (game boosting) or using another’s account to play the game.  
10. Using unauthorized programs or applications to play the game. 
11. Distributing restricted or private information. 
12. Engaging in any behavior that violates applicable laws or goes against public morals and social norms. 

All reported content will be carefully investigated, so please be mindful that it may take some time to analyze a reported case.

We also ask for your understanding that it might be difficult to take action if there’s not enough evidence, or if it is not possible to confirm the reported behavior during the investigation.
 

We trust this [Support FAQ] will assist you in navigating your journey with [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] Partner Creator Plus. Your dedication to supporting the creators of Westeros and beyond strengthens our community, and we are grateful for your continued involvement.

May your support shape the realms for the better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/5ed36ee26b1ff3db583fb8abcaf82146b8ca8f7e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Steam Early Access FAQ
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/b12f21ba30e92bbd6503cb8c881325f8f31f2348.gif[/img]

Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 

The banners have been raised, and the fight against the cold winds of winter is about to begin.
Your stories in the lands of Westeros will soon unfold. 

Early Access will be available to those who secure a [b]Founder’s Pack[/b], and we’ve prepared a helpful FAQ to ensure you’re fully equipped for the adventure ahead. 

[h3][b]❓Instability issues when playing on 13th and 14th Gen Intel CPUs[/b][/h3]
A) Gameplay may be occasionally unstable on a 13th or 14th Gen Intel CPU. Intel is currently distributing a 0x129 microcode fix to address the root cause. Please check your motherboard's manufacturer's website for the latest BIOS update. For further details, please refer to the links below.
https://community.intel.com/t5/Processors/July-2024-Update-on-Instability-Reports-on-Intel-Core-13th-and/m-p/1617113

https://community.intel.com/t5/Processors/Microcode-0x129-Update-for-Intel-Core-13th-and-14th-Gen-Desktop/m-p/1622129


[h3][b]❓ I can’t see the [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] store page on my Steam account. 
[/b][/h3]💬 [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] is preparing for a global release, and we are diligently working on the necessary arrangements for each region, taking into account local policies, languages, and technical environments. Due to this internal process, the game’s availability may be delayed in certain regions. We appreciate your understanding and will share further updates through our official channels once the release schedule is confirmed.

[h3][b]❓ How can I play the Steam Early Access version?
[/b][/h3]💬 You must purchase a [b]Founder’s Pack[/b], which is available as DLC through your Steam account, in order to join in during the Early Access Period. 
* The Founder’s Pack grants early access to the game. Please note that the official release date is subject to change.  
▪ Founder’s Pack Sale Period: March 20, 6 PM (PT) - Until further notice
▪ Founder’s Pack Availability: After March 26, 12 AM (PT) 

[h3][b]❓ Can I purchase a different Founder’s Pack after already buying one? 
[/b][/h3]💬 You can only purchase one Founder’s Pack per Steam account. Once bought, it cannot be canceled. 
However, you can purchase an upgrade to a higher-tier Founder’s Pack within the game if you wish to acquire other components and benefits that were not included in your current pack. 

[h3][b]❓ Will I keep my account information after Steam Early Access ends? 
[/b][/h3]💬 Yes, all information linked to your Steam account during the Early Access period, including your Netmarble ID, will be preserved.
* [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] will be available on multiple platforms, including mobile devices, upon its official release. If you wish to cross-play, we recommend additionally linking your Steam account on your Netmarble ID with other available linking options such as Facebook, Google or Apple. 
* Please take care to secure your account information to avoid losing access. 

[h3][b]❓ Can I share all of my Early Access gameplay and events on social media? 
[/b][/h3]💬 Absolutely! We encourage you to share your thrilling adventures across Westeros on various platforms. 
Additionally, [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i] will soon be launching the Netmarble Partner Creator Program, designed to support and encourage the creation of stories and videos by our players. 
Stay tuned for more details about the program, which will be shared in the near future! 

[h3][b]❓ What should I do if I encounter bugs or issues while playing? 
[/b][/h3]💬 If you experience any issues, please report them through the [b][Menu > Options > Info > Support][/b] section in the game. 
* Including screenshots and/or videos, along with a detailed description, will help us identify and resolve the issue more efficiently. 
* You can reach out to our Customer Support team for any other game-related problems or feedback.


We look forward to welcoming you on this exciting adventure across the Seven Kingdoms! Stay tuned for more updates, and be sure to secure your Founder’s Pack to dive into the game as soon as Early Access begins. We can’t wait to see you on the Kingsroad!

notes.title: Live Chat Giveaway Results: Event Winners Revealed!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/054e6b8f1adbdb19693db0f68f26dee4d37f65fe.gif[/img]

Greetings, Lords and Ladies. 
This is the [b]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad [/b]team. 

After an engaging and exciting developer stream that took place during Steam Next Fest, we are finally ready to announce the winners of our special giveaway. 

We thank everyone who participated and interacted with us. The following participants have earned the Steam Demo Celebration Special Gift, which will aid them greatly in their journey through [i]Game of Thrones: Kingsroad[/i]!


[h3][b]🏆Winners & Rewards
[/b][/h3]■ Steam Demo Celebration Special Gift x1

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/fd5f1620587d662056391a141c80ea63a57b0667.png[/img]

* The announced winners are based on the Steam Profile Name used at the time of the live chat event. Please make sure to check your Steam name, as any discrepancies may cause issues in verifying your win.

[h3][b]🎁Rewards Distribution [/b][/h3]
- The winners will sequentially receive a friend request from our account [b][GoT: Kingsroad][/b] after this notice is posted. Once you have been added as a friend, we will reach out to you through Steam Chat and send you the event reward codes. 
[b]* Please note that friend requests must be accepted by March 21, 12 AM (PT). Failure to do so may result in difficulty claiming the event rewards.
[/b]- The event reward codes will be sent out sequentially between March 24 and March 25.
* Further details regarding the contents of the Steam Demo Celebration Special Gift will be included in the Steam message.


Once again, a big thank you to all of those who participated in the stream’s Q&A session. Below are some of the most notable questions and our responses:

[b]❓: What is the maximum number of players who can fight together in World Boss battles?
[/b]💬: For world bosses, the party size is 8 players. The Altar of Memories can be played with a party of 4. 

[b]❓: Will you be able to address the concerns regarding the 4-man dungeon requirement? As time goes on, this will only lead to longer queue times and make older dungeons even harder to complete, as no one will want to do them again.
[/b]💬: Definitely! This is something that we've addressed internally. We'll be making it so players can enter dungeons in a party of 1~3 as well. I can't speak with full authority on this, but judging by what other games have done in the past, I assume that dungeon requirements will be adjusted before this kind of thing becomes an issue - we don't want to lock any players out of any content they'd like to enjoy.

[b]❓: Is there multiplayer in the main story of the game? Specifically, can we explore the world together?
[/b]💬: The game's main story can be enjoyed in single-player, but there are multi-player areas throughout the world, most notably the major castles such as Winterfell.

[b]❓: Will PC players have more graphic options, such as anti-aliasing and other settings?
[/b]💬: Yes! We want to make sure players will have the best possible experience on their platform of choice, so the PC version will have all of the graphic options you've come to expect.

[b]❓: In the official game, will we have full access to the map from the start, allowing us to explore Westeros freely?
[/b]💬: The map will open up as you explore the lands of Westeros, it won't be fully opened right from the start. After having discovered an area, you will be able to fast-travel to it at any time for convenience.

[b]❓: We have World Bosses and dungeons now. Do you have any information about additional co-op activities?
[/b]💬: Of course! We have multiple other endgame challenges waiting for our players. Both Co-Op and Single Player.

[b]❓: Do we have an estimated release time for the game? Will it launch as early access, or will it be released as a full product with ongoing updates?
[/b]💬: The game is scheduled for release this year. I can't be more specific than that right now, but if you wishlist the game you'll get notified automatically when the time comes, and our twitter and discord channels will be putting out the news as well!

[b]❓: Do you have plans for something like a multiplayer farming zone? Perhaps outside the Wall, where players can team up to fight White Walkers for farming purposes?
[/b]💬: 👀

[b]❓: As the Narrative Lead, did you have any direct contact with George R.R. Martin?
[/b]💬: Unfortunately, George is a very busy man and difficult to get hold of. We were lucky enough to be able to ask him a few specific questions through our partners at Warner Brothers, and are getting a lot of support from the experts on their end as well.

[b]❓: Will Kennet return as a White Walker miniboss? It would be awesome if we encounter him first when we cross the Wall later.
[/b]💬: I won't spoil too much, but this is indeed not the last we've seen of Kennet.

[b]❓: Will the Rankings system reset every week, or if you achieve your best score once, can it remain on the list forever, allowing you to claim rewards continuously?
[/b]💬: For example, Altar of Memories rankings will have a weekly reset allowing people to compete for better time each week!

[b]❓: The first thing I tried to do, even before any other mission, was head to King’s Landing, but sadly I couldn’t. Can’t wait to be able to do that in the official game!
[/b]💬: Right! The demo is restricted in its scope, but you will be able to visit many more locations in the full release later this year.

[b]❓: Will we be able to participate in main story battles or wars, like the Battle of the Bastards? That would be amazing!
[/b]💬: Kingsroad takes place near the end of Season 4 of the show, so the events of the show play a role in the story of our protagonist as well. Again, I don't want to spoil anything, but one of our goals was to use the events of the show as a starting point for each region and expand on them.

[b]❓: Is the game based on the show or the books? 
[/b]💬: The game is based on the show, but since the show is based on the books, we are also taking inspiration from situations described there - but only in so far as they feel fitting for the world as established in the show.

[b]❓: Is there a content creator program for this game that I can join?
[/b]💬: Content creators are highly valuable to us. Be on the lookout!

[b]❓: I truly hope we get those RPG choices.
[/b]💬: I'm a huge cRPG fan, so I share your interest in choice and consequence. As you saw just now in the video, we have a dialogue system similar to that of recent ARPGs, and it will be possible to establish your character's attitude through those.

[b]❓: Will there be companions who travel and fight alongside you?
[/b]💬: Yes! As you saw just now in the prologue with Kennet and Jon, the PC will be joined by allied NPCs from time to time in both the main quest and subquests.

[b]❓: Will I be able to romance Cersei or Jon Snow?
[/b]💬: You asked a very important question, to which I unfortunately have to answer - only in the private build I have on my PC at the office.

[b]❓: From a narrative standpoint, since we have options, will these choices affect the story in the game, such as in cut-scenes or other ways?
[/b]💬: As mentioned above, we do have a dialogue system and the choices you make can indeed impact the way the story unfolds. This is especially pronounced in subquests, since those are more manageable in their scope.

[b]❓: Will there be more exotic mounts, such as dragons, spiders, or griffins?
[/b]💬: I want to answer that, but I can't... yet 😉

[b]❓: Will there be more variety in weapon designs between sets? In the beta, they all looked quite similar.
[/b]💬: Weapons will have different models as tiers change!

[b]❓: I have concerns about the P2W aspects of the game. 
[/b]💬: Regarding 'P2W' in general - As the narrative guy, I haven't had much to do with the business model for the game, but I do know that we are actively avoiding P2W - everyone will be able to enjoy the game to the fullest without being forced to make purchases.

[b]❓: I’ve probably spent over 60 hours between the closed beta and the demo, and I’ve really enjoyed the game. Each of the three classes is fun to play in its own way. Are there any plans to add additional class types in the future?
[/b]💬: Wow, you've played a lot! I'm so glad to hear you've enjoyed the demo because, if I may say so myself, the story actually gets much better in the later chapters so I'm sure you'll enjoy it even more! I can't say anything about additional classes at the moment, unfortunately.

[b]❓: Will there be a PvP arena or any other types of PvP content in the game?
[/b]💬: PVP isn't in the scope of our current spec, but we're experimenting with various ideas to see what would make the most enjoyable experience to the players.

[b]❓: I can't wait to see which iconic characters will make an appearance!
[/b]💬: Regarding show characters - Since the demo only takes place in the North, we haven't been able to show off many of the ones you'll be able to interact with in the game yet, but rest assured most fan-favorite characters will make an appearance and you'll even be able to fight (alongside) some.


[h3][b]📌Additional Notes
[/b][/h3]- Event rewards can only be claimed once per account. 


We appreciate your curiosity and look forward to more discussions as we continue our journey toward the official release.

Stay tuned for more exciting updates and events, and may your path through Westeros be filled with glory!

notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions
notes.notes:
[h2][b]⭐ Game of Thrones: Kingsroad Demo Play FAQ[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]❓ What do I need to know about the Steam demo?[/b]
[/h3]A) The conditions to play the Steam demo are as follows. 
① Steam Demo Play Period: February 23, 2025, 23:00 - March 4, 2025, 00:00 (PT)
② Supported Languages: English / French / Italian / German / Spanish
③ Netmarble ID Linking Accounts: Google / Apple / Email / Steam 

* Certain content and features, including purchases of paid items, may be restricted during the Steam demo play period.
* Please note that the demo play may be restricted in certain countries.
* Please note that Facebook account linking is not yet supported, but will be made available in the future.

[h3][b]❓ What are the PC specifications required for the demo?[/b] 
[/h3]A) The demo is available with the following minimum and recommended system requirements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505270/af49e16e379bc3751a5eb3983c74e271e3dfa9ad.png[/img]

* Game of Thrones: Kingsroad offers controller support.


[h2][b]⭐ Game of Thrones: Kingsroad Demo Usage FAQ
[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]❓ Why can't I launch the game after installation?
[/b][/h3]A) If you're having trouble launching the game, please try the following steps to resolve the issue. 

[b]① Restart Your PC
[/b]Restart your computer and try launching the game again

[b]② Verify Game Files via Steam[/b] [url=https://help.steampowered.com/faqs/view/0C48-FCBD-DA71-93EB][Click here for details][/url]
1. Restart your computer and launch Steam
2. Right-click on Game of Thrones: Kingsroad in your Library or click the gear icon on the right side of the game's Library page
3. Select "Properties..." from the dropdown menu
4. Go to the Installed Files tab and click "Verify integrity of demo files"

[b]③ Reinstall the Game[/b]
1. Launch Steam
2. Right click Game of Thrones: Kingsroad and select "Manage"
3. Select Uninstall
4. Reinstall the game after uninstallation is complete

[b]④ Check Your Antivirus & Security Software[/b]
Set Game of Thrones: Kingsroad as an exclusion in your security software
* If it is already set as an exclusion, try temporarily disabling real-time protection before launching the game.

For additional troubleshooting, we recommend checking for any other software that might negatively affect the performance of Steam games or the Steam client [url=https://help.steampowered.com/faqs/view/1F39-DCB4-FF28-5748]here[/url].  

[h3][b]❓ Why does the game keep disconnecting? 
[/b][/h3]A) If you're experiencing issues such as game crashes or freezing, please follow the steps below to resolve the issues. 

[b]① Windows Update
[/b]1. Click the Windows button in the bottom left and click "Settings"
2. Click on "Windows Update" to update to the latest version of Windows

[b]② Graphics Driver Update
[/b]1. Click the Windows button in the bottom left and click "Settings"
2. Select "Windows Update", and click on "Advanced options", and then "Optional updates" 
3. Click "Driver updates" and select your graphics driver 
4. Click "Download and Install"

[b]③ Network Driver Update
[/b]1. Open Device Manager and expand the "Network adapters" section 
2. Double-click the network card name, then select the Driver tab to check the driver date
3. If the driver is not up to date, visit the network driver manufacturer's website to update to the latest version 

For additional troubleshooting, we recommend checking for any other software that might negatively affect the performance of Steam games or the Steam client [url=https://help.steampowered.com/faqs/view/1F39-DCB4-FF28-5748]here[/url].  

[h3][b]❓ Will I be able to keep my account information after the demo period ends? 
[/b][/h3]A) The Netmarble account linked to your Steam account during the demo period will be retained; however, all game data will be deleted. 

Upon official release, you will be able to log in using the same account information used during the demo in order to play Game of Thrones: Kingsroad again. 

* If you're unable to access your Steam account, please reach out to Steam Support for assistance.

[h3][b]❓ What should I do if I encounter bugs or issues during the demo period? 
[/b][/h3]A) Please report any bugs or issues through the in-game path [Menu > Settings > Info > Support].

* Providing details such as screenshots and specific circumstances under which the issue occurred will help us accurately identify and resolve the issue. 
* Any other game-related problems or additional feedback can also be submitted via Customer Support. 

[h3][b]❓ Can I share my gameplay on social media? 
[/b][/h3]A) You can create any content through live streaming, videos, screenshots, and share them across multiple channels.

There are no specific security restrictions, so feel free to share your journey through Kingsroad! 

[h3][b]❓ Will the official release of the game be the same as the demo version? 
[/b][/h3]A) This demo version is intended for testing purposes and may differ from the final version of the game upon official release.

Our team is committed to delivering a more immersive experience set in the intense world of Westeros, and some changes may be made to improve the game based on the feedback we receive. 

We aim to actively fix bugs and incorporate feedback from the demo, so please don’t hesitate to share your opinions and reports to help us improve the game!
